meta.title: Awesome-TCM-LLM
meta.title_zh: 开源中医模型、数据、论文、专利
meta.description_zh: 开源中医模型、数据、论文、专利精选，也带一点相关中文医疗资源。
meta.description_en: Curated open TCM models, datasets, papers, and patents, plus a few related Chinese medical resources.

items.name: 广医·岐智大模型2.0亮相2026服贸会，落地AI医生安安与六大医院场景
items.summary_zh: 中国中医科学院广安门医院在2026服贸会展示**广医·岐智2.0**，以AI医生「安安」覆盖患者服务、临床诊疗、病房管理等六大场景
items.summary_en: Guang'anmen Hospital shows **Guangyi Qizhi 2.0** at CIFTIS 2026, with AI doctor An'an covering six hospital scenes from patient service to ward management.

items.name: 北京中医药大学在服贸会首发展示中医体质辨识体系与具身智能推拿机器人
items.summary_zh: 2026服贸会中医药展区，北京中医药大学**首发首展**中医体质辨识体系与具身智能推拿机器人，同期还有智能诊脉设备体验
items.summary_en: Beijing University of Chinese Medicine debuts a TCM constitution-identification system and an embodied tuina robot at the CIFTIS 2026 TCM pavilion.

items.name: 上海市第七人民医院发布岐元中医大模型，支持名老中医Agent数字孪生
items.summary_zh: 上海中医药大学附属第七人民医院正式发布**岐元大模型**，采用预训练+领域微调+专家强化学习，支持生成式病历与名老中医Agent数字孪生，并亮相WAIC
items.summary_en: Shanghai Seventh People's Hospital (SHUTCM) releases the **Qiyuan** TCM LLM with pretraining, domain fine-tuning, and expert RL; supports generative medical records and master-physician Agent digital twins; showcased at WAIC.

items.name: 贵州医大等发布华族本草民族药AI大模型
items.summary_zh: 贵州医科大学等在中国—东盟教育交流周发布全国首个民族药创制全域智能平台**华族本草**，以数智岐黄+Qwen为底座融汇多民族医药古籍
items.summary_en: Guizhou Medical University and partners launch **HuaZu BenCao**, a national ethnic-medicine AI platform built on ShuZhi QiHuang + Qwen integrating multi-ethnic materia medica classics.

items.name: 安顿七诊合参中医机器人亮相WAIC 2026
items.summary_zh: 安顿健康在WAIC 2026首发**七诊合参**中医机器人，集成面/红外面/舌/耳/闻/问/脉采集；报道称底座为2350亿参数的中医大模型。该页未写天回
items.summary_en: Andun Health debuts a **seven-diagnosis** TCM robot at WAIC 2026, integrating face, infrared face, tongue, ear, auscultation, inquiry, and pulse. The page cites a 235-billion-parameter TCM model and does not mention TianHui.

items.name: 智慧眼砭石多模态中医大模型亮相WAIC 2026
items.summary_zh: 智慧眼携**砭石云中医**亮相WAIC 2026，以已备案砭石多模态大模型为底座，展示四诊仪与辅助诊疗系统
items.summary_en: Insightful Eye presents **Bianshi Cloud TCM** at WAIC 2026, built on a registered Bianshi multimodal model with four-diagnosis devices and assisted-care systems.

items.name: 中科闻歌通过港交所上市聆讯；与中国中医科学院合作的大医金匮中医大模型已通过中国信通院最高级别可信AI认证
items.summary_zh: 中科闻歌通过港交所上市聆讯；报道提及与中国中医科学院合作的**大医金匮**中医大模型已通过中国信通院最高级别可信AI认证
items.align_note: 大医金匮聆讯措辞已按核验修正
items.summary_en: Zhongke Wenge passes HKEX listing hearing; reports note the **DaYi JinKui** TCM LLM (with CACMS) has obtained top-tier CAICT Trusted AI certification.

items.name: 北京中医药大学牵头研发的薪火中国药中医药教育大模型通过国家生成式人工智能服务备案
items.summary_zh: 北京中医药大学牵头研发的**薪火中国药**中医药教育大模型通过国家生成式人工智能服务备案，成为国内首个获批面向公众服务的中医药领域大模型
items.summary_en: Beijing University of Chinese Medicine's **XinHuo ZhongGuoYao** TCM education LLM completes national generative-AI service filing—the first publicly approved TCM-domain model of its kind.

items.name: 山东启动智汇岐黄中医药大模型重点场景项目
items.summary_zh: 山东中医药大学附属医院启动山东省卫健委「人工智能＋」中医药重点场景**智汇岐黄**大模型项目
items.summary_en: Affiliated Hospital of Shandong University of TCM launches the provincial AI+ TCM scenario project **ZhiHui QiHuang**.

items.name: 八部门印发中药工业高质量发展实施方案提出AI与知识图谱赋能
items.summary_zh: 工信部等八部门印发《中药工业高质量发展实施方案（2026—2030年）》，明确运用人工智能与知识图谱赋能经典名方与名老中医经验方研发
items.summary_en: Eight ministries issue the TCM Industry High-Quality Development Plan (2026–2030), calling for AI and knowledge graphs to empower classical formulas and master physicians' prescriptions.

items.name: 吉林发布众星·长白岐黄1.0 AI原生多模态中医药大模型
items.summary_zh: 吉林发布**众星·长白岐黄1.0** AI原生多模态中医药大模型
items.summary_en: Jilin releases **ZhongXing·Changbai Qihuang 1.0**, an AI-native multimodal TCM LLM.

items.name: 固生堂发布“中医大脑”及国医大师施杞教授AI数字分身，已累计发布14位顶级专家数字分身
items.summary_zh: 固生堂发布“中医大脑”及国医大师施杞教授AI数字分身，已累计发布14位顶级专家数字分身。八大专科出自另一则十大分身报道，本页未写
items.summary_en: Gushengtang launches a “TCM Brain” and an AI twin of National TCM Master Shi Qi, with 14 expert twins released. The eight-specialty claim is from a different story, not this page.

items.name: 智明堂ZMT-M1在国家中医执业医师资格考试模拟测试中以96.26分获得该领域最佳成绩
items.summary_zh: **智明堂ZMT-M1**在国家中医执业医师资格考试模拟测试中以96.26分获得该领域最佳成绩，已在全国100余间诊室试点应用
items.summary_en: **ZMT-M1** scores 96.26 on a simulated national TCM practitioner exam and is piloted in 100+ clinics.

items.name: 国家卫健委等五部门印发《关于促进和规范”人工智能+医疗卫生”应用发展的实施意见》
items.summary_zh: 国家卫健委等五部门印发《关于促进和规范”人工智能+医疗卫生”应用发展的实施意见》，明确支撑建设中医药诊疗大模型
items.summary_en: Five national health ministries issue AI+ healthcare guidelines that explicitly support building TCM diagnostic LLMs.

items.name: 传神素问中医大模型通过中国信通院可信AI中医药大模型4+级评估
items.summary_zh: 页面受评对象是**传神素问**中医大模型，获得可信AI中医药大模型4+级；正文写它由传神语联基于任度大模型打造
items.summary_en: The evaluated model on this page is **Chuanshen Suwen**, which passed CAICT Trusted AI TCM LLM Level 4+. The text says Transn built it on the Rendu base model.

items.name: 智赋岐黄天功中医AI大模型通过国家深度合成服务算法备案，应用于中医四诊仪与体质辨识
items.summary_zh: **智赋岐黄天功**中医AI大模型通过国家深度合成服务算法备案，应用于中医四诊仪与体质辨识
items.summary_en: **ZhiFu Qihuang Tiangong** TCM AI model completes national deep-synthesis algorithm filing for four-diagnosis devices and constitution assessment.

items.name: 伊尹中医经典大模型在河南嵩县启用
items.summary_zh: 中原药谷基层中医药振兴工程下，**伊尹中医经典大模型**在嵩县发布启用，融合中医教育与AI辅助诊疗服务县域基层
items.summary_en: **YiYin** classical TCM LLM goes live in Song County, Henan, combining TCM education with AI-assisted care for county clinics.

items.name: 固生堂正式发布十大“国医AI分身”，专家模拟一致性达86%以上
items.summary_zh: **固生堂**正式发布十大“国医AI分身”，基于国医大师及名中医临床经验构建。页面写专家模拟一致性达86%以上，不是辨证准确率
items.summary_en: **Gushengtang** releases ten “National Master AI twins” trained on master clinicians' experience. The page reports expert-simulation consistency above 86%, not pattern-differentiation accuracy.

items.name: 天河·灵枢中医药大模型2.0与智能模型评价体系发布
items.summary_zh: 国家超算天津中心联合天津中医药大学等发布**天河·灵枢**2.0，由针灸专科扩展至20余科；同步启动中医药智能模型评价体系
items.summary_en: NSCC-TJ and Tianjin University of TCM release **TianHe·LingShu** 2.0 (expanded beyond acupuncture to 20+ specialties) and launch a TCM intelligent-model evaluation system.

items.name: 广安门医院成立广医·岐智大模型智能体联盟
items.summary_zh: 中国中医科学院广安门医院与多家医联体单位成立**广医·岐智大模型智能体联盟**，推进跨机构智能诊疗能力辐射
items.summary_en: Guang'anmen Hospital forms the **GuangYi·QiZhi** LLM agent alliance with medical consortium partners for cross-institution intelligent care.

items.name: 中医横琴垂类大模型正式发布
items.summary_zh: **中医横琴**垂类大模型正式发布
items.summary_en: **TCM Hengqin** vertical LLM is officially released.

items.name: 中国中医科学院发布中医药大模型评测标准
items.summary_zh: 中国中医科学院发布中医药大模型评测标准
items.summary_en: China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences releases evaluation standards for TCM large models.

items.name: 传神语联发布任度·素问中医大模型，基于全自研混合熵(moH)技术架构，支持智能问诊、辨证分析、方剂推荐
items.summary_zh: 传神语联发布**任度·素问**中医大模型，基于全自研混合熵(moH)技术架构，支持智能问诊、辨证分析、方剂推荐
items.summary_en: Transn releases **RenDu·SuWen** TCM LLM (mixture-of-entropy architecture) for inquiry, pattern differentiation, and formula recommendation.

items.name: 广安门医院发布广医·岐智中医大模型，成为国内首家本地化部署“算力+模型+应用”一体化服务的中医医院
items.summary_zh: 中国中医科学院广安门医院28日正式发布**广医·岐智**中医大模型，成为国内首家本地化部署”算力+模型+应用”一体化服务的中医医院
items.summary_en: Guang'anmen Hospital releases **GuangYi·QiZhi**, described as the first TCM hospital with integrated local compute + model + application deployment.

items.name: 招联联合中山大学与广中医深圳医院发布仲思中医大模型
items.summary_zh: 招联消费金融联合中山大学、广州中医药大学深圳医院发布中医垂直大模型**仲思**，落地深圳多家社康中心智能问诊
items.summary_en: China UnionPay Consumer Finance with Sun Yat-sen University and GZUCMS Shenzhen Hospital release vertical TCM LLM **ZhongSi** for community clinic inquiry.

items.name: 中科闻歌发布大医金匮中医大模型及中医智能健康管理平台，基于1500余本中医典籍及海量临床医案训练
items.summary_zh: 中科闻歌发布**大医金匮**中医大模型及中医智能健康管理平台，基于1500余本中医典籍及海量临床医案训练
items.summary_en: Zhongke Wenge releases **DaYi JinKui** TCM LLM and a health platform trained on 1,500+ TCM classics and a large set of clinical cases.

items.name: 天士力与华为发布数智本草中医药语言与计算双模态大模型
items.summary_zh: 天士力与华为云联合发布**数智本草**大模型，基于盘古语言与药物分子模型。本页没有信通院4+级评估
items.summary_en: Tasly and Huawei Cloud release **ShuZhi BenCao** on Pangu language and molecular models. This page does not mention a CAICT Level 4+ evaluation.

items.name: 华东师范大学联合发布数智岐黄2.0
items.summary_zh: 华东师范大学、上海中医药大学、华东理工大学、海军军医大学、临港实验室和华润江中一起做了**数智岐黄**。1.0 在 2024 年 1 月 19 日发布。2024 年 11 月 25 日，他们在上海一场论坛上介绍了 2.0。
items.summary_en: ECNU, Shanghai University of Traditional Chinese Medicine, East China University of Science and Technology, Naval Medical University, Lingang Laboratory, and CR Jiangzhong built **ShuZhi QiHuang**. Version 1.0 came out on 19 January 2024. On 25 November 2024 they introduced version 2.0 at a forum in Shanghai.

items.name: 大经中医发布岐黄问道中医大模型
items.summary_zh: 南京大经中医发布**岐黄问道·大模型**，基于千万级知识图谱与临床数据，面向医疗机构开放内测
items.summary_en: Nanjing Dajing TCM releases **QiHuang Wendao** LLM with large knowledge graphs and clinical data for institutional beta use.

items.name: CORE-Acu
items.summary_zh: 针灸临床决策：结构化推理轨迹与知识图谱安全否决闭环
items.summary_en: Acupuncture clinical decision support with structured reasoning traces and a knowledge-graph safety veto loop.

items.name: DERM-3R
items.summary_zh: 资源受限下的中医皮肤病多模态多智能体框架（识别/表征/辨证论治三智能体）
items.summary_en: Resource-constrained multimodal multi-agent framework for TCM dermatology (recognition / representation / SDT agents).

items.name: GastroTCM
items.summary_zh: 中医消化内科大模型，基于Llama3-8B微调并结合RAG与智能体框架。Chinese Medicine 论文署名清华大学 TCM-X 与中日友好医院等
items.summary_en: TCM gastroenterology LLM fine-tuned from Llama3-8B with RAG and agent scaffolding. Chinese Medicine paper from Tsinghua TCM-X and China-Japan Friendship Hospital et al.

items.name: MMIR-TCM
items.summary_zh: 记忆增强的多模态舌诊与临床决策框架，提出 MedTCM 数据集与 TDEU 评测指标
items.summary_en: Memory-augmented multimodal tongue diagnosis and clinical decision framework; proposes MedTCM dataset and TDEU metric.

items.name: Qwen-TCM-Dia
items.summary_zh: 面向中医泄泻的专科微调模型（续训+CoT指令微调），覆盖症状→病机→治法→方药推理链。Digital Chinese Medicine 署名首都医科大学附属北京中医医院与北京中医药大学等
orgs: 首都医科大学附属北京中医医院
items.summary_en: Specialty fine-tuned model for TCM diarrhea care (CPT + CoT SFT) covering symptom→pathomechanism→method→formula chains. Digital Chinese Medicine authors at Beijing Hospital of TCM (CMU) and BUCM et al.
orgs_en: Beijing Hospital of TCM, Capital Medical University
Beijing University of Chinese Medicine et al.

items.name: TCM-Agent
items.summary_zh: 面向网络药理学与中药发现的 LLM 多智能体系统
items.summary_en: LLM multi-agent system for network pharmacology and herbal discovery.

items.name: TCM-DiffRAG
orgs: Guangdong Institute of Intelligence Science and Technology, Zhuhai
items.summary_zh: 通用知识图谱 + 个性化知识图谱 + CoT 的辨证推理 RAG 框架
items.summary_en: Syndrome-differentiation RAG with a general KG, a personalized KG, and chain-of-thought.

items.name: TongueVLM
items.summary_zh: 中医舌诊多模态大模型，支持舌象描述生成与体质推理。JMIR 页被拦截，OpenAlex 记录作者单位为合肥工业大学与安徽中医药大学等
items.summary_en: Multimodal VLM for TCM tongue diagnosis, description generation, and constitution reasoning. JMIR page blocked; OpenAlex lists HFUT and Anhui University of Chinese Medicine et al.
orgs_en: Anhui University of Chinese Medicine et al.

items.name: 杏核 (Xinghe)
items.summary_zh: Xinghe-TCM 基于 Qwen3.5-9B 的内经推理模型；QLoRA 后合并权重，约 2009 条内经指令，显式思维链辨证并强调不开方。HF 页无独立论文、无高校署名
items.summary_en: Xinghe-TCM Neijing reasoning model on Qwen3.5-9B (QLoRA, ~2009 instructions, no-prescription safety). HF page lists no paper and no university affiliation.

items.name: 灵兰秘典 (LingLan)
items.summary_zh: 大规模多任务中医评测基准，覆盖 5 大域、13 子任务、25620 条经专家核对的实例
items.summary_en: Large multi-task TCM benchmark: 5 domains, 13 subtasks, 25,620 expert-verified items.

items.name: ATCMD-Bench
items.summary_zh: 首个Agentic中医诊断基准，通过多智能体模拟问诊评估LLM诊疗能力
items.summary_en: First agentic TCM diagnosis benchmark, evaluating LLMs through multi-agent simulated consultations.

items.name: 中医端到端临床支持基准
items.summary_zh: 面向端到端临床支持全链路的中医LLM评测基准
items.summary_en: Benchmark for end-to-end TCM clinical support across the full LLM care pipeline.

items.name: 青囊 (QingNangTCM)
items.summary_zh: 参数高效微调的中医问答与临床推理模型，构建10万条**QnTCM_Dataset**语料
items.summary_en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuned TCM QA and clinical reasoning model; builds the 100k-item **QnTCM_Dataset**.

items.name: HerbWise
items.summary_zh: 面向传统草药（THM）的领域大模型，服务草药现代化与标准化
items.summary_en: Domain LLM for traditional herbal medicine (THM), serving herbal modernization and standardization.
orgs_en: Chengdu University of Traditional Chinese Medicine

items.name: Med-Shicheng（师承）
items.summary_zh: 基于天医 (Tianyi) 的轻量级名老中医经验传承框架，单模型内化5位国医大师知识系统、覆盖7类任务
items.summary_en: Lightweight master-physician experience-inheritance framework built on Tianyi; a single model internalizes 5 national masters' knowledge systems across 7 task types.
orgs_en: Nanjing University of Chinese Medicine et al.

items.name: DongYuan
items.summary_zh: 中西医结合脾胃病诊断LLM框架，融合中医辨证与西医诊断推理。arXiv PDF 署名河北省中医院、中科院自动化所、中科闻歌与天津大学
orgs: 中国科学院自动化研究所等
items.summary_en: Integrative spleen–stomach disease diagnosis LLM framework combining TCM pattern differentiation with Western diagnostic reasoning. arXiv PDF authors at Hebei Provincial Hospital of TCM and CASIA et al.
orgs_en: Hebei Provincial Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine
Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences et al.

items.name: MACAT
items.summary_zh: 多智能体文化感知翻译框架，实验覆盖中医经典与《论语》文化负载词英译
items.summary_en: Multi-agent culture-aware translation framework, evaluated on culture-loaded terms from TCM classics and the Analects.

items.name: TongueDx2
items.summary_zh: 舌诊深度学习设计空间系统消融研究（20+模型版本），含5109图像/976专家标注
items.summary_en: Systematic ablation of the tongue-diagnosis DL design space (20+ model variants); TongueDx2 includes 5,109 images / 976 expert annotations.

items.name: Med-Bench-Arena
items.summary_zh: 面向医学与中医药LLM/Agent的开源评测平台，支持HF/vLLM/LiteLLM、多模态与中医特色指标（ZhongJing团队）
items.summary_en: Open evaluation platform for medical and TCM LLMs/Agents (HF/vLLM/LiteLLM, multimodal, TCM-specific metrics), from the ZhongJing team.

items.name: TCMBenchEval
items.summary_zh: 基于真实临床医案的LLM中医评测基准
items.summary_en: Benchmark evaluating LLMs on real clinical TCM case records (ICIC 2026).

items.name: 舌面多模态融合智能诊断
items.summary_zh: 舌-面多模态特征融合+LLM驱动的中医智能诊断
items.summary_en: Tongue–face multimodal feature fusion with LLM-driven intelligent TCM diagnosis.

items.name: TCMI-F-6D
items.summary_zh: 中医信息学跨学科基础能力六维基准
items.summary_en: Six-dimensional benchmark of interdisciplinary foundational competence in TCM informatics.

items.name: 靳三针知识图谱问答 (Jin San Zhen KG-QA)
items.summary_zh: 靳三针针灸流派知识图谱+大模型问答工具
items.summary_en: Knowledge graph + LLM QA tool for the Jin San Zhen acupuncture school.

items.name: KDC-NER

items.summary_zh: 基于 LLaVA 架构的中文医学多模态大模型，支持中文医学影像问答，配套 llava-med-zh-eval 评测集与开源 7B 权重
items.summary_en: Chinese medical multimodal LLM based on the LLaVA architecture, with the llava-med-zh-eval benchmark and open 7B weights.

items.name: MedChatZH
items.summary_zh: 面向中医问诊对话的微调大语言模型 MedChatZH，开源问诊数据集与模型权重（Computers in Biology and Medicine 2024）
items.summary_en: MedChatZH: a fine-tuned LLM for TCM consultation dialogues, released with open dataset and weights (Comput. Biol. Med. 2024).

items.name: TCMLLM / 灵丹 (Lingdan)
items.summary_zh: 中医药大模型与处方推荐
items.summary_en: TCMLLM / Lingdan for TCM modeling and prescription recommendation.

items.name: 灵丹-V2 (Lingdan-V2)
items.summary_zh: 北交大灵丹二代中医推理家族（Qwen3 4B/8B/14B，CPT+SFT+处方GRPO）；ModelScope有权重但需申请，未标可自由下载
items.summary_en: BJTU's second Lingdan TCM reasoning family (Qwen3 4B/8B/14B with CPT, SFT, and prescription GRPO). ModelScope checkpoints exist but require access requests, so they are not marked freely downloadable.

items.name: DFGLM-TCM
items.summary_zh: 北京中医药大学东方医院与智谱等的中医临床系统，把通用中医知识与名医经验分模块建模后多任务协同；论文已发，权重未公开
items.summary_en: Dongfang Hospital / Zhipu TCM clinical system that models textbook knowledge and practitioner experience in separate modules; paper is out, weights are not.

items.name: 大数中医 (BigDataTCM)
items.summary_zh: 河南工业大学复杂性科学研究院与阿帕斯联合研发的中医垂直领域大模型（34B），提供医疗问答、诊断支持与中医知识服务
items.summary_en: BigDataTCM (34B): a vertical TCM LLM co-developed by HAUT's Complexity Science institute and Apus, offering medical QA, diagnostic support and TCM knowledge services.

items.name: 明医 (MING)
items.summary_zh: 中文医疗问诊大模型 MING，以稀疏 LoRA 混合专家（MING-MoE）增强医疗多任务学习能力（arXiv 2024）
items.align_note: ACL anthology 619 为 MedCare，明医主论文改 arXiv
items.summary_en: MING: a Chinese medical consultation LLM using a sparse mixture of low-rank adapter experts (MING-MoE) for medical multi-task learning (arXiv 2024).

items.name: 本草[原名：华驼(HuaTuo)]
items.summary_zh: 哈工大社会计算与信息检索研究中心做的本草，原来叫华驼。它用中文医学知识做指令微调，论文是 2023 年的 HuaTuo。同组后来又写了知识微调的工作，2025 年 2 月登在 ACM TKDD。
items.summary_en: BenCao, first called HuaTuo, is an instruction-tuned medical model from HIT SCIR, trained with Chinese medical knowledge. The 2023 paper is HuaTuo. The same group later published a knowledge-tuning paper in ACM TKDD in February 2025.

items.name: TCM-GPT
items.venue: Computer Methods and Programs in Biomedicine Update
items.summary_zh: 面向中医领域自适应的高效预训练大模型。期刊元数据署名北京邮电大学与伦敦大学学院
items.summary_en: Efficient pre-training of LLMs for domain adaptation in Traditional Chinese Medicine. Journal metadata lists BUPT and UCL.
orgs_en: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

items.name: CPMI-ChatGLM
orgs: 中国中医科学院安徽中医药计算机应用研究所
items.summary_zh: 中成药指令数据的 ChatGLM 参数高效微调模型。OpenAlex/期刊单位为安徽中医药大学与中国中医科学院安徽中医药计算机应用研究所
items.summary_en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning of ChatGLM with Chinese patent medicine instructions. Authors at Anhui University of Chinese Medicine and CACMS Anhui Computer Application Research Institute.
orgs_en: Anhui Computer Application Research Institute of Chinese Medicine, CACMS

items.name: TCM-FTP
items.summary_zh: 面向中药处方预测的大模型微调方法
items.summary_en: Fine-tuning LLMs for herbal prescription prediction.

items.name: LLM 腧穴定位关系抽取
items.venue: Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association
orgs: The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center , Houston, TX 77030
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型关系抽取案例研究：腧穴定位知识
items.summary_en: Relation extraction with LLMs — a case study on acupuncture point locations.

items.name: LLM 中医语言文化偏差研究
items.summary_zh: 比较不同国家大模型的中医表现，论证本土化模型的必要性
items.summary_en: Comparing LLMs developed in different countries on TCM; highlights language/cultural bias and the need for localized models.

items.name: LLM 构建中医知识图谱
items.summary_zh: 基于大语言模型的中医知识图谱构建
items.summary_en: Constructing Traditional Chinese Medicine knowledge graphs based on large language models.

items.name: 中医领域知识图谱补全
orgs: Guangdong Provincial Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine
items.summary_zh: 中医领域知识图谱补全与质量评估研究
items.summary_en: Domain knowledge graph completion and quality evaluation for Traditional Chinese Medicine.

items.name: ChatGPT 中医交互可行性研究
items.summary_zh: 以 ChatGPT 为例探讨交互式AI应用于中医的可行性与挑战
items.summary_en: Feasibility and challenges of interactive AI for TCM, using ChatGPT as an example.

items.name: Evi-BERT
items.summary_zh: 中医RCT证据自动抽取的信息抽取模型开发与验证
items.summary_en: Automated information-extraction model (Evi-BERT) enhancing RCT evidence extraction for TCM.

items.name: ZY-BERT
items.summary_zh: TCM-SD 同文提出的中医领域预训练编码器（约 0.4B token 语料）；权重在网盘，仓库另含辨证微调代码。与 2411.00897 RLAIF 文不是同一工作
items.summary_en: Domain TCM encoder from the TCM-SD paper (~0.4B-token corpus); weights are on cloud drive, with syndrome-differentiation fine-tune code in the repo. Not the same work as arXiv 2411.00897.

items.name: TCM-BERT
items.summary_zh: 用领域语料继续预训练 BERT，把中医临床记录分成五类病（JAMIA 2019）。CKCEST 版权，全量 46205 条不公开，仓库只有划分样例和网盘微调权重
items.summary_en: BERT further pretrained on TCM clinical text for five-way disease classification (JAMIA 2019). CKCEST holds copyright; the full 46,205 records are not released, only splits plus drive-hosted fine-tuned weights.

items.name: TCM MLKG-RAG
orgs: University of Science and Technology of China
items.summary_zh: 多层知识图谱检索增强生成的中医智能诊断
items.summary_en: TCM intelligent diagnosis based on multi-layer knowledge graph retrieval-augmented generation.

items.name: TCMSF
items.summary_zh: 中医证候古籍知识图谱构建框架 TCMSF，将古籍中的证候知识系统化组织并语义关联，为中医信息化提供基础（Methods of Information in Medicine 2024）
items.summary_en: TCMSF: a construction framework for a TCM syndrome ancient-book knowledge graph that organizes syndrome knowledge from classical texts in a structured, semantically oriented way (Methods Inf. Med. 2024).

items.name: ChatGPT 中医知识理解探究
items.summary_zh: ChatGPT 对中医知识理解能力的评测
items.summary_en: Evaluating ChatGPT's comprehension of Traditional Chinese Medicine knowledge.

items.name: 中医提示工程框架
items.summary_zh: 基于提示工程框架的大语言模型中医智能理解方法
items.summary_en: Prompt-engineering framework for LLM intelligent understanding in TCM.

items.name: RLAIF 中医对齐
items.summary_zh: 通过AI反馈强化学习增强大语言模型的中医能力
items.summary_en: Enhancing LLMs' TCM capabilities through reinforcement learning from AI feedback.

items.name: PresRecST
items.summary_zh: 按「辨证—立法—荐药」递进推荐中药处方（JAMIA 2024）；配套公开 TCM-Lung 编码子集与 TCM-PD 复现表，代码在 GitHub
items.summary_en: Progressive herb-prescription recommendation following syndrome differentiation then treatment planning (JAMIA 2024); ships a public encoded TCM-Lung subset and a TCM-PD reproduction table.

items.name: TCMD
items.summary_zh: 面向大模型评测的中医执业考试选择题集（论文报告约 2851 训 / 600 测）；独立打开论文页未见官方 GitHub 或 Hugging Face 下载
items.summary_en: TCMD, a TCM licensing-exam multiple-choice set for LLM evaluation (paper reports ~2,851 train / 600 test). Independent check found no official GitHub or Hugging Face download.

items.name: BSG 中医智能问答
orgs: Hunan University of Traditional Chinese Medicine
items.summary_zh: 基于 BSG 深度学习模型的中医智能问答系统（方剂与中药实例）
items.summary_en: Intelligent QA system for TCM based on a BSG deep-learning model (prescription and materia medica cases).

items.name: ACUBERT
items.summary_zh: 针灸适应证知识库的经络实体识别与分类模型
items.summary_en: ACUBERT for meridian entity recognition and classification in acupuncture indication knowledge bases.

items.name: 中医药大模型知识增强方法
items.summary_zh: 面向中医药大模型的知识增强方法，基于约十万首经典方剂构建图谱并保持方剂结构性
items.summary_en: Knowledge augmentation for TCM LLMs — a graph built from ~100k classical formulas preserving prescription structure.

items.name: 中医标准化评估基准
items.summary_zh: 覆盖13个学科共29506道题的中医测评基准，系统评测3个通用模型与5个中文医疗模型
items.summary_en: Standardized TCM evaluation benchmark of 29,506 questions across 13 subjects; tests 3 general and 5 Chinese medical LLMs.
orgs_en: Chengdu University of Traditional Chinese Medicine

items.name: 中医药问答大语言模型
items.summary_zh: RAG 结合 P-Tuning v2 微调的中医药问答大模型（ChatGLM2-6B）
items.summary_en: TCM QA LLM combining RAG with P-Tuning v2 fine-tuning on ChatGLM2-6B.

items.name: GPT-4 中医研究生考试评估
orgs: China Academy of Chinese Medical Science
Changchun University of Traditional Chinese Medicine
items.summary_zh: GPT-4 与国产主流大模型在中医研究生考试数据集上的表现评估（预印本）
items.summary_en: GPT-4 vs mainstream Chinese LLMs on a TCM postgraduate examination dataset (preprint).

items.name: RAG 增强中医问答置信度
items.summary_zh: 检索增强生成提升大模型中医问答置信度（预印本）
items.summary_en: Implementing retrieval-augmented generation to build LLM confidence in TCM (preprint).

items.name: ChatMed
items.summary_zh: ChatMed 系列中文医疗大模型，含基于 50 万+ 在线问诊数据训练的 ChatMed-Consult。GitHub README 引用 Wei Zhu / Xiaoling Wang，无独立期刊论文
items.summary_en: ChatMed series of Chinese medical LLMs, including ChatMed-Consult trained on 500k+ online consultation dialogues. GitHub README cites Wei Zhu and Xiaoling Wang; no standalone journal paper.

items.name: XrayGLM
items.summary_zh: 会看胸部X光片的中文多模态医学大模型
items.summary_en: Chinese multimodal medical LLM for chest X-ray interpretation.

items.name: 华佗GPT
items.summary_zh: 中文医学语料训练的大型语言模型
orgs: 香港中文大学(深圳)，深圳市大数据研究院
items.summary_en: Large language model trained on Chinese medical corpora (HuaTuoGPT).
orgs_en: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen

items.name: 启真医学大模型 (QiZhenGPT)
items.summary_zh: 中文医疗场景、药品知识问答、优化疾病、手术、检验等
items.summary_en: Chinese clinical QA model for drugs, diseases, procedures, and labs (QiZhenGPT).

items.name: 孙思邈 (Sunsimiao)
items.summary_zh: 孙思邈中文医疗大模型，Sunsimiao-7B 基于 Qwen2-7B 以高质量医疗数据微调，在 CMB-Exam 达 30B 量级 SOTA
items.summary_en: Sunsimiao Chinese medical LLM; Sunsimiao-7B fine-tuned from Qwen2-7B on curated medical data, reaching 30B-level SOTA on CMB-Exam.

items.name: 扁鹊 (BianQue)
items.summary_zh: 中文领域生活空间主动健康大模型
orgs: 华南理工大学，广东省数字孪生人重点实验室
items.summary_en: Chinese proactive health LLM for everyday living spaces (BianQue).
orgs_en: Guangdong Key Laboratory of Digital Twin Humans

items.name: 百川-M1 (Baichuan-M1)
items.summary_zh: 百川智能从零训练的开源医疗大模型（14B），约20万亿token医疗+通用数据，覆盖20+科室；常被后续中医微调当作底座
items.summary_en: Baichuan's from-scratch open medical LLM (14B), trained on ~20T medical+general tokens across 20+ specialties; a common base for later TCM fine-tunes.

items.name: 百川-M2 (Baichuan-M2)
items.summary_zh: 百川第二代开源医疗推理模型（32B，底座Qwen2.5-32B），用大规模验证器与多阶段RL做临床对话对齐，HealthBench开源前列
items.summary_en: Baichuan's second open medical reasoning model (32B on Qwen2.5-32B) with a large verifier system and multi-stage RL; strong open-source HealthBench results.

items.name: 百川-M3 (Baichuan-M3)
items.summary_zh: 百川第三代开源医疗推理模型（235B，底座Qwen3），用SPAR分段RL与事实感知RL做主动问诊和抑幻觉；HealthBench与SCAN-bench开源前列
items.summary_en: Baichuan's third open medical reasoning model (235B on Qwen3) with SPAR staged RL and fact-aware RL for active inquiry and hallucination control; strong HealthBench and SCAN-bench results.

items.name: 华佗GPT-II (HuatuoGPT-II)
items.summary_zh: 中大深圳华佗系列二代，单阶段领域适配；7B/13B以Baichuan2为底座，是中文医疗评测里最常见的开源对照之一
orgs: 香港中文大学(深圳)，深圳市大数据研究院
items.summary_en: Second HuatuoGPT generation with one-stage medical adaptation; 7B/13B use Baichuan2 backbones and remain a standard Chinese medical baseline.
orgs_en: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen

items.name: 华佗GPT-o1 (HuatuoGPT-o1)
items.summary_zh: 华佗系列医疗复杂推理模型，用可验证医题和医学验证器做搜索微调与强化学习。仓库给出 7B、8B 和 70B。
orgs: 香港中文大学(深圳)，深圳市大数据研究院
items.summary_en: HuatuoGPT medical complex-reasoning model trained with verifiable problems and a medical verifier. The repository lists 7B, 8B, and 70B checkpoints.
orgs_en: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen

items.name: 华佗GPT-Vision (HuatuoGPT-Vision)
items.summary_zh: 华佗系列医学多模态模型，大规模注入医学视觉知识，常作中文医学影像/多模态对照
orgs: 香港中文大学(深圳)，深圳市大数据研究院
items.summary_en: HuatuoGPT multimodal medical model that injects visual knowledge at scale; a common Chinese medical vision baseline.
orgs_en: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen

items.name: DISC-MedLLM
items.summary_zh: 复旦DISC实验室的医疗对话大模型，底座Baichuan-13B，配套DISC-Med-SFT；知识图谱+真实问诊重构
items.summary_en: Fudan DISC conversational medical LLM on Baichuan-13B, with DISC-Med-SFT built from knowledge graphs and reconstructed consultations.

items.name: PULSE
items.summary_zh: 上海人工智能实验室 OpenMEDLab 的中文医疗大模型。PULSE-7b 基于 bloomz-7b1-mt，PULSE-20b 基于 InternLM-20B，覆盖医考、报告解读、病历结构化与模拟诊疗。
items.summary_en: OpenMEDLab Chinese medical LLM. PULSE-7b is fine-tuned from bloomz-7b1-mt and PULSE-20b from InternLM-20B, for exams, report reading, record structuring, and simulated diagnosis.

items.name: 卫宁WiNGPT2
items.summary_zh: 卫宁健康开源医疗大模型，底座Qwen，覆盖医学问答、病历理解和多轮问诊，7B/14B可下载
items.summary_en: Winning Health open medical LLM on Qwen for medical QA, record understanding, and multi-turn consults; 7B/14B weights are public.

items.name: 卫宁WiNGPT3
items.summary_zh: 卫宁第三代医疗推理模型（32B，底座Qwen2.5），多阶段SFT+RL与长思维链，对接WiNEX医院流程；技术报告和代码已公开，权重未核验可下载
items.summary_en: Winning Health's third medical reasoning model (32B on Qwen2.5) with multi-stage SFT+RL and WiNEX hospital integration; tech report and code are public, weights are not verified as downloadable.

items.name: 太一 (Taiyi)
items.summary_zh: 大连理工DUTIR的中英双语生物医学大模型，底座Qwen-7B，覆盖问答、医患对话、报告生成与信息抽取等
items.summary_en: DUTIR bilingual biomedical LLM on Qwen-7B for QA, doctor–patient dialogue, report generation, and information extraction (JAMIA 2024).

items.name: 太一2 (Taiyi-2)
items.summary_zh: 太一二代开源生物医学模型，底座从Qwen-7B换成GLM4-9B，重做数据过滤与任务指令。官方模型卡仍引用太一1的JAMIA论文（10.1093/jamia/ocae037），没有单独的太一2论文
items.align_note: 原DOI指向太一1，已从本条移除
items.summary_en: Second Taiyi open biomedical model, moving from Qwen-7B to GLM4-9B with tighter data filters and task instructions. The model card still cites the Taiyi-1 JAMIA paper (10.1093/jamia/ocae037); there is no separate Taiyi-2 paper.

items.name: 麒麟-Med (Qilin-Med)
items.summary_zh: 多阶段知识注入的中文医疗LLM（CPT+SFT+DPO，底座Baichuan-7B），发布约3GB ChiMed语料，可再加RAG。arXiv PDF 署名北京大学、港科大（广州）等
items.summary_en: Multi-stage Chinese medical LLM (CPT+SFT+DPO on Baichuan-7B) releasing the ~3GB ChiMed corpus, optionally with RAG. arXiv PDF authors at Peking University and HKUST (Guangzhou) et al.
orgs_en: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou) et al.

items.name: ChiMed-GPT
items.summary_zh: 中科大等在Ziya-v2上做继续预训练+SFT+RLHF的中文医疗大模型，覆盖抽取、问答与多轮对话
items.summary_en: USTC Chinese medical LLM continued from Ziya-v2 with pretraining, SFT, and RLHF for extraction, QA, and multi-turn dialogue.
orgs_en: University of Science and Technology of China

items.name: Apollo
items.summary_zh: 中大深圳FreedomIntelligence的多语种医疗LLM（含中文），配套ApolloCorpus与XMedBench
orgs: 香港中文大学(深圳)，深圳市大数据研究院
items.summary_en: FreedomIntelligence multilingual medical LLM (including Chinese) with ApolloCorpus and XMedBench.
orgs_en: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen

items.name: DoctorGLM
items.summary_zh: 基于ChatGLM-6B的早期开源中文问诊模型，用多科室医患数据做LoRA/P-Tuning，常出现在2023年中文医疗对照表。arXiv HTML 署名上海科技大学、联影智能、复旦大学华山医院等
items.summary_en: Early open Chinese consultation model on ChatGLM-6B with LoRA/P-Tuning; a frequent 2023 Chinese medical baseline. arXiv HTML authors at ShanghaiTech and United Imaging Intelligence et al.

items.name: MedicalGPT
items.summary_zh: 开源中文医疗LLM训练框架（预训练/SFT/RLHF/DPO），也被大量中医微调实验当作基线实现
items.summary_en: Open training stack for Chinese medical LLMs (pretrain/SFT/RLHF/DPO), often reused as a baseline pipeline in TCM fine-tuning.

items.name: SoulChat
items.summary_zh: 华南理工数字孪生人实验室的心理健康对话大模型，与扁鹊同系列，常作中文医疗/健康对话对照
orgs: 华南理工大学，广东省数字孪生人重点实验室
items.summary_en: SCUT mental-health dialogue LLM from the same lab as BianQue; a common Chinese health-conversation baseline.
orgs_en: Guangdong Key Laboratory of Digital Twin Humans

items.name: CareGPT
items.summary_zh: 开源中文医疗LLM全流程训练框架（预训练到DPO）与配套权重，常被复现中文医疗微调。README 写明由澳门理工大学应用科学学院完成
items.summary_en: Open Chinese medical LLM training stack (pretrain through DPO) with accompanying weights, often used to reproduce Chinese medical fine-tunes. README attributes the work to Macao Polytechnic University.

items.name: 扁鹊-2 (BianQue-2)
items.summary_zh: 扁鹊二代开源医疗问诊模型，强化多轮追问；CMB 等中文医疗评测里的常见对照
orgs: 华南理工大学，广东省数字孪生人重点实验室
items.summary_en: Second BianQue open consultation model with stronger multi-turn questioning; a common CMB baseline.
orgs_en: Guangdong Key Laboratory of Digital Twin Humans

items.name: IvyGPT
items.summary_zh: 基于 LLaMA 的中文医疗问答模型，用高质量医患 QA 与 RLHF 微调，CMB 论文对照列表中的开源基线。arXiv PDF 署名澳门理工大学
items.align_note: 2026-10-21 复核 GitHub 仓库返回 404，论文页仍在
items.summary_en: LLaMA-based Chinese medical QA model fine-tuned with curated clinical QA and RLHF; listed as an open baseline in the CMB paper. arXiv PDF authors at Macao Polytechnic University.

items.name: ChatGLM-Med
items.summary_zh: 哈工大SCIR用中文医学知识图谱指令微调的ChatGLM-6B，与本草/华驼同源数据，CMB常用对照
items.summary_en: HIT-SCIR ChatGLM-6B instruction-tuned on Chinese medical KGs, sharing data lineage with BenCao/HuaTuo; a frequent CMB baseline.

items.name: ClinicalGPT

orgs: International Human Phenome Institutes (Shanghai), Shanghai, China
items.title_zh: HIT 2.0 草药成分靶点库
items.summary_zh: 人工审核的草药成分–靶点活性对（约1237成分/2208靶点），覆盖2000–2020文献；门户可打开，分析后端端口当前不通
items.summary_en: Manually curated herbal-ingredient–target activity pairs (~1,237 ingredients / 2,208 targets, 2000–2020 literature). Portal opens; the analysis backend port is currently down (marked site issue).

items.name: LTM-TCM
items.title_zh: LTM-TCM 中西医分子表型链接库
items.summary_zh: 整合十四个权威库与临床/古籍记录的症状–方剂–植物–成分–靶点平台（约4.8万方）；官网cloud.tasly.com域名已无法解析，核验走论文DOI
items.summary_en: Symptom–prescription–plant–ingredient–target platform linking 14 source databases plus clinical and classical records (~48k formulas). Official Tasly cloud no longer resolves; verify via the paper DOI.

items.name: TCMIO
orgs: Traditional Chinese Medicine Bureau of Guangdong Province
items.title_zh: TCMIO 中医药免疫肿瘤学数据库
items.summary_zh: 面向免疫肿瘤的中药/方剂–成分–靶点–通路库，提供浏览、下载与REST API
items.summary_en: Immuno-oncology TCM database of prescriptions, herbs, ingredients, targets, and pathways, with downloads and a REST API.

items.name: CEMTDD
items.title_zh: CEMTDD 中国少数民族传统药物数据库
items.summary_zh: 以新疆维吾尔/哈萨克等民族药为主的草药–化合物–靶点–疾病库（约621草药）；原域名cemtdd.com已改作他用，核验走PMC论文
items.summary_en: Ethnic-minority herbal–compound–target–disease resource (~621 herbs, mainly Uygur/Kazakh). Original cemtdd.com now hosts something else; verify via the PMC paper.

items.name: YaTCM
items.title_zh: YaTCM 中药方剂–成分–靶点库
items.summary_zh: 约1813首方、6220味药、4.7万天然产物及靶点/通路分析工具；南开官网当前403，核验走开放论文
items.summary_en: About 1,813 prescriptions, 6,220 herbs, and 47k natural products with target/pathway tools. Nankai site currently returns 403; verify via the open-access paper.

items.name: TCMBank
items.title_zh: TCMBank 中药–成分–靶点–疾病库
items.summary_zh: 可下载的大规模中药–成分–靶点–疾病关系库，含文献自动抽取后人工核对的持续更新模块
items.summary_en: Large downloadable herb–ingredient–target–disease resource with literature-mining updates after manual checks.

items.name: ITCM
items.title_zh: ITCM 整合中医药与药效转录组平台
items.summary_zh: 整合多方剂/药材/成分/靶点，并提供496个中药成分的1488条药理转录谱；成分表达数据另见Synapse
items.summary_en: Integrated formula/herb/ingredient/target platform plus 1,488 pharmacotranscriptomic profiles for 496 TCM ingredients (expression data also on Synapse).

items.name: DCABM-TCM
items.title_zh: DCABM-TCM 中药入血成分与代谢物库
items.summary_zh: 文献挖掘的方剂/草药入血原型与代谢物及其检测条件（约1816个有结构入血成分）
items.summary_en: Literature-mined blood constituents and metabolites of TCM prescriptions and herbs, with experimental detection conditions (~1,816 structured absorbed constituents).

items.name: CMAUP
items.title_zh: CMAUP 有用植物集体分子活性库
items.summary_zh: BIDD的有用植物（含中药）多靶点活性、通路与疾病景观库，2024版扩展功能与关联信息，站点可下载
items.summary_en: BIDD landscape of multi-target activities, pathways, and diseases for useful plants including TCM herbs; 2024 update, downloadable from the official site.

items.name: SuperTCM
orgs: Development Research Center of the State Council
items.title_zh: SuperTCM 中药生物文化数据库
items.summary_zh: Charité团队整合药典与多源数据的中药–物种–成分–靶点–通路–疾病库（约6516味药）；官网tcm.charite.de已无法解析
items.summary_en: Charité biocultural TCM resource linking drugs, botanical species, ingredients, targets, KEGG pathways, and diseases (~6,516 drugs). Official tcm.charite.de no longer resolves.

items.name: TCMAnalyzer
items.title_zh: TCMAnalyzer 中药化学信息学分析平台
items.summary_zh: 中山大学RCDD的方剂/药材/成分网络分析与骨架检索服务（约1493方、618味药）；官网rcdd.org.cn当前超时
items.summary_en: RCDD chemo-/bioinformatics service for formula/herb/ingredient networks and scaffold search (~1,493 formulas, 618 herbs). Official rcdd.org.cn currently times out.

items.name: TCM-Mesh
items.title_zh: TCM-Mesh 中药网络药理学分析库
items.summary_zh: 草药–化合物–基因–疾病网络与毒副作用记录（约6235味药）；官网当前403，核验走开放论文
items.summary_en: Herb–compound–gene–disease network with toxicity/side-effect records (~6,235 herbs). Official portal currently returns 403; verify via the open paper.

items.name: TCMGeneDIT
orgs: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University
items.title_zh: TCMGeneDIT 中药–基因–疾病文本挖掘库
items.summary_zh: 从文献挖掘中药、基因、疾病、功效与成分关联，并接入通路与PPI；官网tcm.lifescience.ntu.edu.tw已无法解析
items.summary_en: Text-mined associations among TCM, genes, diseases, effects, and ingredients, with pathway and PPI links. Official NTU site no longer resolves.

items.name: CVDHD
orgs: Beijing National Laboratory for Molecular Sciences
State Key Laboratory of Rare Earth Materials Chemistry and Application
items.title_zh: CVDHD 心血管病本草数据库
items.summary_zh: 面向心血管病的本草化合物三维结构、靶点与通路库，用于虚拟筛选与网络药理；原北大站点当前超时
items.summary_en: Cardiovascular herbal database of 3D compound structures, targets, and pathways for virtual screening and network pharmacology. Original Peking University site currently times out.

items.name: TM-MC
orgs: Korea Research Institute of Bioscience and Biotechnology
items.title_zh: TM-MC 东北亚传统药物成分库
items.summary_zh: 韩国韩医学研究院从文献抽取的东北亚药材–化合物库；2015初版约536种药材，2024的2.0扩到约3.4万化合物；官网当前超时
items.summary_en: KIOM literature-derived Northeast Asian medicinal-material–compound database; the 2015 release covers ~536 materials, and the 2024 2.0 paper expands to ~34k compounds. Official site currently times out.

items.name: CMB
items.title_zh: CMB 中文综合医学评测（Exam + Clin）
items.summary_zh: 中大深圳FreedomIntelligence的中文医疗综合基准：CMB-Exam约28万题+CMB-Clin复杂病案，中医论文里最常见的西医/综合对照榜
items.summary_en: FreedomIntelligence comprehensive Chinese medical benchmark (CMB-Exam ~280k items plus CMB-Clin cases); the most common non-TCM comparison board in TCM LLM papers.

items.name: CMExam
items.title_zh: CMExam 中文执业医师考试评测集
items.summary_zh: 源自国家医学考试的中文医考题（约6.8万），带多维标注，常被中文医疗/中医LLM当知识回忆对照
items.summary_en: Chinese medical licensing-exam set (~68k annotated items) used as a knowledge-recall baseline by Chinese medical and TCM LLMs.

items.name: Huatuo-26M
items.title_zh: Huatuo-26M 大规模中文医疗问答
items.summary_zh: 目前最大的开源中文医疗QA（约2600万对），含百科/图谱/问诊；精简版Huatuo-Lite常被拿来SFT或RAG
items.summary_en: Largest open Chinese medical QA resource (~26M pairs from encyclopedias, KGs, and consults); Huatuo-Lite is the usual SFT/RAG subset.

items.name: PromptCBLUE
items.title_zh: PromptCBLUE 中文医疗NLP指令化评测
items.summary_zh: 把CBLUE的16项中文医疗NLP任务改写成生成式指令，CCKS-2023评测任务，中文医疗LLM早期统一榜之一
items.summary_en: CBLUE's 16 Chinese medical NLP tasks rewritten as generative instructions; an early unified Chinese medical LLM leaderboard (CCKS 2023).

items.name: DISC-Med-SFT
items.title_zh: DISC-Med-SFT 医疗对话指令数据
items.summary_zh: 复旦DISC配套的约47万条医疗对话SFT（图谱三元组+真实问诊重构），不含偏好数据
items.summary_en: Fudan DISC medical-dialogue SFT set (~470k examples from KG triples and reconstructed consults; no preference data).

items.name: ChiMed (Qilin)
items.title_zh: ChiMed 中文医疗多阶段语料（Qilin-Med）
items.summary_zh: Qilin-Med发布的约3GB中文医疗语料（CPT/SFT/DPO），与预训练集ChiMed 2.0不是同一资源
items.summary_en: Qilin-Med's ~3GB Chinese medical corpus (CPT/SFT/DPO); not the same resource as the ChiMed 2.0 pretraining set.

items.name: cMedQA
items.title_zh: cMedQA v1 中文社区医疗问答
items.summary_zh: 从中文健康社区抓取的问答匹配集（仓库表：约 5.4 万问 / 10.2 万答，非商用研究）；论文 DOI 与 README 对得上，后续版本见 cMedQA2
items.summary_en: Chinese community medical QA-matching set (repo table ~54k questions / 102k answers; non-commercial research). Paper DOI matches the README; see cMedQA2 for the later release.

items.name: cMedQA2
items.title_zh: cMedQA2 中文社区医疗问答
items.summary_zh: 中文医疗论坛问答（约10.8万问/20万答），扁鹊语料和后续SFT常把它当作源数据
items.summary_en: Chinese community medical QA (~108k questions / 200k answers), a common source for BianQue-style SFT mixtures.

items.name: MedDialog
items.title_zh: MedDialog 中英医疗对话
items.summary_zh: 大规模医患对话（中文约110万场），中文医疗多轮问诊微调的常用源数据
items.align_note: 2026-10-21 复核 GitHub 仓库返回 404，论文页仍在
items.summary_en: Large doctor–patient dialogue corpus (about 1.1M Chinese encounters) used for multi-turn Chinese medical fine-tuning.

items.name: CMeKG
items.title_zh: CMeKG 中文医学知识图谱
items.summary_zh: 覆盖疾病、药物、症状等的中文医学KG，本草/华驼和ChatGLM-Med的指令数据主要来源；原门户不稳，核验走工具仓
items.summary_en: Chinese medical knowledge graph of diseases, drugs, and symptoms; main source for BenCao/HuaTuo and ChatGLM-Med instruction data. Official portal is unstable; verify via the tools repo.

items.name: CBLUE
items.title_zh: CBLUE 中文生物医学语言理解评测
items.summary_zh: 中文生物医学NLU总榜（NER/关系/诊断归一化/分类等），PromptCBLUE的源任务集；天池有提交入口
items.summary_en: Chinese biomedical NLU benchmark (NER, relations, diagnosis normalization, classification); the source-task suite behind PromptCBLUE, with a Tianchi submission portal.

items.name: IMCS-21
items.title_zh: IMCS-21 智能医疗问诊对话
items.summary_zh: 约4116场儿科在线问诊，带实体/意图/症状/报告标注，后接入CBLUE四任务
items.summary_en: About 4,116 pediatric online consults annotated for entities, intents, symptoms, and reports; later wired into four CBLUE dialogue tasks.

items.name: webMedQA
items.title_zh: webMedQA 在线医疗咨询问答
items.summary_zh: 从健康咨询网站收集的中文非事实型医问（约6.3万问，1正4负答案），早期中文医疗QA常用源
items.summary_en: Early Chinese non-factoid medical QA from health-consult sites (~63k questions, one positive and four negative answers each).

items.name: KNApSAcK KAMPO
orgs: Nara Institute of Science and Technology
items.title_zh: KNApSAcK KAMPO 汉方处方与生药库
items.summary_zh: 奈良先端大整理的汉方公开库（约1581处方、278生药），生命科学数据库档案可下载
items.summary_en: NAIST Kampo public database (~1,581 formulas, 278 crude drugs), downloadable from the NBDC life-science archive.

items.name: Korean Medicine Embedding Dataset
items.title_zh: 韩医领域嵌入对比学习数据
items.summary_zh: 从韩医术语与本体构造的query–positive–negatives（约11.3万对），用于BGE-M3等检索微调
items.summary_en: Query–positive–negatives (~113k pairs) built from Korean-medicine terms and an ontology, for embedding fine-tunes such as BGE-M3.

items.name: OASIS (KIOM)
items.title_zh: OASIS 韩国传统医学信息门户
items.summary_zh: 韩国韩医学研究院的传统医学文献与资源门户，可检索韩医论文与本草资料
items.summary_en: KIOM traditional-medicine literature portal for Korean-medicine papers and herbal resources.

items.name: 儿童流感中成药推荐系统（KG+LLM）
items.summary_zh: 整合权威指南构建儿童流感中成药知识图谱并与LLM集成（JMIR Preprints预印本）
items.summary_en: Knowledge graph of Chinese patent medicines for pediatric influenza built from authoritative guidelines and integrated with an LLM (JMIR Preprints).
items.name_en: Pediatric influenza Chinese patent-medicine recommender (KG + LLM)

items.name: AI驱动中医诊断智能化综述（JTCMS）
items.summary_zh: 综述多模态融合与大模型在中医四诊智能化中的应用、挑战与展望（JTCMS正式发表）
items.venue: Journal of Traditional Chinese Medical Sciences
items.summary_en: Survey on multimodal fusion and LLMs for intelligent four-diagnosis in TCM: applications, challenges and outlook (JTCMS).

items.name: Beyond the Poetic Bard（中医AI翻译评论）
items.summary_zh: 讨论生成式AI翻译中医文本的精确性、认识论与医学语境局限（Translation Review）
items.summary_en: Beyond the Poetic Bard: a perspective on accuracy, epistemology, and medical-context limits of generative-AI translation of TCM texts (Translation Review).

items.name: RAG+LoRA 中医执照考试推理架构
items.summary_zh: RAG+LoRA生成式架构，构建台湾中医师执照考试11,476题（2005–2025）数据集，准确率61.0%→89.0%+（Future Internet）
items.summary_en: RAG+LoRA generative architecture with an 11,476-item Taiwan TCM licensing-exam dataset (2005-2025), raising accuracy from 61.0% to 89.0%+ (Future Internet, MDPI).

items.name: 从大语言模型到智能体（兰州大学学报医学版综述）
items.summary_zh: 以「大模型→智能体」演进为主线的中医临床辅助诊疗中文系统综述，梳理研究进展、关键问题与方向（兰州大学学报(医学版) 2026;52(4):49-57）
items.summary_en: Chinese-language systematic review organized around the LLM-to-agent transition for TCM clinical assisted diagnosis and treatment (J. Lanzhou Univ. Med. Sci. 2026;52(4):49-57).

items.name: 人工智能驱动下的中医智能诊疗研究进展与挑战
items.summary_zh: 以中医辨治六步程式为骨架的全链路（四诊-辨证-处方-疗效预测）中文综述，对照监督/无监督/强化/深度学习范式（上海中医药杂志 2026;60(1)）
items.summary_en: Chinese review structured on the six-step TCM diagnosis-treatment chain (four diagnoses, pattern differentiation, prescription, outcome prediction), contrasting supervised/unsupervised/RL/deep-learning paradigms (Shanghai J. TCM 2026;60(1)).

items.name: 多模态大模型驱动舌脉面诊智能化综述（Springer 书章）
items.summary_zh: 唯一以「多模态LLM×四诊感知」为题的综述性文本，覆盖舌/脉/面诊智能化（Springer CCIS 会议书章，评审强度低于期刊）
items.venue: Communications in Computer and Information Science (Springer)
orgs: University of Chinese Academy of Social Sciences
items.summary_en: The only review text dedicated to multimodal-LLM-driven tongue, pulse, and facial diagnosis in TCM (Springer CCIS book chapter; weaker peer review than journals).

items.name: AI in TCM: Unraveling Herbal Medicine's Mechanisms（Research）
items.summary_zh: 主张AI从相关分析范式走向重建证候辨证与方剂配伍生物逻辑的药材机制中心宽口径综述（Research 2026;9:1224）
items.summary_en: Broad AI-in-TCM review arguing AI should move beyond correlational analysis toward reconstructing the biological logic of syndrome differentiation and formula compatibility (Research 2026;9:1224).

items.name: Deep learning in TCM（J Integr Med）
items.summary_zh: 深度学习单技术线综述：医学影像、药材物质研究、数据挖掘等应用实例（J Integr Med 2026;24(4):471-480）
items.summary_en: Single-technology review of deep learning in TCM: medical imaging, herbal material research, data mining (J. Integr. Med. 2026;24(4):471-480).

items.name: The integration of machine learning into TCM（J Pharm Anal）
items.summary_zh: 机器学习×中医整合综述：诊断客观化与机制阐释两条线（J Pharm Anal 2025;15(8):101157）
items.summary_en: Review of machine-learning integration into TCM along diagnostic objectification and mechanism-elucidation lines (J. Pharm. Anal. 2025;15(8):101157).

items.name: 古籍知识图谱×多智能体融合综述（Chin Med）
items.summary_zh: 古籍KG构建（术语统一、数据标准化）挑战-展望型综述，首次把multi-agent写入中医古籍议题（Chin Med 2025;20:168）
items.summary_en: Challenges-and-prospects review of knowledge-graph construction over ancient TCM classics, first to frame multi-agent convergence in this area (Chin. Med. 2025;20:168).

items.name: AI empowers the innovation of TCM（J Integr Med 评论）
items.summary_zh: 单作者评论性综述：古籍挖掘、诊疗标准化、药物研发周期三痛点×AI（J Integr Med 2026）
items.summary_en: Single-author perspective on AI for TCM innovation: classics mining, diagnosis standardization, drug R&D cycles (J. Integr. Med. 2026).

items.name: AI and Big Data in TCM Standardization and Internationalization（Chin Med Cult）
items.summary_zh: 谈人工智能和大数据怎样帮助中医做标准化、走到国际上去。刊在 Chinese Medicine and Culture 2026 年第 9 卷第 3 期。
items.summary_en: An essay on how AI and big data can help standardize traditional Chinese medicine and carry it abroad. Chinese Medicine and Culture, 2026, volume 9, issue 3.

items.name: AI for Spleen-Stomach Disorders in TCM（Curr Med Sci）
items.summary_zh: 单病种（脾胃病）KG+智能诊疗综述：「症状-证候-疾病-方剂」框架的知识工程化（Curr Med Sci 2025;45(6):1348-1357）
orgs: Hubei Provincial Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine
items.summary_en: Single-disease-area (spleen-stomach) review of KG plus intelligent diagnosis/treatment with a symptom-syndrome-disease-formula framework (Curr. Med. Sci. 2025;45(6)).

items.name: 人工智能赋能中医数字化诊断：现状与挑战（中华中医药学刊）
items.summary_zh: 短文，写人工智能在中医数字化诊断里能做什么，也写了数据质量、说得清说不清、以及和中医理论怎么接上。刊在《中华中医药学刊》。
items.summary_en: A short essay on what AI can do for digital TCM diagnosis, and on data quality, explanations, and joining the models to TCM theory. Published in Chinese Archives of Traditional Chinese Medicine.

items.name: 人工智能实现中医四诊的发展现状、问题及解决路径（中华中医药学刊）
items.summary_zh: 写人工智能做中医四诊现在走到哪、卡在哪。面舌采集、电子鼻、脉象传感和四诊合在一起看，都还比较弱。刊在《中华中医药学刊》。
items.summary_en: On where AI stands in the four TCM examinations, and where it gets stuck: face and tongue capture, electronic noses, pulse sensors, and putting the four together. Published in Chinese Archives of Traditional Chinese Medicine.

items.name: Intelligent Question-Answering Systems in Healthcare（Healthcare，邻近）
items.summary_zh: 2018-2025医疗QA综述+CiteSpace计量，明确含中医方剂开发应用场景（邻近综述，非TCM专用）
items.summary_en: Adjacent review (not TCM-specific): 2018-2025 healthcare QA survey with CiteSpace bibliometrics, explicitly covering TCM formula-development scenarios (Healthcare 2025).

items.name: 医疗领域的大型语言模型综述（智能系统学报，邻近）
items.summary_zh: 中文医疗LLM通用综述（训练流程/策略/场景/挑战），与中医LLM综述圈属母子集关系（邻近）
items.summary_en: Adjacent Chinese general survey of medical LLMs (training pipeline, strategies, scenarios, challenges), a superset-context reference for TCM LLM surveys.

items.name: 医学大语言模型的研发与应用系统综述（智能系统学报，邻近）
items.summary_zh: 系统综述129个医学专用LLM（截至2024-06）+4类临床应用研究；系统检索协议方法学可比（邻近）
items.summary_en: Adjacent systematic review of 129 medical-domain LLMs (to 2024-06) and four clinical application categories; methodologically comparable search protocol.

items.name: LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems for Clinical Workflows（ACL 2026，邻近）
items.summary_zh: 工作流级多智能体综述+四层评测栈（safety/process/outcome/operations）；无TCM交集但过程评测主张方法学同构（邻近）
items.summary_en: Adjacent ACL 2026 survey of workflow-level multi-agent clinical systems with a four-layer evaluation stack; no TCM coverage but methodologically isomorphic process-evaluation claims.

items.name: 仲景（CMtMedQA 线，Yang et al.）

items.summary_en: Closed loop of LLM generation and knowledge-graph completion for TCM QA (published, not granted).
items.name_en: Building a TCM QA system from a large language model and a knowledge graph

items.name: 一种基于AI大模型的中医处方智能推荐方法和系统
items.summary_zh: 用病历训练 AI 大模型生成个性化中药处方，并接到医院信息系统（公开，未授权）
items.summary_en: Trains an AI large model on medical records to recommend personalized TCM prescriptions, wired into a hospital IS (published, not granted).
items.name_en: AI-large-model system for intelligent TCM prescription recommendation

items.name: 基于长文档检索增强生成的中医问答方法、设备及介质
items.summary_zh: 长文档 RAG（扩展、召回、重排序、来源标注）做中医问答（2024.07 授权；申请公布日 2024-04-05）
items.summary_en: Long-document RAG (expansion, recall, reranking, source citations) for TCM QA (granted July 2024).
items.name_en: Long-document retrieval-augmented generation for TCM question answering

items.name: 广医·岐智
items.summary_zh: **广医·岐智**是中国中医科学院广安门医院的中医医疗服务大模型，支持导诊、预问诊、病历生成和辨证方剂建议，2.0增加智能体医生，并已完成算法备案。
orgs: 中国中医科学院广安门医院
items.summary_en: Guangyi Qizhi is Guang'anmen Hospital's TCM service model for triage, pre-consultation, charting, and syndrome-formula advice; version 2.0 adds an agent doctor and the system has completed algorithm filing.

items.name: 数智岐黄
items.summary_zh: **数智岐黄**由华东师范大学联合上海中医药大学等研发，1.0提供中医药问答、健康咨询和知识图谱交互，2.0升级为覆盖中西药数据的多模态大模型。
items.summary_en: Shuzhi Qihuang is a TCM model from East China Normal University and partner institutes; version 1.0 offers QA and knowledge-graph interaction, and version 2.0 extends it to multimodal Chinese and Western medicine data.

items.name: 数智本草
items.summary_zh: **数智本草**是天士力与华为云基于盘古语言大模型和盘古药物分子大模型开发的中医药双模态模型，用古籍、方剂和文献支持问答、分子计算与中药研发筛选。
items.summary_en: Shuzhi Bencao is Tasly and Huawei Cloud's dual language-and-molecule TCM model, built on Pangu, for classic-text QA, molecular computation, and herbal R&D screening.

items.name: 天河·灵枢
items.summary_zh: **天河·灵枢**由国家超算天津中心联合天津中医药大学等研发，1.0面向针灸并配三维穴位数字人，2.0把覆盖范围扩到20余个临床学科。
orgs: 国家超级计算天津中心
现代中医药海河实验室
items.summary_en: Tianhe Lingshu is a TCM model from the National Supercomputing Center in Tianjin and Tianjin University of Traditional Chinese Medicine; version 1.0 targets acupuncture with a 3D acupoint avatar, and version 2.0 covers more than 20 clinical specialties.

items.name: 任度·素问
items.summary_zh: **任度·素问**是传神语联基于任度大模型和自研 moH 混合熵架构的中医模型，提供主动问诊、辨证和方剂建议，并通过信通院中医药大模型 4+ 级评估。
items.summary_en: Rendu Suwen is Transn's TCM model on its Rendu base and moH architecture, offering proactive consultation, syndrome analysis, and formula suggestions, and it passed CAICT's TCM large-model evaluation at level 4+.

items.name: 大医金匮
items.summary_zh: **大医金匮**是中科闻歌与中国中医科学院联合打造的中医大模型，学习典籍与临床医案，用于辨证推理、治疗方案生成和四诊健康管理。
items.summary_en: Dayi Jingui is a TCM model jointly built by Wenge and the China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences for syndrome reasoning, treatment planning, and four-diagnostic health management.

items.name: 仲思
items.summary_zh: **仲思**是招联消费金融联合中山大学、广州中医药大学深圳医院发布的中医垂直大模型，覆盖知识问答、问诊病历生成和方剂推荐，并在深圳社康场景使用。
orgs: 广州中医药大学深圳医院
items.summary_en: Zhongsi is a vertical TCM model released by Merchants Union Consumer Finance with Sun Yat-sen University and Shenzhen Hospital of Guangzhou University of Chinese Medicine for QA, consultation notes, and formula suggestions in community clinics.

items.name: 薪火中国药
items.summary_zh: **薪火中国药**是北京中医药大学牵头建设的中医药教育大模型，覆盖助学、助教、助研、助管和对外传播，并于2026年通过生成式人工智能服务备案。
items.summary_en: Xinhuo Zhongguoyao is an education TCM model led by Beijing University of Chinese Medicine for study, teaching, research, administration, and international communication, and it received generative-AI service filing in 2026.

items.name: 岐元
items.summary_zh: **岐元**是上海中医药大学附属第七人民医院的中医垂类大模型，采用预训练、领域微调和专家强化学习，支持生成式病历和名老中医 Agent 数字孪生。
orgs: 上海中医药大学附属第七人民医院
items.summary_en: Qiyuan is the Seventh People's Hospital of Shanghai's TCM model, trained with pretraining, domain fine-tuning, and expert reinforcement learning, for generative records and famous-doctor agent twins.

items.name: 华族本草
items.summary_zh: **华族本草**是贵州医科大学中药全国重点实验室牵头的民族药大模型，以数智岐黄和 Qwen 为底座，融合多民族医药古籍与知识图谱，覆盖成分筛选、配伍、质控和教学。
orgs: 中药功效成分发掘与利用全国重点实验室
items.summary_en: Huazu Bencao is an ethnic-medicine model led by Guizhou Medical University, using Shuzhi Qihuang and Qwen to connect multi-ethnic classics and a knowledge graph across ingredient screening, formulation, quality control, and teaching.

items.name: 砭石云中医
items.summary_zh: **砭石云中医**是智慧眼基于已备案砭石多模态大模型的中医方案，用症状到方药的知识图谱支持四诊采集和辅助辨证。
items.summary_en: Bianshi Yun Zhongyi is Wisdom Eye's TCM application on its filed multimodal Bianshi model, using a symptom-to-formula knowledge graph for four-diagnostic capture and decision support.

items.name: 众星·长白岐黄
items.summary_zh: **众星·长白岐黄**是长春中医药大学、吉林工商学院等联合研发的多模态中医药推理大模型，设有家庭健康助手和吉派中医医生助手两个入口。
items.summary_en: Zhongxing Changbai Qihuang is a multimodal reasoning TCM model from Changchun University of Chinese Medicine and partner universities, with a family health assistant and a Jipai doctor assistant.

items.name: 伊尹中医经典大模型
items.summary_zh: **伊尹中医经典大模型**由中医在线用医典和经方经验训练，在问诊中展示辨证思路，并在嵩县基层医疗机构提供辅助诊疗。
items.summary_en: The Yiyin classic TCM model from Zhongyi Online is trained on medical canons and classical prescriptions, shows its syndrome-reasoning steps, and supports primary-care clinics in Song County.

items.name: 固生堂中医大脑
items.summary_zh: **固生堂中医大脑**把国医 AI 分身接入医院信息系统，在病情采集、病历生成、辅助辨证和开方环节给出可溯源的名医思路。
items.summary_en: Gushengtang TCM Brain connects national-physician AI avatars to the hospital information system for history taking, record drafting, syndrome support, and prescription support with traceable rationale.

items.name: 岐黄问道
items.summary_zh: **岐黄问道**是南京大经中医发布的中医垂直大模型，基于千万级知识图谱和临床数据，面向医疗机构做辨证、处方和养生建议。
orgs: 南京大经中医药信息技术有限公司
items.summary_en: Qihuang Wendao is Nanjing Dajing TCM's vertical model, using a large TCM knowledge graph and clinical data for syndrome diagnosis, prescriptions, and regimen advice in medical institutions.

items.name: 智赋岐黄天功
items.summary_zh: **智赋岐黄天功**是智赋岐黄与哈尔滨工业大学联合研发的中医大模型，用医案和名医验方训练多种辨证体系，作为四诊仪体质辨识的算法底座并已完成算法备案。
items.summary_en: Zhifu Qihuang Tiangong is a TCM model from Zhifu Qihuang and Harbin Institute of Technology, trained on cases and famous-doctor formulas for several syndrome systems, and it backs four-diagnostic constitution reports under algorithm filing.

items.name: 张仲景中医药大模型
items.summary_zh: **张仲景中医药大模型**由河南中医药大学与北京科技大学等联合发布，覆盖智能辨证、证素推荐、经方应用和方药分析，并接入临床辅助诊疗。
items.summary_en: The Zhang Zhongjing TCM model, released by Henan University of Chinese Medicine and the University of Science and Technology Beijing, covers syndrome differentiation, syndrome-element recommendation, classical formulas, and formula analysis for clinical decision support.

items.name: 中医横琴 (Hengqin-R1)
items.summary_zh: **中医横琴（Hengqin-R1）**是中医药广东省实验室的垂类推理大模型，融合精调、强化学习与知识图谱，支撑辨证、中西药联用智能体和四诊客观化。
orgs: 中医药广东省实验室（横琴实验室）
items.summary_en: Hengqin-R1 is the Guangdong Provincial Laboratory of TCM's vertical reasoning model, combining fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and a knowledge graph for syndrome reasoning, combined Chinese-Western medication agents, and objective four diagnostics.

items.name: 古今医案云平台
items.title_zh: 古今医案云平台
items.summary_zh: 中国中医科学院中医药信息研究所的医案检索、结构化与挖掘平台。该所2026年9月20日新闻写明，现行资源已形成110余万条高质量结构化古今医案，另有1963万条科研分析数据，注册用户约5.3万人。需注册或机构登录，未见公开批量下载。部分院校试用页仍写约50万条，与这一口径不同。
orgs: 中国中医科学院中医药信息研究所
items.summary_en: Case search, structuring, and mining platform of the Institute of Information on Traditional Chinese Medicine, China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences. An institute news item on 2026-09-20 states that the current resource holds more than 1.1 million structured historical and modern cases, plus 19.63 million analysis records, with about 53,000 registered users. Registration or institutional login is required, and no public bulk download was found. Some campus trial notes still say about 500,000 cases.

items.name: 中医药知识服务平台
items.title_zh: 中医药知识服务平台
items.summary_zh: 中国中医科学院中医药信息研究所维护的知识服务首页，面向知识检索、知识图谱和疾病画像。同一信息所的中医学专业知识服务系统关于页写明，2019年起受中国工程科技知识中心委托建设专业知识服务，汇聚病证、方剂、中药与文献资源。首页可打开；高校试用说明要求校园网注册登录，未见公开批量下载。
orgs: 中国中医科学院中医药信息研究所
items.summary_en: Knowledge-service homepage maintained by the Institute of Information on Traditional Chinese Medicine, CACMS, for search, knowledge graphs, and disease profiles. A related about page from the same institute says that, starting in 2019, it built a professional TCM knowledge service for the China Knowledge Centre for Engineering Sciences and Technology, bringing together diseases, formulas, herbs, and literature. The homepage opens; campus trial notes require registration on an institutional network, and no public bulk download was found.

items.name: 国医典藏
items.section: 原始书籍 / 预训练语料
items.title_zh: 国医典藏（中国中医古籍数字资源库）
items.summary_zh: 中国中医科学院中医药信息研究所/图书馆的中医古籍图文库，现行入口为第4版站点。公开介绍收录先秦至清末民国医药典籍，可见口径为2500余种至3000余种，支持基本、高级和后控检索以及图文对照。校园网或注册查阅，不是公开批量下载。
orgs: 中国中医科学院中医药信息研究所
中国中医科学院图书馆
items.summary_en: Image-and-text library of historical Chinese medical books from the Institute of Information on Traditional Chinese Medicine and its library, CACMS. The current entry is the version-4 site. Public descriptions put the holdings at roughly 2,500 to 3,000 titles from pre-Qin through the late Qing and Republican periods, with basic, advanced, and controlled-vocabulary search and image-text viewing. Access is by campus network or registration, not a public bulk download.

items.name: 中华医典
items.section: 原始书籍 / 预训练语料
items.title_zh: 中华医典（商业电子丛书，第6版为网页版）
items.summary_zh: 商业电子丛书《中华医典》的现行销售站（飞熊科技）。站点写明收录古籍1156部、约4.5亿字，2000年获得国家电子出版物提名奖，裘沛然编审并题名。第6版是网页版，购买注册后使用，不是公开下载。
items.summary_en: Commercial sales site (Feixiong Technology) for the Zhonghua Yidian electronic collection. The site states 1,156 classical titles and about 450 million characters, a 2000 national electronic-publication nomination, and Qiu Peiran as editorial reviewer and title writer. Edition 6 is a web version used after purchase and registration, not a public download.

items.name: 国家中医药古籍数字图书馆
items.section: 原始书籍 / 预训练语料
items.title_zh: 国家中医药古籍数字图书馆
items.summary_zh: 中国中医科学院中医药信息研究所自2022年起建设的古籍与传统知识发布门户，设古典医籍、民国文献、版本目录等分馆，并链出国医典藏等阅读系统。门户页可打开；读全文需进入分馆，不是公开批量下载。
orgs: 中国中医科学院中医药信息研究所
items.summary_en: Ancient-book and traditional-knowledge portal started in 2022 by the Institute of Information on Traditional Chinese Medicine, CACMS. It has halls for classical texts, Republican-era documents, and bibliographic catalogs, and links out to reading systems including Guoyi Diancang. The portal opens; full text is reached through the sub-libraries and is not a public bulk download.

items.name: ICD-11传统医学章节
items.title_zh: ICD-11 传统医学病情补充章
items.summary_zh: WHO 对 ICD-11 补充章 Traditional Medicine Conditions 的官方说明。该章用于发病数据的可选双编码，不用于死亡报告。当前模块 I 覆盖源于古代中国、现用于中国、日本、韩国及其他地区的传统医学病情。本页是章节说明，具体编码在 ICD-11 浏览器中查阅，页面公开。
items.summary_en: Official WHO explanation of the ICD-11 supplementary chapter Traditional Medicine Conditions. The chapter is for optional dual coding of morbidity and is not used for mortality. Module I covers traditional-medicine conditions that originated in ancient China and are now used in China, Japan, Korea, and elsewhere. This page explains the chapter; the codes themselves are read in the ICD-11 browser. The page is public.

items.name: WHO西太区标准穴位定位
items.title_zh: WHO 西太平洋区标准针灸穴位定位
items.summary_zh: WHO 西太平洋区办事处2008年出版、2009年重印的穴位定位标准。IRIS 记录写明包含体表定位方法和361个穴位，用于教学、科研、临床、出版和学术交流，并提供英文 PDF。中国、日本、韩国专家参与定位协调。记录页公开。
orgs: 世界卫生组织西太平洋区办事处
items.summary_en: WHO Regional Office for the Western Pacific standard for acupuncture point locations, published in 2008 and reprinted in 2009. The IRIS record states the surface-location method and 361 points for teaching, research, clinical service, publication, and academic exchange, and provides the English PDF. Experts from China, Japan, and Korea joined the location consensus. The record page is public.

items.name: GB/T 12346-2021
items.title_zh: 经穴名称与定位
items.summary_zh: 现行国家标准《经穴名称与定位》，2021年11月26日发布并实施，主管部门为国家中医药局。国家标准全文公开系统提供在线预览和下载。这是标准全文页，不是单独打包的穴位词表。
orgs: 国家标准化管理委员会
items.summary_en: Current Chinese national standard Nomenclature and location of meridian points, issued and effective on 26 November 2021, under the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine. The official full-text disclosure system offers online preview and download. This is the standard page, not a separately packaged acupoint table.

items.name: GB/T 15657-2021
items.title_zh: 中医病证分类与代码
items.summary_zh: 现行国家标准《中医病证分类与代码》，2021年10月11日发布并实施，替代 GB/T 15657-1995，主管部门为国家中医药局。国家标准全文公开系统提供在线预览和下载。这是标准全文页，不是独立的机器可读代码包。
orgs: 国家标准化管理委员会
items.summary_en: Current Chinese national standard Classification and codes of diseases and patterns of traditional Chinese medicine, issued and effective on 11 October 2021, replacing GB/T 15657-1995, under the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine. The official full-text disclosure system offers online preview and download. This is the standard page, not a standalone machine-readable code package.

items.name: GB/T 16751.1-2023
items.title_zh: 中医临床诊疗术语 第1部分：疾病
items.summary_zh: 现行国家标准《中医临床诊疗术语 第1部分：疾病》，2023年3月17日发布并实施，主管部门为国家中医药局。国家标准全文公开系统提供在线预览和下载。证候部分和治法部分另有独立全文页。
orgs: 国家标准化管理委员会
items.summary_en: Current national standard Clinic terminology of traditional Chinese medical diagnosis and treatment — Part 1: Diseases, issued and effective on 17 March 2023, under the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine. The official full-text disclosure system offers online preview and download. Syndrome and therapeutic-method parts have their own full-text pages.

items.name: GB/T 16751.2-2021
items.title_zh: 中医临床诊疗术语 第2部分：证候
items.summary_zh: 现行国家标准《中医临床诊疗术语 第2部分：证候》，2021年11月26日发布并实施。国家标准全文公开系统提供在线预览和下载。这是证候术语标准页，不是独立词表数据包。
orgs: 国家标准化管理委员会
items.summary_en: Current national standard Clinic terminology of traditional Chinese medical diagnosis and treatment — Part 2: Syndromes/patterns, issued and effective on 26 November 2021. The official full-text disclosure system offers online preview and download. This is the syndrome-terminology standard page, not a separate vocabulary dump.

items.name: GB/T 16751.3-2023
items.title_zh: 中医临床诊疗术语 第3部分：治法
items.summary_zh: 现行国家标准《中医临床诊疗术语 第3部分：治法》，2023年3月17日发布并实施。国家标准全文公开系统提供在线预览和下载。这是治法术语标准页，不是独立词表数据包。
orgs: 国家标准化管理委员会
items.summary_en: Current national standard Clinic terminology of traditional Chinese medical diagnosis and treatment — Part 3: Therapeutic methods, issued and effective on 17 March 2023. The official full-text disclosure system offers online preview and download. This is the therapeutic-method standard page, not a separate vocabulary dump.

items.name: SoFDA
items.title_zh: 中医证候本体与疾病–证候–方剂关联平台
items.summary_zh: 中国中医科学院中药研究所等建设的证候本体平台。iMeta 2023论文写明整理319个证候、8045种疾病和1359首方剂，并关联基因、疾病与方剂。论文页可核；前台页面当前没有可读的证候内容。与 ETCM 同在 tcmip.cn，但是独立证候系统。未见免登录的整库镜像。
orgs: 中国中医科学院中药研究所
中国中医科学院广安门医院
items.summary_en: Syndrome-ontology platform built by the Institute of Chinese Materia Medica, CACMS, and collaborators. The iMeta 2023 paper describes 319 curated syndromes, 8,045 diseases, and 1,359 formulas, linked to genes, diseases, and formulas. The paper page checks out; the front page currently shows no readable syndrome content. It shares the tcmip.cn host with ETCM but is a separate syndrome system. No anonymous full-database mirror was found.

items.name: 本草典开放数据
items.title_zh: 本草典开放数据（本草、方剂、证型、腧穴）
items.summary_zh: 本草典编辑部发布的双语中医药种子数据，CC BY-SA 4.0，可直接下载 JSON。2026年4月17日生成的 v1 写明本草365条、方剂112条、证型84条、腧穴208条，另有经络、舌脉和关系图谱。同一页的覆盖说明写标准本草约530味中已收335味。这是编辑项目词表，不是国家标准。
items.summary_en: Bilingual TCM seed data from the Bencao Dian editorial group, released under CC BY-SA 4.0 as directly downloadable JSON. Version 1, generated on 17 April 2026, lists 365 herb records, 112 formulas, 84 patterns, and 208 acupoints, plus meridians, tongue and pulse entries, and a relation graph. A coverage note on the same page says 335 of about 530 standard materia medica items are included. This is an editorial vocabulary, not a national standard.

items.name: TCMPG 2.0
items.title_zh: 中药植物基因组数据库 2.0
items.summary_zh: 成都中医药大学等维护的中药植物基因组库。现行首页写明274种植物、324个基因组、414味药材和13809个成分，并提供 BLAST、JBrowse 等工具。2024年论文描述 2.0 升级。站点可浏览和分析；本次未核到整库打包下载。
items.summary_en: Traditional Chinese medicine plant-genome database maintained by Chengdu University of Traditional Chinese Medicine and collaborators. The current homepage lists 274 plants, 324 genomes, 414 herbs, and 13,809 ingredients, with BLAST, JBrowse, and other tools. A 2024 paper describes the 2.0 upgrade. The site is open for browsing and analysis; a full packaged dump was not verified.

items.name: TCMSSD
items.title_zh: 中医证候标准化数据库
items.summary_zh: 浙江中医药大学作者发表的证候标准化综合库。论文报告624个证候、133518首方剂、8073种疾病、8259味中药、43413个成分和17602个靶点。站点可打开，前端脚本含证候与 TCMSSD 内容；未启用脚本时页面为空。本次未看到整库下载入口。
items.summary_en: Syndrome-standardization database reported by authors at Zhejiang Chinese Medical University. The paper reports 624 syndromes, 133,518 prescriptions, 8,073 diseases, 8,259 herbs, 43,413 ingredients, and 17,602 targets. The site opens and its front-end script contains syndrome and TCMSSD content; without JavaScript the page is empty. No full-database download entry was found.

items.name: 中药材图像数据库
items.title_zh: 香港浸会大学中药材图像数据库
items.summary_zh: 香港浸会大学中医药学院的中药材图像库。图书馆页面写明收录常用中药材420余种，包括来源、产地、性状、性味功效和高清图像，可按中文名、拉丁名和英文名检索。2013年上线，可公开在线浏览，不是批量下载包。
orgs: 香港浸会大学中医药学院
items.summary_en: Chinese medicinal-material image library from the School of Chinese Medicine, Hong Kong Baptist University. The library page states more than 420 commonly used crude drugs, with source, origin, morphology, properties, indications, and high-resolution images, searchable by Chinese, Latin, and English names. It has been online since 2013 and is openly browsable, not a bulk download.

items.name: 中药方剂图像数据库
items.title_zh: 香港浸会大学中药方剂图像数据库
items.summary_zh: 香港浸会大学中医药学院的方剂图像库，公开浏览方剂组成、功用、主治和图像。浏览页显示约182首，访问计数自2017年11月起。在线查阅，不是方剂表批量下载。
orgs: 香港浸会大学中医药学院
items.summary_en: Formula image library from the School of Chinese Medicine, Hong Kong Baptist University, openly browsing composition, actions, indications, and images. The browse page shows about 182 formulas, and the public counter starts in November 2017. It is an online reference, not a bulk formula-table download.

items.name: TradMPD
items.summary_zh: 富山大学和汉医药学综合研究所的传统医药数据库。英文说明页写明由文部科学省区域创新集群计划于2008–2012年资助，收录生药基原、性味归经与汉方组成、适应及文献；处方文献一万余篇。和汉药实验文库含近80个化合物，以及80种生药热水提取物和80个汉方提取物的化学与生物测定，2024年起提供生物测定下载。
items.summary_en: Traditional Medical and Pharmaceutical Database at the University of Toyama Institute of Natural Medicine. The English about page says it was supported by a MEXT regional innovation cluster grant for 2008–2012. It covers crude-drug identity, properties, Kampo composition and indications, and more than 10,000 Kampo papers. The Wakanyaku Library holds nearly 80 compounds plus chemical and bioassay data for hot-water extracts of 80 crude drugs and 80 Kampo extracts, with bioassay downloads from 2024.

items.name: KampoDB
items.summary_zh: 富山大学和汉医药学综合研究所维护的汉方作用机制库，整合处方、生药、天然化合物与靶蛋白，含已知相互作用和对接预测。关于页当前统计为汉方298首、生药180种、天然化合物3002个、蛋白或基因62906个、对接结果3063505条。2018年 Scientific Reports 论文为首篇描述；站点新闻写明2021年7月15日改版。
items.summary_en: Kampo mechanism database maintained by the Institute of Natural Medicine, University of Toyama. It links formulas, crude drugs, natural compounds, and target proteins, including known interactions and docking predictions. The about page currently lists 298 Kampo formulas, 180 crude drugs, 3,002 natural compounds, 62,906 proteins or genes, and 3,063,505 docking results. The 2018 Scientific Reports paper is the citation; the site news records a renewal on 15 July 2021.

items.name: 药用植物综合信息数据库 (MPDB)
items.summary_zh: 医薬基盤·健康·营养研究所药用植物资源研究中心的汉方与生药综合图鉴。首页写明收录药用植物、生药、成分与基因、栽培和内部形态，并对国内流通的模型生药做了实测；页脚版权为2012–2025，资助来自厚生劳动科学研究费。另有可打开的汉方处方列表和日本药局方收载生药列表。
orgs: National Institutes of Biomedical Innovation, Health and Nutrition
Research Center for Medicinal Plant Resources
items.summary_en: Comprehensive medicinal-plant database of the NIBIOHN Research Center for Medicinal Plant Resources. The home page describes medicinal plants, crude drugs, constituents and genes, cultivation, and internal morphology, plus measured data for representative crude drugs in Japanese circulation. The footer copyright is 2012–2025, funded by a MHLW research grant. Separate Kampo-formula and Japanese Pharmacopoeia crude-drug lists are online.

items.name: EKAT
items.summary_zh: 日本东洋医学会EBM委员会的汉方治疗证据报告。官网写明2007年起免费公开并持续更新，把在售汉方制剂的随机对照试验和荟萃分析做成结构化摘要；煎剂因品质不明不收，试验限于1986年以后、与市售制剂同品质者。有日文版和英文版，大韩韩医学会另有韩语译本。
items.summary_en: Evidence Reports of Kampo Treatment, a structured-abstract database from the Japan Society for Oriental Medicine EBM committee. The site says it has been free and updated since 2007. It covers RCTs and meta-analyses of Kampo products still on the market, limited to reports since 1986 that used the same quality as marketed products; decoctions are excluded because product quality is unknown. Japanese and English editions are provided, and the Association of Korean Medicine has a Korean translation.

items.name: ETHMEDmmm
items.summary_zh: 富山大学和汉医药学综合研究所民族药物资料馆的生药标本库。首页表格写明和汉药461种、8942点，日文公开始于2000年4月；同站另有英文和汉药以及尤纳尼、泰药、阿育吠陀、印度尼西亚生药分库。最终更新说明为2018年3月30日的第7版。
items.summary_en: Ethnomedicine specimen database of the Museum of Materia Medica at the University of Toyama. The home-page table lists 461 kinds and 8,942 Japanese–Chinese crude-drug specimens, opened in Japanese in April 2000. The same site also has an English crude-drug list and separate Unani, Thai, Ayurvedic, and Indonesian collections. The latest note is a version-7 rebuild on 30 March 2018.

items.name: KTKP Traditional Medicine
items.summary_zh: 韩国知识产权部的传统知识门户中的韩医部分。英文介绍写明数据库于2005–2007年以韩国传统医学文献编成，2007年12月开始检索服务。介绍页当前结构计数为药材5500、处方7103、病证12500，并关联功效、主治、方药和专利分类号。
orgs: Korea Institute of Science and Technology Information
items.summary_en: Korean-medicine slice of the Korean Traditional Knowledge Portal, run for the Ministry of Intellectual Property. The English introduction says the database was compiled from traditional Korean medicine literature in 2005–2007 and opened for search in December 2007. The same page currently counts 5,500 herbs, 7,103 prescriptions, and 12,500 diseases, linked to effects, indications, formulas, and patent classes.

items.name: 韩医药素材银行药材目录 (KMMB)
items.summary_zh: 韩国韩医药振兴院韩医药素材银行的在库药材检索。打开的药材页写明检索结果共691条，字段有药材名、异名、学名、基原植物和反应酶。振兴院事业文件记载2016年1月1日由天然物物质银行与韩方生物素材银行合并为本事业。
orgs: National Institute for Korean Medicine Development
items.summary_en: Searchable crude-drug holdings of the Korean Medicine Material Bank at the National Institute for Korean Medicine Development. The open herb page reports 691 results, with name, synonym, scientific name, botanical source, and reacting enzymes. An institute project file records that the bank was formed on 1 January 2016 by merging the natural-substance bank and the herbal biomaterial bank.

items.name: KMCRIC
items.summary_zh: 庆熙大学韩医药融合研究信息中心的数据门户。数据中心页列出循证韩医文献库（收录2010年起的系统评价、随机对照试验和机制研究）、基于 Natural Standard 的韩药相互作用库、依据2008年WHO西太区标准穴位制作的取穴视频，以及庆熙大学与忠北大学药学院合作的生药更新库。中心长介绍写明2013年起任该中心所长。
items.summary_en: Data portal of the Korean Medicine Convergence Research Information Center at Kyung Hee University. The data-center page lists an evidence-based Korean-medicine literature set of systematic reviews, RCTs, and mechanism studies published since 2010; an herb-interaction set based on Natural Standard; acupoint videos made from the 2008 WHO Western Pacific standard locations; and a crude-drug update built with the Kyung Hee and Chungbuk pharmacy faculties. The director’s biography says the directorship began in 2013.

items.name: 藏药材资源数据库
items.summary_zh: 中国科学院西北高原生物研究所藏药研究重点实验室公开的藏药材名录（藏医）。页面为学名、拉丁名、药材名和药用部位表，并写明共15页；条目链接路径为2022年3–4月。这是药材名录，不是成分–靶点库。
orgs: Northwest Institute of Plateau Biology, Chinese Academy of Sciences
Key Laboratory of Tibetan Medicine Research
items.summary_en: Tibetan materia-medica list published by the Key Laboratory of Tibetan Medicine Research at the CAS Northwest Institute of Plateau Biology. The page is a table of Chinese name, Latin name, drug name, and part used, and it states that there are 15 pages. Entry paths are dated March–April 2022. It is a crude-drug list, not a compound–target database.

items.name: Sowa Rigpa Materia Medica Dataset
items.summary_zh: Data in Brief 公开的藏医（Sowa Rigpa）常用本草拉丁学名数据集。论文写明从《四部医典》等经典和嘎务多吉本草分类中选取约700种常用药物，给出藏文、Wylie转写和拉丁学名，补充材料随文发布。作者单位包括甘肃中医药大学藏医学院、青海民族大学药学院和成都中医药大学民族医药学术传承创新研究中心。
orgs: Chengdu University of Traditional Chinese Medicine
items.summary_en: Open Data in Brief table of Latin identifications for commonly used Sowa Rigpa materia medica. The paper says about 700 commonly used items were selected from the Four Medical Treatises and Gawé Dorjé’s classification, with Tibetan script, Wylie transliteration, and Latin names; the supplement is published with the article. Affiliations include the School of Tibetan Medicine at Gansu University of Chinese Medicine, the College of Pharmacy at Qinghai Nationalities University, and the ethnic-medicine center at Chengdu University of Traditional Chinese Medicine.

items.name: 傣药基原植物数据库
items.summary_zh: 中国科学院西双版纳热带植物园在植物园联盟平台上的傣药基原植物库（傣医）。首页版权为2018年，简介写明傣医四塔、五蕴与解药理论。物种列表地址返回跳转提示，匿名状态下未见可浏览的物种清单。
orgs: Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden, Chinese Academy of Sciences
items.summary_en: Dai medicinal-plant source database on the Chinese Union of Botanical Gardens platform, from Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden, CAS. The home page is copyrighted 2018 and describes Dai medicine’s four towers, five aggregates, and antidote theory. The species-list URL returns a redirect notice, and no anonymously browsable species catalogue was confirmed.

items.name: 内蒙古自治区民族药目录
items.summary_zh: 内蒙古自治区医疗保障局公开的民族药目录PDF（蒙医成方为主）。文件名为2023年12月25日的政府公开稿，正文标题为内蒙古自治区民族药目录，备注写明目录内民族药按乙类管理。这是医保收载目录，不是蒙药研究型成分库；2026年发布的蒙医药知识库平台未见可打开的网址。
items.summary_en: Public ethnic-medicine catalogue PDF from the Inner Mongolia Healthcare Security Administration, mainly finished Mongolian formulas. The government filename is dated 25 December 2023. The extracted text is titled the Inner Mongolia ethnic-medicine catalogue and notes that listed drugs are managed as class B. It is a reimbursement list, not a research compound database. The 2026 Mongolian-medicine knowledge-base launch has no open platform URL.

items.name: KG-IMHRE（赵炳南流派可解释多跳检索增强问答）
items.venue: 世界科学技术-中医药现代化
orgs: 中国中医科学院中医药信息研究所
items.summary_zh: 以赵炳南皮肤科流派知识图谱为库，用子图挖掘和动态检索语句引导大模型做可解释多跳问答。流派测试基准上选择题 85.2、问答题 45.78、总分 73.38，问答题专家评分 4.2。
items.summary_en: KG-IMHRE guides an LLM with subgraph mining and dynamic retrieval queries over the Zhao Bingnan dermatology school graph. On that benchmark it scores 85.2 on multiple choice, 45.78 on open questions, and 73.38 overall.

items.name: TCM Classic-Translator（中医古籍今译）
items.venue: 世界科学技术-中医药现代化
orgs: 中国中医科学院中医药信息研究所
南京中医药大学人工智能与信息技术学院
items.summary_zh: 用《黄帝内经》《伤寒论》等文言—白话平行语料，对 DeepSeek、Qwen、Baichuan 做 LoRA 微调并融合注释，得到命名模型 TCM Classic-Translator。BLEU-4、ROUGE-1、ROUGE-2、ROUGE-L 分别为 39.35、55.05、35.81、54.66。未见公开权重。
items.summary_en: TCM Classic-Translator is a named LoRA model for classical-to-modern TCM translation, trained on Huangdi Neijing and Shanghan Lun parallels with commentary augmentation. Reported scores are BLEU-4 39.35 and ROUGE-L 54.66. No public weights were found.

items.name: 杏林-NER (XingLin-NER)
items.venue: 世界科学技术-中医药现代化
orgs: 中国中医科学院中医药信息研究所
items.summary_zh: 面向中医临床文本术语多变的问题，用结构化指令和推理式指令做生成式命名实体识别，得到杏林-NER 系列，并用 TCM-BERT 语义相似度作评估。属抽取方法，不是通用领域对话大模型。
items.summary_en: XingLin-NER is a generative NER framework that instruction-tunes structured and reasoning prompts for variable TCM clinical terms, scored with TCM-BERT semantic similarity. It is an extraction method, not a general TCM chat model.

items.name: 知识蒸馏中医辨证论治模型
items.venue: 世界科学技术-中医药现代化
orgs: 南京中医药大学人工智能与信息技术学院
南京大学信息管理学院
江苏省中医流派研究院
items.summary_zh: 以 GPT-4o 为教师，从中医医案蒸馏辨证论治指令，再对 Qwen2.5-7B 做 LoRA 监督微调。论文报告推理过程更可读，同时保住处方推荐精度。未给独立品牌名，也未见公开权重。
items.summary_en: GPT-4o distills TCM case records into syndrome-differentiation instructions, then LoRA-tunes Qwen2.5-7B. The paper reports more readable reasoning while keeping prescription accuracy. No brand name or public weights.

items.name: 监督微调结合检索增强的中医知识问答
items.venue: 世界科学技术-中医药现代化
orgs: 南京中医药大学人工智能与信息技术学院
南京大学信息管理学院
江苏省中医流派研究院
items.summary_zh: 以 ChatGLM3 为基座，用 PissA 做监督微调并接 RAG。文中模型 BLEU 14.5830、ROUGE-1 34.6730；接入 RAG 后中医题库推理 F 值 0.6398，高于 ChatGLM3 基线 0.2654。
items.summary_en: ChatGLM3 is supervised-fine-tuned with PissA and then wrapped in RAG. Reported scores are BLEU 14.5830 and ROUGE-1 34.6730; with RAG the TCM item-bank F rises to 0.6398 from a 0.2654 ChatGLM3 baseline.

items.name: 轻量化中医药古籍大语言模型（LoRA）
items.venue: 世界科学技术-中医药现代化
orgs: 南京中医药大学人工智能与信息技术学院
辽宁中医药大学中医药创新工程技术中心
items.summary_zh: 用 GPT-4 生成历代《伤寒论》问答，并入神农与 cMedQA2，对 Baichuan、ChatGLM3、Xverse、Qwen 等五个基座做 LoRA，再比较 Qwen-7B-Chat 的全量 LoRA 与 8bit/4bit QLoRA。微调后 Qwen-7B-Chat 的 BLEU、ROUGE-1、ROUGE-2、ROUGE-L 较基座提高 17.61、19.63、14.3、21.4。未命名独立模型。
items.summary_en: Shanghan Lun QA pairs from GPT-4, plus ShenNong and cMedQA2, are used to LoRA-tune five base models and to compare full LoRA with 8-bit and 4-bit QLoRA on Qwen-7B-Chat. That model gains 17.61 BLEU and 21.4 ROUGE-L over its base. No separate model name.

items.name: 阿尔茨海默病指南知识库问答（ChatGLM3）
items.venue: 世界科学技术-中医药现代化
orgs: 湖南中医药大学信息科学与工程学院
items.summary_zh: 用 LangChain 把 ChatGLM3-6B 接到本地库，库含中华中医药学会、中华医学会认证的阿尔茨海默病诊疗指南、规范和教科书。相对裸 ChatGLM3-6B，事实准确性 Win 88.09%、完整性 Win 85.71%。
items.summary_en: LangChain grounds ChatGLM3-6B on a local library of Alzheimer guidelines and textbooks endorsed by the China Association of Chinese Medicine and the Chinese Medical Association. Against bare ChatGLM3-6B, factual-accuracy wins are 88.09% and completeness wins 85.71%.

items.name: MMKGQA（海洋中药知识图谱问答）
items.venue: 世界科学技术-中医药现代化
orgs: 南京中医药大学人工智能与信息技术学院
items.summary_zh: 以细粒度海洋中药图谱 MMKG 为库，用 Aho-Corasick 与 Word2Vec 做实体识别和问题分类，建成 MMKGQA。六类常见问题上平均精确率 97.93%、召回率 83.41%、F1 89.10%。不是大语言模型系统。
items.summary_en: MMKGQA answers marine Chinese materia medica questions from the MMKG graph using Aho-Corasick and Word2Vec. On six common question types, mean precision, recall, and F1 are 97.93%, 83.41%, and 89.10%. It is not an LLM system.

items.name: 基于大语言模型与文本嵌入计算的中医证素辨证自动化方法
orgs: 北京中医药大学中医学院
天津中医药大学针灸推拿学院
天津中医药大学第一附属医院
天津中医药大学中医学院
items.summary_zh: 先训练指令调优嵌入模型 Instr-MT-TCM，再与大模型协同做证素辨证。1793 例、34 病 66 证上协同方法平均 F1 0.927，高于人工标注 0.512；并在 48 例前列腺癌上核算证素。作者孙肇阳、汪洋、马铭泽、陈妍文、吕镇秀、江甜甜、温慧玲、陈波、关静。
items.align_note: 期刊页标题为《基于大语言模型与文本嵌入计算的中医证素辨证自动化方法研究》；该中文DOI不在Crossref
items.summary_en: Instr-MT-TCM, an instruction-tuned TCM embedding model, is paired with an LLM for syndrome-element differentiation. On 1,793 real cases the joint method reaches mean F1 0.927 versus 0.512 for manual labels, and is applied to 48 prostate-cancer cases.

items.name: 循证中医指南 PICO 知识图谱问答
orgs: 中国中医科学院中医药信息研究所
items.summary_zh: 崔唐明、孙美玲、孙华君、李海燕以多囊卵巢综合征指南为例，用文心一言抽取 PICO 知识，Neo4j 存成 13 类、248 节点、337 条关系的指南图谱，并预设 12 类临床问题、24 个问句模板。2024 年第 19 卷第 5 期 20–27 页。
items.summary_en: Cui et al. use ERNIE Bot to extract PICO triples from a polycystic-ovary guideline, store 248 nodes and 337 relations in Neo4j, and draft 12 question classes with 24 templates for a guideline QA system.

items.name: 基于雅意大模型的中医智能预问诊
orgs: 中国中医科学院医学实验中心
中国科学院自动化研究所
天津中科闻歌科技有限公司
中国中医科学院中医基础理论研究所
items.summary_zh: 刘奕清、李迎、杨洪军等用 DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 微调 YAYI 2-30B，并用症状关系带权无向图做智能体辨证。专业知识测试中执业医师题正确率 94.09%；360 例临床测试辨证准确率 88.33%，问诊轮次和时间少于主治医师。2025 年第 66 卷第 9 期 895–900 页。
items.summary_en: Liu et al. fine-tune YAYI 2-30B and couple it to a weighted symptom graph agent. Practitioner-exam accuracy is 94.09%, and on the clinical test syndrome accuracy is 88.33% with fewer turns and less time than attending physicians.

items.name: SMGCN
items.summary_zh: 证候感知的多图卷积荐药模型：在症状–草药图之外再建症状共现图和草药共现图，先融成隐式证候表示再推荐草药。
items.summary_en: Syndrome-aware multi-graph convolution for herb recommendation. Besides the symptom–herb graph, it adds symptom and herb co-occurrence graphs, fuses an implicit syndrome vector, then ranks herbs.

items.name: MGCN
items.summary_zh: 面向《伤寒论》方的多图卷积处方推荐：用证素图和证型图做症状特征聚合，再由多层感知机预测草药。
