items.summary_en: Multi-graph convolutional prescription model on the Treatise on Cold Damage. Symptom features are aggregated on state-element and syndrome graphs, then an MLP predicts the herb set.

items.name: 知识引导的中医荐药（FITEE）
items.venue: Frontiers of Information Technology & Electronic Engineering
items.summary_zh: 用典籍和处方抽出的症状–草药知识图谱做图注意力表示，并在预测层加入方剂学信息。
items.summary_en: Graph-attention herb recommendation guided by a knowledge graph mined from TCM literature and prescriptions, with formula-theory signals added in the prediction layer.

items.name: KDHR
items.summary_zh: 知识驱动的多层图卷积荐药：把中医药知识图谱里的症状–草药关系做多层信息融合后再推荐。代码公开。
items.summary_en: Knowledge-driven herb recommendation by multi-layer graph-convolution fusion over a TCM knowledge graph. Code is public.

items.name: PresRecRF
items.summary_zh: 把分子知识图谱与大模型抽出的中医语义表示融合，同时预测草药和剂量。代码与数据在 GitHub。
items.summary_en: Fuses a molecular knowledge graph with TCM semantic representations from large models, and predicts both herbs and dosages. Code and data are on GitHub.

items.name: TongueDx
items.title_zh: TongueDx 远程舌诊多标签数据集
items.summary_zh: 面向远程舌诊的公开图像集：5109 张、4650 名受试者，8 个二分类舌象属性（淡、边尖红、红点、瘀斑、裂纹、齿痕、厚苔、黄苔），并带年龄和性别。仓库可下。与后续消融论文 TongueDx2 不是同一篇。
items.summary_en: Public remote-tongue dataset: 5,109 images from 4,650 subjects, eight binary attributes (pale, red tip/side, red spots, ecchymosis, cracks, tooth marks, thick fur, yellow fur), plus age and sex. The repository is downloadable. This is not the later TongueDx2 ablation paper.

items.name: 辅助诊断结果和参考处方生成方法、装置、介质及计算机设备
items.summary_zh: 病历与诊疗思路分四路召回、融合排序后，由大模型生成中医诊断、证型和参考处方（公开，未授权）
orgs: 浙江固生智能科技有限公司
items.summary_en: Recalls similar records and treatment rationales on four paths, then a large model drafts TCM diagnosis, syndrome pattern, and a reference prescription (published, not granted).

items.name: 一种基于大模型智能体协作规划的中医诊断场景模拟方法
items.summary_zh: 把非结构化医案做成结构化知识，再用大模型智能体协作模拟中医诊断流程（公开，未授权）
items.summary_en: Turns unstructured case records into structured knowledge, then large-model agents collaborate to simulate a TCM diagnostic encounter (published, not granted).

items.name: 一种基于大模型的心血管疾病医疗决策支持方法
items.summary_zh: 用预训练大模型融合中医证候知识与西医病理图谱，生成含中医方剂的心血管决策方案（公开，未授权）
items.summary_en: A pretrained large model fuses TCM syndrome knowledge with a Western pathology graph to propose cardiovascular decisions that include Chinese herbal formulas (published, not granted).

items.name: 基于多模态中医大语言模型的数据分析方法、系统、终端及介质
items.summary_zh: 用舌象、语音和问诊文本训练多模态中医大模型，输出初步中医分析（2026.06 授权）
orgs: 深圳心语心言智能技术有限公司
items.summary_en: Trains a multimodal TCM large model on tongue images, speech, and inquiry text, then outputs a preliminary TCM analysis (granted June 2026).

items.name: 广安门医院「广医·岐智」完成国家级深度合成算法备案
items.summary_zh: 广安门医院官网称广医·岐智取得国家级深度合成算法备案，并称是国内首家完成该项备案的中医院
orgs: 中国中医科学院广安门医院
items.summary_en: Guang'anmen Hospital reports that Guangyi Qizhi completed national deep-synthesis algorithm filing and describes itself as the first TCM hospital to do so.

items.name: 天津中医药大学等发布中医药临床研究智能体CTA
items.summary_zh: 科技日报报道CTA在中医药临床疗效评价大会发布，基于Qwen2.5-14B微调，面向临床试验方案、数据管理与统计
items.summary_en: Science and Technology Daily reports the CTA clinical-research agent, fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-14B for trial protocols, data management, and statistics.

items.name: 安贞医院与中国电子云发布中西医结合高血压大模型Idiom-Hypertension
items.summary_zh: 中国经济网报道10月26日发布中西医结合高血压诊疗大模型Idiom-Hypertension，用于高血压规范管理
items.summary_en: China Economic Net reports the 26 October release of Idiom-Hypertension, an integrated Chinese-Western model for hypertension care.

items.name: 中医方证多模态大模型与方证智云入选国家人工智能应用中试基地阶段成果
items.summary_zh: 上海中医药大学称方证多模态大模型入选医疗领域国家人工智能应用中试基地阶段成果，基座为视觉语言模型
items.summary_en: Shanghai University of TCM says its formula-syndrome multimodal model was selected as a stage result of a national AI application pilot base.

items.name: 薪火中国药亮相2026世界数字教育大会，问答版上线国家智慧教育平台
items.summary_zh: 北京中医药大学中药学院称薪火中国药在世界数字教育大会发布，问答版已上线国家智慧教育公共服务平台
items.summary_en: Beijing University of Chinese Medicine says XinHuo ZhongGuoYao appeared at the 2026 World Digital Education Conference and its Q&A edition is on the national smart-education platform.

items.name: 上海中医药大学与龙华医院方证大模型正式开放接入
items.summary_zh: 中新网报道方证大模型9月19日开放接入，覆盖临床辅助诊疗、科研数据挖掘和人才培养，并计划部署到龙华医院及医联体
items.summary_en: China News Service reports that the formula-syndrome model opened for access on 19 September, covering assisted care, research mining, and training, with planned deployment at Longhua Hospital.

items.name: 南京中医药大学发布灵素·艾护中医护理大模型
items.summary_zh: 报道称徐桂华团队10月9日发布灵素·艾护中医护理大模型，面向辨证施护、科研与居家康养，27所加盟医院为首批应用单位
items.summary_en: Reports say Nanjing University of Chinese Medicine released the LingSu Aihu TCM nursing model on 9 October; 27 member hospitals are the first sites.

items.name: 中医聪宝素问中医内容生成大模型算法通过深度合成备案
items.summary_zh: 中医聪宝称素问中医内容生成大模型算法列入国家网信办第十四批深度合成服务算法备案
items.summary_en: TCM Congbao says its Suwen content-generation algorithm was included in the 14th CAC deep-synthesis filing batch.

items.name: 一种基于中医语言大模型的中医智能分析方法及系统
items.summary_zh: 用LoRA微调得到中医语言大模型，按证型和主诉输出方剂（公开，未授权）
orgs: 杭州轩岐智能科技有限公司
浙江中医药大学附属第三医院
items.summary_en: LoRA-tunes a TCM language model that maps syndrome and chief complaint to a formula (published, not granted).

items.name: 一种基于动态语义分块、知识图谱与多跳路径规划的中医大语言模型AI题库智能生成方法及系统
items.summary_zh: 对中医文本做语义分块和知识图谱多跳路径，再训练大语言模型生成中医题库（公开，未授权）
orgs: 北京安戈普罗科技有限公司
items.summary_en: Chunks TCM text, plans multi-hop paths on a knowledge graph, and trains a large model to generate a TCM question bank (published, not granted).

items.name: 基于多模态大模型的中医舌诊药饮推荐方法
items.summary_zh: 用大模型根据舌象生成病症描述并推荐药饮（2026.05授权；申请公布日2025-11-07）
orgs: 天大智图（天津）科技有限公司
items.summary_en: A multimodal model turns a tongue image into a condition description and a medicinal-drink recommendation (granted May 2026).

items.name: 一种面向中医药知识图谱的综合质量评估方法
items.summary_zh: 把小样本送入中医药微调大语言模型，做知识图谱质量预评估（公开，未授权）
orgs: 湖北省标准化与质量研究院
items.summary_en: Sends a small sample to a TCM-tuned large model for a preliminary quality check of a TCM knowledge graph (published, not granted).

items.name: 利用AI大模型进行舌象分析的方法及装置
items.summary_zh: 在中医舌诊场景用AI大模型按体质、症状和综合解读做舌象分析（公开，未授权）
orgs: 深圳伯德睿捷健康科技有限公司
items.summary_en: Uses a large model to read tongue images by constitution, symptoms, and an overall interpretation (published, not granted).

items.name: 基于AI大模型的中医元气充盈智能健康管理系统
items.summary_zh: 把可穿戴数据转成中医术语后送入AI中医大模型（公开；2026-02-06已视为撤回）
orgs: 重庆鼐龙生物科技有限公司
items.summary_en: Converts wearable signals into TCM terms and passes them to a TCM large model (published; deemed withdrawn on 6 February 2026).

items.name: 基于AI大模型智能人体域网的中医六经辨证智能对话健康管理系统
items.summary_zh: 包含中医六经辨证术语大模型和对话式健康管理（公开；2026-02-06已视为撤回）
orgs: 重庆鼐龙生物科技有限公司
items.summary_en: A six-meridian TCM dialogue system over a body-area network and a large model (published; deemed withdrawn on 6 February 2026).

items.name: Yin et al. 2025: 数据挖掘、大模型与多模态融合的中医AI综述
items.summary_zh: 从数据挖掘、大语言模型和多模态融合三条线综述人工智能如何解析中药复方的多成分、多靶点机制
items.summary_en: Reviews AI for TCM across data mining, large language models, and multimodal fusion, aimed at multi-component herbal formulas.

items.name: Liu et al. 2025: 网络药理学推动大模型用于中医药研究
items.summary_zh: 综述网络药理学如何把药物—靶点—疾病网络与大语言模型结合起来，解释中药复方的多靶点机制
items.summary_en: Reviews how network pharmacology and large language models jointly explain multi-target mechanisms of TCM formulas.

items.name: Sun et al. 2026: 生成模型在中医药中的进展与应用
items.summary_zh: 综述生成模型在中医药中的进展与应用
items.summary_en: Reviews advances and applications of generative models in traditional Chinese medicine.

items.name: Wang et al. 2026: 重思中医大模型评测
items.summary_zh: 指出中医大模型评测仍缺少质量底线：未筛选古籍和网页语料可能含过时或禁用建议，单病例基准也不足以代表临床
items.summary_en: Argues that TCM LLM evaluation still lacks a quality floor: unfiltered classics and web text can contain outdated advice, and a single case is not a benchmark.

items.name: Dong et al. 2026: 中医处方推荐计算方法综述
items.summary_zh: 综述从临床数据学习处方规律的计算方法，覆盖智能处方推荐如何支持中医临床决策
items.summary_en: Reviews computational herbal-prescription recommendation and how it can support TCM clinical decisions.

items.name: 2026: 数字化与智能化时代的中医药机遇与挑战
items.summary_zh: 从专家系统到深度学习和大语言模型，讨论数字化、智能化给中医药带来的机遇与挑战
items.summary_en: Discusses opportunities and challenges for TCM as AI moves from expert systems to deep learning and large language models.

items.name: 2026: 面向中医药证据知情决策的数字智能循证
items.summary_zh: 讨论如何用数字智能循证方法，把辨证论治推进到证据知情的中医药决策
items.summary_en: Discusses digital intelligent evidence-based methods for evidence-informed decisions in Chinese medicine.

items.name: 2026: 中医智能诊断的跨学科融合与发展趋势
items.summary_zh: 讨论中医智能诊断的跨学科融合与发展趋势
items.summary_en: Discusses interdisciplinary integration and development trends of intelligent diagnosis in TCM.

items.name: 中医大模型临床实践评测方法
items.venue: Guidelines and Standards of Chinese Medicine
items.summary_zh: 针对现有医学大模型评测以西医范式为主、缺少中医专用标准的问题，构建面向临床实践的中医大模型评测方法
items.summary_en: Builds a clinical-practice evaluation for TCM large language models, arguing that Western medical benchmarks do not fit.

items.name: 灵丹 JAMIA：面向临床推理的中医知识编码
items.summary_zh: JAMIA论文提出灵丹，用大模型加强中医知识编码以提升临床推理任务。与后来的Digital Chinese Medicine灵丹处方评测不是同一篇
items.summary_en: JAMIA paper on Lingdan, a TCM large language model for encoding domain knowledge in clinical reasoning tasks. Distinct from the later Digital Chinese Medicine prescription-evaluation paper.

items.name: 中医场景中医疗大模型的提示词效应
items.summary_zh: 在中医任务上评估16个大模型，说明提示词效应随模型而变，制约医疗大模型在中医场景的稳定部署
items.summary_en: Evaluates 16 models on TCM and shows that prompt effects depend on the model, which complicates reliable deployment.

items.name: 用大模型理解中医：机制探索与创新应用
items.summary_zh: 提出面向中医理解的大模型方法，覆盖机制探索与创新应用
items.summary_en: An LLM method for mechanism exploration and downstream application in TCM.

items.name: TEmbed-DDI：中西药相互作用标注
items.summary_zh: 用大语言模型和双向神经网络做跨域药物相互作用标注，并把中药相互作用纳入评测
items.summary_en: Annotates cross-domain drug interactions with large language models and bidirectional networks, and adds a Chinese-medicine interaction evaluation.

items.name: TCM-CoT-RAG
items.summary_zh: 面向中医风湿病临床决策的检索增强系统，用思维链约束专家式推理，降低大模型幻觉
items.summary_en: Retrieval-augmented generation with chain-of-thought for TCM rheumatology decisions.

items.name: TCM-HyperRAG
items.summary_zh: 用高阶知识超图增强中医疾病诊断和处方推荐，并把可追溯证据交给骨干大模型
items.summary_en: Higher-order knowledge hypergraphs for TCM diagnosis and prescription recommendation, with traceable evidence passed to a backbone model.

items.name: AcuGPT-Agent
items.summary_zh: 面向针灸治疗不孕的大模型智能系统
items.summary_en: An LLM agent for acupuncture-based infertility treatment.

items.name: LLM-SDaT
items.summary_zh: 把知识注入大模型，用于中医辨证
items.summary_en: A knowledge-informed LLM framework for TCM syndrome differentiation.

items.name: AcuKG
items.summary_zh: 用实体识别、关系抽取和本体映射，把针灸指南、文献和临床试验整理成知识图谱
items.summary_en: A knowledge graph of medical acupuncture built with entity recognition, relation extraction, and ontology mapping.

items.name: KampoBench
items.summary_zh: 医师修订的汉方问诊基准：74个问诊场景、310条对话级评分标准，评的是问诊应用而不是考试得分
items.summary_en: Physician-reviewed Kampo consultation benchmark: 74 scenarios and 310 dialogue-level criteria, scoring application rather than exam recall.

items.name: 韩医CPX场景自动生成
items.venue: Studies in Health Technology and Informatics
items.summary_zh: 用大模型和检索增强，加上多模态临床线索，自动生成韩医标准化病人CPX场景并给出量化反馈；10名专家验证
items.summary_en: LLM plus retrieval-augmented generation and multimodal cues to automate traditional Korean medicine CPX scenarios; validated by 10 experts.

items.name: 辨证论治大模型基准数据集
items.summary_zh: Scientific Data发布的辨证论治基准，用来评估大模型在中医个体化、整体性临床任务上的能力
items.summary_en: Scientific Data benchmark for evaluating syndrome differentiation and treatment in large language models.

items.name: 大模型连接中医知识与临床实践
items.summary_zh: 讨论大语言模型如何把多源、隐性的中医知识和以证候为核心的临床诊疗连接起来
items.summary_en: Discusses how large language models can link implicit TCM knowledge with syndrome-based clinical practice.

items.name: 知识图谱增强的中医问答大模型
items.summary_zh: 用知识图谱增强大模型的中医问答，补辨证推理并降低多源数据带来的幻觉
items.summary_en: Knowledge-graph-enhanced large language models for TCM question answering.

items.name: 医学知识增强的双层对齐中药处方推荐
items.summary_zh: 用医学知识增强的双层对齐网络做中药处方推荐，避免只依赖结构化输入或多阶段流水线
items.summary_en: Medical-knowledge-enhanced dual-level alignment network for herbal prescription recommendation.

items.name: DMease
items.summary_zh: 辅助中医师诊断和治疗糖尿病的人工智能工具
items.summary_en: An AI assistant for TCM doctors diagnosing and treating diabetes mellitus.

items.name: 用大模型构建中医舌诊本体
items.summary_zh: 用大语言模型辅助构建中医舌诊本体
items.summary_en: Uses a large language model to help construct a TCM tongue-diagnosis ontology.

items.name: 名老中医针灸医案知识图谱
items.summary_zh: 用大模型做信息抽取，构建名老中医针灸医案知识图谱
items.summary_en: Builds a knowledge graph of famous acupuncturists' cases by extracting information with a large language model.

items.name: 针灸临床决策中的大模型补偿机制
items.summary_zh: 分析大语言模型在针灸临床决策中的补偿机制
items.summary_en: Studies compensation mechanisms of large language models in acupuncture clinical decision-making.

items.name: ChatGPT、DeepSeek与医师针灸方案对照
items.summary_zh: 比较ChatGPT、DeepSeek和医师生成的针灸治疗方案
items.summary_en: Compares ChatGPT, DeepSeek, and physician-generated acupuncture treatment plans.

items.name: 中医大模型指令微调
items.summary_zh: 面向中医药任务对大语言模型做指令微调
items.summary_en: Instruction fine-tuning of large language models for TCM.

items.name: 面向辨证的大模型微调
items.summary_zh: 微调大语言模型做中医辨证
items.summary_en: Fine-tunes large language models for TCM syndrome differentiation.

items.name: 中医药知识图谱问答系统
items.summary_zh: 把中医药知识图谱和大语言模型接成智能问答系统
items.summary_en: An intelligent TCM question-answering system that joins a knowledge graph with large language models.

items.name: 中医问诊中的大模型与知识图谱
items.summary_zh: 以中医问诊为例，把大语言模型和知识图谱结合起来
items.summary_en: Case study of integrating large language models with knowledge graphs in TCM consultation.

items.name: 多阶段学习的中医处方推荐大模型
items.summary_zh: 用多阶段学习训练面向中医处方推荐的大语言模型
items.summary_en: A large language model for TCM prescription recommendation trained in multiple stages.

items.name: 中医药专利关系抽取
items.venue: Lecture Notes on Data Engineering and Communications Technologies
items.summary_zh: 用大语言模型和多样化语义交互抽取中医药专利中的关系
items.summary_en: Relation extraction over TCM patents with a large language model and diversified semantic interaction.

items.name: 基于Llama3的中医大模型
items.summary_zh: 在中医数据上微调Llama 3、Phi-3.5和Mistral，补通用模型对中文中医语料的不足
items.summary_en: Fine-tunes Llama 3, Phi-3.5, and Mistral on TCM data to improve Chinese TCM language coverage.

items.name: TCMHP
items.summary_zh: 面向中医养生（治未病）的大语言模型，用专业数据补理论体系难以直接智能化的问题
items.summary_en: A large language model for TCM health preservation (preventive care).

items.name: 动态知识图谱与大模型的中医生理建模
items.summary_zh: 把动态知识图谱接进大模型，补中医生理知识覆盖不足和更新成本高的问题
items.summary_en: Connects dynamic knowledge graphs with large language models for TCM physiological modeling.

items.name: TCMQA
items.summary_zh: 38279道中医执照考试题，并配101名执业医师的15151条作答作为人类参照
items.summary_en: Open benchmark of 38,279 TCM licensing questions paired with 15,151 answers from 101 licensed practitioners.

items.name: TCMClinicalReason-Bench
items.summary_zh: 用2000份多中心电子病历，检验模型能否按病例证据完成从病因病机、证候、治则到处方的推理
items.summary_en: 2,000 multicenter EHR cases testing whether a model can reason from pathogenesis and syndrome to treatment principle and prescription.

items.name: 理法方药对齐的中医处方生成
items.summary_zh: 四阶段对齐处方生成：补可审计的理法方药推理、随证加减，以及十八反等禁忌
items.summary_en: Four-stage alignment for TCM prescription generation covering auditable li-fa-fang-yao reasoning, follow-up adjustment, and contraindications such as the eighteen antagonisms.

items.name: TCMScience
items.summary_zh: 中医科研发现智能体，把语言模型提案与执行、发布权限分开，避免不同证据类型混推
items.summary_en: An autonomous TCM research agent that separates language-model proposals from execution and release authority.

items.name: 证伪导向的可审计辨证协议
items.summary_zh: 在公开TCMEval-SDT的200例辨证上，用与具体模型无关的证伪协议约束可审计决策，强调输出纪律而不只是换更大的模型
items.summary_en: A model-agnostic falsification protocol for auditable syndrome differentiation on the public 200-case TCMEval-SDT set.

items.name: LingLan多模态辨证大模型
orgs: 清华大学深圳国际研究生院
items.summary_zh: 面向望闻问切多模态数据的中医诊断大模型。与灵兰秘典评测基准（arXiv 2602.01779）不是同一篇
items.summary_en: A multimodal TCM diagnosis model over the four examinations. Not the LingLan benchmark paper (arXiv 2602.01779).

items.name: 辨证论治基准数据集
items.title_zh: 大模型辨证论治评测基准
items.summary_zh: Scientific Data发布的辨证论治基准，用来评估大模型的中医临床应用能力
items.summary_en: Scientific Data benchmark for syndrome differentiation and treatment with large language models.

items.name: TCMQA
items.title_zh: 带执业医师参照的38279题中医考试基准
items.summary_zh: 38279道中医执照考试题，并配101名执业医师的15151条作答
items.summary_en: 38,279 TCM licensing questions with 15,151 responses from 101 licensed practitioners.

items.name: TCMClinicalReason-Bench
items.title_zh: 从病机到处方的真实病历推理基准
items.summary_zh: 2000份多中心电子病历，检验模型能否按病例证据完成从病因病机到处方的推理
items.summary_en: 2,000 multicenter records for reasoning from pathogenesis to prescription.

items.name: KampoBench
items.title_zh: 医师修订的汉方问诊基准
items.summary_zh: 74个汉方问诊场景、310条对话级评分标准，由持证汉方医师修订
items.summary_en: Physician-reviewed Kampo consultation benchmark with 74 scenarios and 310 dialogue-level criteria.

items.name: AcuKG
items.title_zh: 针灸知识图谱
items.summary_zh: 综合针灸知识图谱，来源包括指南、PubMed、临床试验和本体映射
items.summary_en: Knowledge graph of medical acupuncture assembled from guidelines, literature, trials, and ontology mapping.

items.name: 一种基于大语言模型的中医知识图谱构建方法
items.summary_zh: 用大语言模型从中医文本抽取命名实体和实体关系，按相似度融合后生成中医知识图谱（公开，未授权）
items.summary_en: An LLM extracts named entities and relations from TCM text, merges similar entities, and builds a TCM knowledge graph (published, not granted).

items.name: 一种基于大语言模型的中医客服回复系统
items.summary_zh: 用同义词增广中医资料并训练Transformer大语言模型，微调后解析客户请求并生成回复；该申请于2024-07-09授权为CN118070907B
orgs: 卓世智星（天津）科技有限公司
items.summary_en: Synonym-augmented TCM text trains a Transformer LLM that is fine-tuned to parse customer requests and draft replies; the application was granted as CN118070907B on 2024-07-09.

items.name: 一种基于大语言模型的针灸辅助诊疗和模型评价的方法
items.summary_zh: 用标注症状和穴位操作的数据微调ChatGLM3-6B，输出针灸方案，并用句子相似度评价生成结果（公开，未授权）
items.summary_en: ChatGLM3-6B is fine-tuned on labeled symptoms, points, and operations to propose acupuncture plans, which are scored by sentence similarity (published, not granted).

items.name: 一种基于计算视觉与大语言模型辅助中医诊疗的系统
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型处理语音问诊，计算机视觉把患者图像转成诊断信息，检索增强后作为大语言模型输入，辅助中医诊疗（公开，未授权）
orgs: 深圳金草健康科技有限公司
items.summary_en: An LLM handles spoken inquiry while computer vision converts patient images into findings that are retrieved and fed back to the LLM for TCM decision support (published, not granted).

items.name: 一种基于大语言模型的中医知识深度挖掘方法
items.summary_zh: 同时训练检索增强和模型微调，使系统既能解释中医名词和证候，也能按患者输入给出治疗方案（公开，未授权）
items.summary_en: Retrieval augmentation and model fine-tuning are trained together so the system can explain TCM terms and syndromes and suggest treatment from a patient query (published, not granted).

items.name: 以大语言模型为先验的智能中医系统
items.summary_zh: 用大语言模型优化患者诊断文本，再做语义理解，预测中医证候和病因并给出治疗建议（已授权）
orgs: 上海源庐加佳信息科技有限公司
items.summary_en: An LLM rewrites patient diagnostic text, which is then semantically interpreted to predict TCM syndromes and causes and to suggest treatment (granted).

items.name: 一种基于多模态大模型的中医舌诊分析系统及方法
items.summary_zh: 用舌面象指令数据微调LLaMA等通用大语言模型，形成TongueLMM，用于舌诊解读、多轮问答和体质推理（公开，未授权）
orgs: 合肥云诊信息科技有限公司
items.summary_en: Tongue- and face-image instructions fine-tune a general LLM such as LLaMA into TongueLMM for tongue interpretation, multi-turn QA, and constitution reasoning (published, not granted).

items.name: 一种基于大语言模型的中医知识图谱生成方法及系统
items.summary_zh: 以中药和诊察治疗数据训练模型，按患者信息可视化输出治疗方案，并用疗效反馈继续更新模型（公开，未授权）
orgs: 中国中医科学院中医药信息研究所
items.summary_en: A model trained on herbal and consultation data visualizes treatment options for a patient and is updated from outcome ratings (published, not granted).

items.name: 一种基于大语言模型的中医问答系统及方法
items.summary_zh: 从中医药文献构建数据集并训练大语言模型，接收用户医学问题后生成对话回答（公开，未授权）
items.summary_en: A dataset built from TCM literature trains an LLM that takes a user's medical question and returns a dialogue answer (published, not granted).

items.name: 一种用于智能中医系统的大语言模型的构建方法
items.summary_zh: 用舌诊图像标记和历史病历训练舌诊问诊模型，并据此构建用于智能中医系统的大语言模型（已授权）
orgs: 深圳问止中医健康科技有限公司
items.summary_en: Labeled tongue images and historical records train a tongue-inquiry model used to construct an LLM for an intelligent TCM system (granted).

items.name: 应用大语言模型的泌尿科中医问诊结果预测方法和系统
items.summary_zh: 用大语言模型从泌尿科中医问诊描述预测病灶核心关键词，并按反馈数据实时调整模型参数（2026.03 授权；申请公布日 2025-04-11）
items.summary_en: An LLM predicts core lesion keywords from urological TCM inquiry text and adjusts its parameters from recorded feedback (granted 6 March 2026; application published 11 April 2025).

items.name: 一种基于OCR识别和大模型的中药方数据解析方法及装置
items.summary_zh: 对手写中药方做OCR，把相冲、用量和服药建议拼成提示词送入大模型，生成处方综合判断（2025.06 授权；申请公布日 2025-04-11）
orgs: 同力天合（北京）管理软件股份有限公司
items.summary_en: Handwritten herbal prescriptions are OCR'd into prompts on incompatibility, dosage, and administration, which a large model scores into an overall judgment (granted 20 June 2025; application published 11 April 2025).

items.name: 基于胸肺科中医问诊报告大语言模型的中医方剂推荐方法和系统
items.summary_zh: 用多知识域共享微调胸肺科中医问诊大语言模型，输出体质和症状参数，并推荐药食同源方剂（公开，未授权）
items.summary_en: Shared knowledge domains fine-tune a chest-and-lung TCM inquiry LLM that outputs constitution and symptom parameters and recommends food-medicine formulas (published, not granted).

items.name: 基于大语言模型的中药药物警戒问答系统的构建方法
items.summary_zh: 建立中药知识库并训练药物警戒检索增强模型PV-RAG，按自然语言提问生成中药安全回答（公开，未授权）
items.summary_en: A Chinese-materia-medica knowledge base trains the pharmacovigilance RAG model PV-RAG to answer natural-language safety questions (published, not granted).

items.name: 一种基于大模型的中药分类方法
items.summary_zh: 对多源中药数据做实体识别并映射现代药理指标，再自适应微调预训练大模型完成中药分类（公开，未授权）
items.summary_en: Entities from multi-source herbal data are mapped to modern pharmacological indicators, then a pretrained large model is adaptively fine-tuned to classify herbs (published, not granted).

items.name: 基于大语言模型的中医五音疗疾个性化音乐生成系统及其构建方法
items.summary_zh: 先用大语言模型做中医辨证，再在五音特征约束下生成个性化五音治疗音乐（公开，未授权）
orgs: 苏州昂升网络科技有限公司
items.summary_en: An LLM first performs TCM syndrome differentiation, then generates personalized five-tone therapy music under tonal constraints (published, not granted).

items.name: 融合动态知识图谱的针灸大模型辨证方法及调理优化系统
items.summary_zh: 动态更新针灸知识图谱，结合患者时序临床特征，用图注意力和强化学习辨证并生成针灸方案（公开，未授权）
orgs: 广东中科凯泽信息科技有限公司
items.summary_en: A dynamically updated acupuncture knowledge graph is combined with time-series clinical features, graph attention, and reinforcement learning to differentiate syndromes and draft acupuncture plans (published, not granted).

items.name: 一种基于多模态大语言模型的中医临床辅助决策系统和方法
items.summary_zh: 融合舌象视觉特征与临床文本，检索相似病例后，由多模态大语言模型生成证候、诊断、中药处方和推理过程（公开，未授权）
orgs: 清华大学深圳国际研究生院
items.summary_en: Tongue-image features are fused with clinical text, similar cases are retrieved, and a multimodal LLM drafts syndrome, diagnosis, herbal prescription, and reasoning (published, not granted).

items.name: 基于检索增强生成的针灸大模型构建方法、系统及装置
items.summary_zh: 训练针灸大语言模型，问答请求做知识库向量检索后生成回答，诊断请求再检索针灸方案库给出治疗条目（公开，未授权）
items.summary_en: An acupuncture LLM answers questions from vector-retrieved knowledge snippets and, for diagnosis requests, retrieves treatment entries from an acupuncture-plan library (published, not granted).

items.name: 一种基于大语言模型的人-信息-物理三元数据融合中药制造知识图谱构建系统、电子设备及存储介质
items.summary_zh: 用大语言模型按中药术语和关系约束从制造文本抽取三元组，再按人-信息-物理本体构建中药制造知识图谱（公开，未授权）
items.summary_en: An LLM extracts triples from manufacturing text under TCM term and relation constraints, then a human-cyber-physical ontology assembles a manufacturing knowledge graph (published, not granted).

items.name: 基于大语言模型的经络辨证与针灸方案生成方法及系统
items.summary_zh: 把多源诊疗数据量化并提质后，结合经络辨证知识库和大语言模型生成针灸方案（公开，未授权）
orgs: 广东中科凯泽信息科技有限公司
广州双龙脉健康产业科技有限公司
items.summary_en: Multi-source clinical data are quantified and cleaned, then a meridian-syndrome knowledge base and an LLM generate acupuncture plans (published, not granted).

items.name: 一种基于图注意力网络与大语言模型的中药处方生成方法
items.summary_zh: 把中药处方生成转为多标签分类，用图注意力网络和大语言模型建模药物协同与禁忌（公开，未授权）
orgs: 杭州市第一人民医院（西湖大学附属杭州市第一人民医院）
items.summary_en: Herbal prescription generation is cast as multi-label classification, with graph attention and an LLM modeling drug synergy and contraindications (published, not granted).

items.name: 基于大语言模型的中医智能问诊方法及系统
items.summary_zh: 从多模态问诊数据解析问诊意图，再用双路径检索中医知识，生成问诊结果（公开，未授权）
orgs: 深圳市蓝宇飞扬科技有限公司
items.summary_en: Intent is parsed from multimodal inquiry data, then dual-path retrieval over TCM knowledge produces the consultation result (published, not granted).

items.name: 一种基于大语言模型的中医古籍症状标准化处理方法
items.summary_zh: 用大语言模型从中医古籍切片识别候选症状，并映射到标准症状语义场完成术语标准化（公开，未授权）
items.summary_en: An LLM finds candidate symptom spans in sliced classical TCM texts and maps them into a standard symptom semantic field (published, not granted).

items.name: 学校与河南中医药大学联合发布“中医药大模型”
items.summary_zh: 2025年1月8日，北京科技大学联合河南中医药大学发布张仲景中医药大模型1.0，功能包括智能辨证、证素推荐、经方应用和方药分析。
items.summary_en: On 8 January 2025, the University of Science and Technology Beijing and Henan University of Chinese Medicine released Zhang Zhongjing TCM Large Model 1.0 for syndrome differentiation, syndrome-element recommendation, classical formulas, and formula analysis.

items.name: “AI中医”开处方！南中医科研团队推出“黄煌经方AI辅助诊疗系统”
items.summary_zh: 新华网报道，2025年3月13日南京中医药大学黄煌团队与杭州脉景健康发布黄煌经方AI辅助诊疗系统，用大语言模型与知识图谱把“方人相应”做成可计算诊疗流程。
orgs: 杭州脉景健康管理有限公司
items.summary_en: Xinhua reported that on 13 March 2025 Huang Huang's team at Nanjing University of Chinese Medicine and Hangzhou Maijing Health released an AI system that combines an LLM and a knowledge graph to operationalize formula-person matching.

items.name: 合肥云诊信息科技有限公司重磅发布中医药领域大模型——“云诊华医大模型”
items.summary_zh: 云诊科技官网称，公司基于自研舌诊多模态模型TongueLMM和DeepSeek-R1发布云诊华医大模型，用于辨证论治、体质辨识和诊疗报告生成。
orgs: 合肥云诊信息科技有限公司
items.summary_en: Hefei Yunzhen said it released the Yunzhen Huayi TCM model on its TongueLMM tongue model and DeepSeek-R1 for syndrome differentiation, constitution assessment, and report generation.

items.name: 九为健康联合华为云发布神农中医大模型智能体，解码如何用大模型重构“望闻问切”
items.summary_zh: 凤凰网报道，2025年4月11日华为云生态大会上，九为健康发布基于盘古大模型的九为神农中医大模型智能体，覆盖药物研发、复方优化和辅助诊疗。
orgs: 浙江九为健康科技股份有限公司
items.summary_en: Ifeng reported that on 11 April 2025, at the Huawei Cloud ecosystem conference, Jiuwei Health released the Jiuwei Shennong TCM agent on the Pangu model for drug R&D, formula optimization, and clinical support.

items.name: 国内首个中药学科生成式人工智能教育专用大模型“薪火中国药”智思体1.0版正式发布
items.summary_zh: 北京中医药大学官网称，2025年5月10日发布薪火中国药智思体1.0，依托讯飞星火与DeepSeek，参数超700亿，面向助学、助教、助研、助管和国际合作。
items.summary_en: Beijing University of Chinese Medicine said that on 10 May 2025 it released Xinhuo Zhongguoyao Zhisiti 1.0, a education model of more than 70 billion parameters built on iFlytek Spark and DeepSeek.

items.name: 科技赋能中医药传承创新发展 南京中医药大学“灵山中医”“素山中药”大模型正式发布
items.summary_zh: 南京中医药大学人工智能与信息技术学院页面称，2025年6月6日发布灵山中医大模型（小杏仁）和素山中药大模型（素山智思体），分别服务中医临床教学科研和中药学教学科研。
items.summary_en: Nanjing University of Chinese Medicine said that on 6 June 2025 it released Lingshan TCM Model (Xiao Xingren) and Sushan Chinese Materia Medica Model (Sushan Zhisiti) for clinical, teaching, and research use.

items.name: 数据标注优秀案例集之四十六｜AI数据标注助力中医药领域高质量发展
items.summary_zh: 国家数据局收录成都中医药大学案例：用大模型对996册中医古籍做自动分词和实体识别，并基于ChatGLM-6B关联中医术语、构建穴位-脏腑等知识图谱。
items.summary_en: The National Data Administration listed a Chengdu University of TCM case that uses a large model to segment and tag 996 classical books and ChatGLM-6B to link TCM terms into graphs such as point-organ relations.

items.name: 中医AI大模型问世，传神与湖北中医药大学、湖北时珍实验室合作
items.summary_zh: 湖北日报报道，2025年8月6日湖北中医药大学、湖北时珍实验室与传神语联签约，以传神·素问中医大模型开展产学研用合作。
items.summary_en: Hubei Daily reported that on 6 August 2025 Hubei University of Chinese Medicine, Hubei Shizhen Laboratory, and Transn signed a cooperation agreement centered on the Chuanshen Suwen TCM model.

items.name: 服贸会｜广医·岐智2.0发布，中医最强大脑燃爆服贸会
items.summary_zh: 广安门医院官网称，2025年9月12日服贸会论坛发布广医·岐智2.0，并推出AI医生安安，已出现在门诊导诊屏和预问诊界面。
orgs: 中国中医科学院广安门医院
items.summary_en: Guang'anmen Hospital said that on 12 September 2025, at the CIFTIS forum, it released Guangyi Qizhi 2.0 and the AI doctor An'an, already shown on outpatient guidance and pre-consultation screens.

items.name: 2025服贸会｜中国中医科学院精彩亮相2025服贸会
items.summary_zh: 中国中医科学院官网称，2025年9月10日至14日服贸会上，其智能科学与工程技术研究中心展示大医金匮大语言模型与多轮问诊系统，以及舌诊仪和移动中医智能检测厅。
items.summary_en: The China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences said that at CIFTIS on 10-14 September 2025 its intelligent-science center showed the Dayi Jinkui LLM and multi-turn inquiry system, plus tongue-diagnosis and mobile TCM testing units.

items.name: 学校与郑州市卫健委、郑州市中医院、河南中医药大学数智中医药研究院联合发布“岐黄针灸”大模型
items.summary_zh: 北京科技大学新闻网称，2025年11月2日郑州大会上，学校联合郑州市卫健委、郑州市中医院和河南中医药大学数智中医药研究院发布岐黄针灸大模型，四诊采集后生成针灸处方。
orgs: 郑州市卫生健康委员会
河南中医药大学数智中医药研究院
items.summary_en: USTB said that on 2 November 2025 in Zhengzhou it jointly released the Qihuang Acupuncture model, which turns four-diagnostic readings into acupuncture prescriptions.

items.name: 喜讯！我校“中医药AI模型高质量数据集”项目入选国家人工智能医疗器械揭榜挂帅名单
items.summary_zh: 成都中医药大学官网称，温川飙团队牵头的“中医药AI模型高质量数据集”（项目编号2025-AISJK-02013）入选工信部与药监局2025年度人工智能医疗器械创新任务揭榜名单。
items.summary_en: Chengdu University of TCM said Wen Chuanbiao's team project, a high-quality TCM AI-model dataset numbered 2025-AISJK-02013, was selected for the 2025 MIIT and NMPA AI medical-device challenge list.

items.name: 人工智能+名老中医专家经验数字化传承工作研讨会召开
items.summary_zh: 中国中医药报报道，2026年3月17日研讨会上，中医药信息研究所所长李海燕介绍医源中医大模型已用于医案结构化、智能问诊、处方推荐和中成药合理使用等场景。
orgs: 中国中医科学院中医药信息研究所
items.summary_en: China News of Traditional Chinese Medicine reported that on 17 March 2026 Li Haiyan said the Yiyuan TCM model is being tried for case structuring, intelligent inquiry, prescription recommendation, and rational use of Chinese patent medicines.

items.name: Gancao-TCM-Instruct
items.summary_zh: 甘草中医诊疗指令数据集公开版含 25000 例、125000 条样本，覆盖疾病诊断、证候诊断、治法选择、基础方剂选择和具体中药选择。
items.summary_en: Public Gancao-TCM-Instruct release with 25,000 cases and 125,000 samples covering disease diagnosis, syndrome diagnosis, treatment selection, base-formula selection, and herb selection.

items.name: TriCM-DF Acupuncture Corpus
items.summary_zh: 面向中医大模型的专家审核指令语料，在针灸子领域按共识、专家经验和感知三个维度发布；仓库公开文本表，图像和视频文件不随包提供。
items.summary_en: Expert-verified instruction corpus for TCM models, instantiated for acupuncture across consensus, experiential, and perception tables; the repository releases text, not the image or video files.

items.name: tc_medical_base
items.section: 原始书籍 / 预训练语料
items.summary_zh: 五部中医典籍的条文级语料共 3569 条，并带有 sentence-BERT 向量，书目为宋本伤寒论、桂林古本伤寒杂病论、金匮玉函经、金匮要略方论和傅青主女科。
items.summary_en: Clause-level corpus of five classical TCM texts totaling 3,569 clauses with sentence-BERT embeddings: Song-edition Shanghan Lun, Guilin Shanghan Zabing Lun, Jingui Yuhan Jing, Jingui Yaolue, and Fu Qingzhu Nüke.

items.name: Famous Old TCM Doctors Cases
items.summary_zh: 来源于《当代名老中医典型医案集》的当代名老中医门诊病案，数据卡写明每案含病情描述、辨证论治思路和治疗方药。
items.summary_en: Outpatient cases from Contemporary Famous Old Chinese Medicine Doctors' Typical Cases Collection; the card says each case includes the illness description, syndrome differentiation, and prescriptions.

items.name: TCMLE
items.summary_zh: 中医执业医师与执业助理医师资格考试题库共 7956 题，其中助理医师 2700 题、执业医师 5256 题，含真题和模拟题。
items.summary_en: Chinese TCM practitioner licensing question bank with 7,956 items: 2,700 assistant-practitioner and 5,256 practitioner questions, including past papers and mocks.

items.name: 2023 Pharmacist Licensure Examination TCM Track
items.summary_zh: 2023 年中国执业药师资格考试中药学轨道试题，数据卡写明来自网络收集，并指向 FreedomIntelligence/HuatuoGPT-II 仓库。
items.summary_en: TCM Pharmacy track items from the 2023 Chinese National Pharmacist Licensure Examination; the card says they were collected online and points to FreedomIntelligence/HuatuoGPT-II.

items.name: Taiwan TCM Examination MCQ
items.summary_zh: 来自台湾考选部网站的国家中医考试历届试题，README 写明年份为民国 96 至 111 年且不含 110 年，仓库文件为 basic theory of traditional Chinese medicine.csv。
items.summary_en: Past national TCM exam questions from Taiwan's Ministry of Examination; the README gives ROC years 96–111 excluding 110, and the repository file is basic theory of traditional Chinese medicine.csv.

items.name: JTB Taiwan TCM Exam Questions
items.summary_zh: JTB Tech 整理的台湾考选部中医相关试题，README 写明覆盖民国 90 年至 113 年，科目包括中医内科学、中医基础医学和中医临床医学。
items.summary_en: JTB Tech compilation of Taiwan Ministry of Examination TCM questions for ROC years 90–113, covering TCM internal medicine, basic medicine, and clinical medicine.

items.name: CMMLU Traditional Chinese Medicine
items.summary_zh: CMMLU 中医测试集，数据卡写明可用 load_dataset 加载 185 条样本，文件为 traditional_chinese_medicine.json。
items.summary_en: CMMLU Traditional Chinese Medicine test split; the card shows a 185-example load and the file traditional_chinese_medicine.json.

items.name: Chinese Drug Name Overreliance Set
items.summary_zh: 论文 Do "New Snow Tablets" Contain Snow? 的实验数据，用于检验大模型是否凭名称判断中药成分，卡内链接 arXiv:2504.03786。
items.summary_en: Experiment data for the paper on whether LLMs over-rely on names to identify ingredients of Chinese drugs, linked from the dataset card to arXiv:2504.03786.

items.name: TongueProjectTCM Color Classification
items.summary_zh: TongueProjectTCM 舌图像颜色分类数据，数据卡列出图像和整数标签，训练集 807 条、验证集 121 条。
items.summary_en: TongueProjectTCM tongue-image set whose card lists images and integer labels, with 807 training and 121 validation examples.

items.name: TCM_19W_DataSet-SFT (part)
items.summary_zh: 数据卡写明这是非网络来源的高质量中医指令微调数据的一部分，仓库文件为 TCM19W_Part1.json。
items.summary_en: The card describes a partial non-web TCM instruction-tuning set, released as TCM19W_Part1.json.

items.name: tw-tcm
items.summary_zh: minyichen/tw-tcm 的数据卡给出 8145 条训练样本，字段包括 question、answer、source 和 think。
items.summary_en: minyichen/tw-tcm card lists 8,145 training examples with question, answer, source, and think fields.

items.name: TCM Humanities MCQ
items.summary_zh: 中医药语言模型团队整理的选择题，数据卡写明内容为医学人文、医学伦理和医师法规，来自中国医师资格考试相关题目，规模标注为不到 1000 条。
items.summary_en: Multiple-choice questions on medical humanities, ethics, and physician regulations, curated by the Traditional Chinese Medicine Language Model Team; the card marks the size as under 1,000.

items.name: Cross-linguistic TCM Formula Names
items.summary_zh: 中医方剂名称的跨语言对照表，覆盖中文、日本汉方、韩国韩医和英文，Zenodo 说明依据台湾官方方剂书和常用临床文献整理，文件为 xlsx。
items.summary_en: Cross-linguistic table of TCM formula names in Chinese, Japanese Kampo, Korean Han medicine, and English, compiled from official formularies and clinical references in Taiwan.

items.name: TCM Disease-Pattern-Symptom-Herb KG v2
items.summary_zh: 连接疾病、证候、症状和中药的语义知识图谱 2.0，Zenodo 文件为 node-v2-eng260502.csv 与 edge-v2-eng260502.csv。
items.summary_en: Version 2.0 semantic knowledge graph linking diseases, patterns, symptoms, and herbs, released as node and edge CSV files.

items.name: WHO TCM Terminology LLM Evaluation Set
items.summary_zh: 用于评估大模型充当中医术语评价者的数据，DataCite 说明含 376 条来自 2022 年 WHO 中医国际标准术语的术语对照。
items.summary_en: Evaluation set for using large language models as judges of TCM terminology, containing 376 contrasts from the 2022 WHO International Standard Terminologies on Traditional Chinese Medicine.

items.name: TCM Term Prompt-Language Responses
items.summary_zh: 18 个中医术语在 6 个通用模型、中英马来三种提示语言、各 3 次运行下生成的 972 条模型回答，并附 WHO 2007 与 2022 术语参照。
items.summary_en: 972 model responses for 18 TCM terms across six general-purpose models, three prompt languages (Chinese, English, and Malay), and three runs, with WHO 2007 and 2022 terminology references.

items.name: Chinese Herbal Efficacy Relations
items.summary_zh: 把中药传统功效从自然语言整理成可计算的药–功效关系，DataCite 说明用途包括知识图谱构建、方剂功效预测和药–症关联。
items.summary_en: Structured herb–efficacy relations converted from classical TCM efficacy wording for knowledge-graph construction, formula-efficacy prediction, and herb–symptom association.

items.name: TongueBench
items.summary_zh: 经质量控制的舌象照片集，Zenodo 说明含 2694 张舌照片及文件级元数据，公开文件为 TongueBench Dataset.zip。
items.summary_en: Quality-controlled tongue-image set of 2,694 photographs with file-level metadata; the open file is TongueBench Dataset.zip.

items.name: TCM Knowledge Q&A
items.summary_zh: Science Data Bank 数据集，DataCite 说明以中医经典文献构建，含 6157 条问答知识对。
items.summary_en: Science Data Bank set of 6,157 question-answer pairs built from classic Chinese medicine literature.

items.name: TCM Medical Case Commentary Generation
items.summary_zh: 面向中医医案评注生成的数据，DataCite 说明含 510 条标准化原始医案，以及合计 2550 条的训练和测试实例，材料来自妇科经典。
items.summary_en: Generation set for TCM medical-case commentary, with 510 standardized source cases and 2,550 training and test instances compiled from gynecological classics.

items.name: TCMEFO
items.summary_zh: 中医功效形式化本体，DataCite 说明用于功效概念、关系和中药实例的分层可计算表示。
items.summary_en: Formal ontology for traditional Chinese medicine efficacy, providing a hierarchical computable framework over concepts, relations, and herbal-medicine instances.

items.name: CHM-315
items.summary_zh: 中药材细粒度图像集，DataCite 说明包含 315 类常用中药、共 126000 张图像，每类 400 张。
items.summary_en: Fine-grained Chinese herbal-medicine image set with 315 categories and 126,000 images, 400 images per category.

items.name: HerbPairIAM
items.summary_zh: 汉方复方药物不良反应信号的成分归因数据与模型产物，Zenodo 记录含 HerbPairIAM zip 及 README。
items.summary_en: Data and model artifacts for attributing adverse-reaction signals to components of multi-component Kampo medicines, with a zip archive and README on Zenodo.

items.name: Baize TCM Botanical Origin Images
items.summary_zh: 药用植物基原鉴定图像数据，DataCite 标题写明用于 Baize Traditional Chinese Medicine，包含生境、原植物和药用部位图像，以及依据中国药典、中国植物志和恩格勒系统的中文与拉丁文鉴定信息。
items.summary_en: Medicinal-plant origin images for Baize Traditional Chinese Medicine, covering habitats, original plants, and medicinal parts, with Chinese and Latin identification based on the Chinese Pharmacopoeia, Flora of China, and the Engler system.

items.name: Evaluating Large Language Models for Query Refinement in Systematic Review Retrieval of Traditional Chinese Medicine
items.summary_zh: 作者用GPT-4o、GPT-5、DeepSeek-V3和DeepSeek-R1、六种提示，在知网、万方、PubMed和Embase上检索银屑病、新冠肺炎和2型糖尿病文献；去重后的金标准集有182条记录（分别为50、74和58条）。
orgs: China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences
Hunan University of Traditional Chinese Medicine
items.summary_en: The authors tested GPT-4o, GPT-5, DeepSeek-V3, and DeepSeek-R1 under six prompts for literature retrieval in CNKI, Wanfang, PubMed, and Embase on psoriasis, COVID-19, and type 2 diabetes; the deduplicated gold-standard set contained 182 records (50, 74, and 58).

items.name: Development of an LLM-based CPX Practicing Chatbot for Korean Medicine Education: Implementation of Automated Scoring and Feedback Generation Framework
items.summary_zh: 韩医临床技能考试练习聊天机器人中，Claude-3.5-Sonnet在全部样例上定量评分完全正确，平均耗时43.2秒，快于GPT-4。
items.summary_en: In the Korean-medicine CPX practice chatbot, Claude-3.5-Sonnet scored every sample with perfect quantitative accuracy and averaged 43.2 seconds, faster than GPT-4.

items.name: Knowledge Graphs Combined with ChatGPT in the Field of Acupuncture: A Case Study on the Treatment of Depression
items.venue: International Conference on e-Education, e-Business, e-Management and e-Learning
items.summary_zh: 该研究把针灸原理做成抑郁症知识图谱，并用大语言模型优化知识整合，供研究者和临床医生使用。
items.summary_en: The study built a depression-specific acupuncture knowledge graph and used large language models to optimize knowledge integration for researchers and clinicians.

items.name: A Study on An Intelligent Diagnosis and Treatment Assistant System For Acupuncture in Diminished Ovarian Reserve Based on A Knowledge Graph
items.summary_zh: 作者用大语言模型加人工标注，从82部针灸文献和临床数据中建成含16558个实体、80084条关系的图谱；在90例卵巢储备功能减退患者中，系统辨证与专家的一致率为86.7%。
orgs: Nanjing General Hospital of Nanjing Military Command
items.summary_en: Using large language models plus manual annotation on 82 acupuncture texts and clinical data, the authors built a graph of 16,558 entities and 80,084 relations; on 90 patients with diminished ovarian reserve, diagnostic agreement with experts was 86.7%.

items.name: Supporting postgraduate exam preparation with large language models: implications for traditional Chinese medicine education
items.summary_zh: 在2023年中医考研题上，文心一言准确率50.30%、ChatGLM为46.67%，两者都超过及格线，医学人文模块得分最高。
orgs: Dongzhimen Hospital Affiliated to Beijing University of Chinese Medicine
items.summary_en: On the 2023 Chinese postgraduate examination for traditional Chinese medicine, Ernie Bot scored 50.30% and ChatGLM 46.67%, both above the passing score, with the highest scores in the medical humanities module.

items.name: IC-BERT: An Instruction Classifier Model Alleviates the Hallucination of Large Language Models in Traditional Chinese Medicine
items.venue: IEEE International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Applications (IC
items.summary_zh: IC-BERT用BERT文本过滤器限制中医大模型可回答的问题范围，以减少超出能力范围时生成虚假事实。
items.summary_en: IC-BERT uses a BERT text filter to limit which questions a traditional Chinese medicine large language model may answer, so as to reduce fabricated facts when questions fall outside its capability.

items.name: Dynamic Disease Tracking and Personalized Prescription Recommendation Using Large Language Model in Traditional Chinese Medicine
items.summary_zh: 该系统把多轮问诊和时间序列分析接进大语言模型以推荐个体化中药处方，并在1000例失眠病例上提高了初诊推断、诊断准确性和系统适应性。
orgs: National Taiwan University of Science and Technology
Research Center for Humanities and Social Sciences, Academia Sinica
items.summary_en: The system connects multi-turn consultation and temporal analysis to a large language model for personalized traditional Chinese medicine prescriptions, and on 1,000 insomnia cases it improved initial-case inference, diagnostic accuracy, and adaptability.

items.name: Named Entity Recognition in Traditional Chinese medicine Literature Data for Obesity Based on Large Language Models
items.summary_zh: 在中医肥胖文献实体识别上，经多轮提示优化的DeepSeek-R1在测试集F1达到0.927。
items.summary_en: For named-entity recognition in traditional Chinese medicine obesity literature, prompt-optimized DeepSeek-R1 reached an F1-score of 0.927 on the test set.

items.name: Reunderstanding of the Classification of Syndromes in the Traditional Chinese Medicine Classic “Shang Han Lun” Based on Large Language Models
items.venue: IEEE International Conference on Medical Artificial Intelligence (MedAI)
items.summary_zh: 作者从《伤寒论》三阳病条文中选取10条，用中英文ChatGLM4.0和ChatGPT-4.0按现代医学共识重新归类；四个结果里中文ChatGLM4.0最接近原书三阳分类，英文ChatGLM4.0偏离最大。
orgs: China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences
Wangjing Hospital of China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences
Institute of Basic Theory for Chinese Medicine
items.summary_en: From ten selected Three-Yang passages in Shang Han Lun, Chinese and English ChatGLM 4.0 and ChatGPT-4.0 reclassified cases by modern medical consensus; among the four outputs, Chinese ChatGLM 4.0 was closest to the original Three-Yang grouping and English ChatGLM 4.0 diverged the most.

items.name: Prompt-RAG: Pioneering Vector Embedding-Free Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Niche Domains, Exemplified by Korean Medicine
items.summary_zh: Prompt-RAG不使用向量嵌入，在韩医问答聊天机器人上，其相关性和信息量优于ChatGPT以及基于向量嵌入的检索增强生成。
items.summary_en: Prompt-RAG, which does not use vector embeddings, outperformed ChatGPT and vector-embedding retrieval-augmented generation on relevance and informativeness in a Korean-medicine question-answering chatbot.

items.name: Large Language Models Versus Physicians in Traditional Chinese Medicine: A Real-World Clinical Case Evaluation
items.summary_zh: 作者收集62家医院349例脱敏门诊病例，用其中60例比较16个大语言模型和60名执业中医师，并由5名资深中医专家按9个诊疗维度盲评。
orgs: Yunnan University of Traditional Chinese Medicine
items.summary_en: From 349 de-identified outpatient cases at 62 hospitals, the authors used 60 cases to compare 16 large language models with 60 practicing traditional Chinese medicine physicians, scored blindly by five senior experts across nine diagnostic and therapeutic dimensions.

items.name: A Study of Automated Data Mining of Medication Rules in Traditional Chinese Medicine Prescriptions Based on Large Language Model
items.venue: IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communication Engineering Technolo
items.summary_zh: 作者用大语言模型通过人机问答，对治疗骨质疏松的中药处方做频次、聚类和Apriori关联分析，结果与SPSS人工统计高度相似。
items.summary_en: Through interactive questioning, a large language model ran frequency, clustering, and Apriori association analyses on traditional Chinese medicine prescriptions for osteoporosis, and the automated results were highly similar to manual SPSS statistics.

items.name: Research on the Construction of a Traditional Chinese Medicine Coronary Heart Disease Question-Answering System Integrating Large Language Models and Knowledge Graphs
items.summary_zh: 作者用提示引导大语言模型从近十年8部冠心病中医或中西医结合指南中抽取实体和关系，建成含452个节点、690条关系的知识图谱，并以BERT+CNN做最优意图识别。
orgs: China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences
items.summary_en: Prompted large language models extracted entities and relations from eight coronary-heart-disease guidelines of traditional or integrative Chinese medicine published in the past decade, producing a knowledge graph of 452 nodes and 690 relations, with BERT+CNN selected as the best intent-recognition model.

items.name: Evaluating Semantic Fidelity and Cohesion in NMT and LLM-based Translation of Traditional Chinese Medicine Classics
items.summary_zh: 在中医经典英译上，以BERTScore对照人工参考译文，DeepSeek的语义保真高于Google Translate和ChatGPT-5，而ChatGPT-5的句间语义连贯更好。
items.summary_en: For English translation of traditional Chinese medicine classics, DeepSeek exceeded Google Translate and ChatGPT-5 on BERTScore semantic fidelity to the human reference, while ChatGPT-5 produced more semantically coherent text across sentences.

items.name: Knowledge-guided adaptive educational support for traditional Chinese medicine using large language models and knowledge graphs: integrating Confucian educational principles
items.summary_zh: 该智能中医辅导系统把大语言模型接到由《医宗金鉴》构建的知识图谱上；125名学生志愿者中102份问卷纳入分析，集成系统的即时后测成绩高于纯大语言模型组和自学组。
orgs: Anhui University of Traditional Chinese Medicine
items.summary_en: The intelligent traditional Chinese medicine tutor links a large language model to a knowledge graph from the Golden Mirror of Medicine; of 125 student volunteers, 102 questionnaires were analyzed, and the integrated system produced higher immediate post-test scores than the large-language-model-only group and the self-study group.

items.name: Research on the Organization and Application of Traditional Chinese Medicine Processing Knowledge in Lingnan Herbal Medicine Ancient Texts by Integrating Large Models and Knowledge Graph Technology
items.venue: IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Automation and Computer Engineering
items.summary_zh: 作者用大语言模型和知识图谱整理岭南本草古籍中的药材、炮制方法、辅料和功效，在Neo4j中建图，并结合BERT-CAN-NER与大模型生成做自然语言问答。
items.summary_en: The authors used large language models and a knowledge graph to organize medicinal materials, processing methods, adjuvants, and effects in Lingnan herbal classics, stored the graph in Neo4j, and combined BERT-CAN-NER with generative large models for natural-language question answering.

items.name: Contemporary technological value of ancient Chinese medical books: an empirical patent citation analysis using large language models
items.summary_zh: 该文用大语言模型识别专利引文中的中医实体并分类引用意图；72.9%的专利引用知识融合程度低，《温病条辨》的技术影响排在所评古籍首位。
orgs: China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences
items.summary_en: Large language models recognized traditional Chinese medicine entities and classified citation intent in patents; 72.9% of the patent citations showed low knowledge integration, and Systematic Differentiation of Warm Diseases ranked highest in technological impact.

items.name: A knowledge-enhanced prescription generation model for TCM syndrome differentiation via multilevel memory retrieval
items.venue: International Conference on Optics, Electronics, and Communication Engineering (
items.summary_zh: 该处方生成模型用加权BM25检索相似病例，并接入《本草纲目》药物知识图谱以及十八反、十八畏，再把检索结果交给大语言模型，实验在CCL2025中医基准上进行。
orgs: First Affiliated Hospital of Chengdu Medical College
items.summary_en: The prescription model retrieves similar cases with weighted BM25 and adds a drug knowledge graph from the Compendium of Materia Medica plus the eighteen incompatibilities and eighteen antagonisms, then passes that evidence to a large language model; experiments used the CCL2025 traditional Chinese medicine benchmark.

items.name: Method for Constructing TCM Syndrome Differentiation Q&A System with LLM-RAG
items.summary_zh: 该中医辨证问答框架把整理过的中医知识库通过结构化检索接到大语言模型上，以提高回答的事实准确性、语境精度和专业性。
items.summary_en: The syndrome-differentiation question-answering framework connects a curated traditional Chinese medicine repository to a large language model through structured retrieval, in order to improve factual accuracy, contextual precision, and professional quality.

items.name: Large language models vs traditional Chinese medicine clinical reasoning: Analysis of a single migraine case study
items.summary_zh: 在一份标准化偏头痛病例上，9个大语言模型与两名中医师及已发表病例对照作答，32名专家盲评；GPT o3、Qwen 3和Gemini 2.5 Pro在部分维度上不低于对照，Aya Expanse 32B得分更低。
items.summary_en: On one standardized migraine case, nine large language models were compared with two traditional Chinese medicine physicians and a published case response, scored blindly by 32 experts; GPT o3, Qwen 3, and Gemini 2.5 Pro matched or exceeded selected comparators in some domains, while Aya Expanse 32B scored lower.

items.name: An Intelligent TCM Diagnosis System with Localized LLMs and Modular Multimodal Reasoning Enhanced by RAG
items.summary_zh: 该本地部署系统用望、闻、问、切四个智能体，经模块化组件处理和多模态检索增强生成，把舌象、声音、脉象和症状交给中心推理模块生成诊断与健康建议。
items.summary_en: The locally deployed system uses four agents for inspection, listening, inquiry, and palpation, coordinated by modular component processing and multimodal retrieval-augmented generation, and a central reasoning module turns tongue images, voice, pulse, and symptoms into a diagnosis and health advice.

items.name: Smart Virtual Patients for TCM: Combining Knowledge Graphs and Language Models
items.summary_zh: 该中医虚拟病人把大语言模型和知识图谱与束搜索、Sentence-BERT剪枝结合，症状一致性53.2%、召回率62.5%，均高于提示加知识图谱的基线。
items.summary_en: The traditional Chinese medicine virtual patient combines a large language model and a knowledge graph with beam search and Sentence-BERT pruning, reaching 53.2% symptom consistency and 62.5% recall, both above the prompt-plus-knowledge-graph baseline.

items.name: LLM-Driven Unsupervised Discovery of Semantic Decision Dimensions for Dynamic Scheduling and Intelligent Systems: A Traditional Chinese Medicine Case Study
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek-V3.2从12163条中药记录、64107个短句中归纳出458个原始标签并合并为22个语义类；Qwen3-Embedding-8B测得19个概念的内部一致性平均超过60%，专家合理性均分4.64（1到5分）。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek-V3.2 induced 458 raw labels from 12,163 traditional Chinese medicine herb records and 64,107 short sentences, merged into 22 semantic categories; Qwen3-Embedding-8B found average internal coherence above 60% for 19 concepts, and experts rated reasonableness 4.64 on a 1-to-5 scale.

items.name: Multimodal TCM Seven-Emotion Recognition: A Three-Modality Joint Consultation Framework Based on LLMs and Cross-Attention Fusion
items.summary_zh: 该七情识别框架在IEMOCAP的10593个样本上宏观F1为87.6%，再用冻结的大语言模型把神经预测写成中医辨证报告。
items.summary_en: The seven-emotion framework reached a macro F1 of 87.6% on 10,593 IEMOCAP samples, then used a frozen large language model to turn the neural predictions into traditional Chinese medicine syndrome-differentiation reports.

items.name: Construction of a Knowledge Graph for Functional Specification Standards of Traditional Chinese Medicine Information Systems Based on Large Language Models
items.summary_zh: 作者以中医药信息学会22份中医信息系统功能规范团体标准为语料，用CRISPE框架约束提示，让DeepSeek抽取实体和关系并加规则约束来建知识图谱。
items.summary_en: Using 22 group-standard documents on functional specifications for traditional Chinese medicine information systems, the authors constrained DeepSeek with CRISPE prompts to extract entities and relations and then applied rule-based constraints to build a knowledge graph.

items.name: Performance Assessment of ChatGPT-4.0 and ChatGLM Series in Traditional Chinese Medicine for Metabolic Associated Fatty Liver Disease: Comparative Study
items.summary_zh: 作者把87例经中医治疗的代谢相关脂肪性肝病病历交给ChatGPT-4.0、ChatGLM4、带知识库的ChatGLM4和ChatGLM3-6B，比较辨证论治、中西医概念混淆和治疗方案文本。
items.summary_en: The authors gave medical records of 87 metabolic-dysfunction-associated fatty-liver-disease cases treated with traditional Chinese medicine to ChatGPT-4.0, ChatGLM4, ChatGLM4 with a knowledge base, and ChatGLM3-6B, comparing syndrome differentiation, confusion of Chinese and Western concepts, and treatment-plan text.

items.name: From readable to executable
items.venue: Terminology International Journal of Theoretical and Applied Issues in Specializ
items.summary_zh: 作者用同一套三种提示，让ChatGPT-4o检验世界卫生组织2007年和2022年中医术语标准是否给出了足够明确的信息，以便在并存的英译变体中做可审计的选择。
items.summary_en: Using the same three prompts for each sampled term, the authors tested with ChatGPT-4o whether the WHO 2007 and 2022 traditional Chinese medicine terminology standards give enough explicit information for auditable selection among coexisting English variants.

items.name: TCMRD-KG: Design and Development of a Rheumatism Knowledge Graph Based on Ancient Chinese Literature
items.venue: IEEE International Conference on Medical Artificial Intelligence (MedAI)
items.summary_zh: TCMRD-KG是首个基于中医古籍痹证内容的知识图谱，实体标注结合了主流大语言模型自动标注和人工复核。
orgs: China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences
Institute of Basic Theory for Chinese Medicine
items.summary_en: TCMRD-KG is described as the first rheumatism-specific knowledge graph built from ancient traditional Chinese medicine books, with entity labeling that combines automatic annotation by mainstream large language models and manual review.

items.name: Conveying Imagistic Thinking in Traditional Chinese Medicine Translation: A Prompt Engineering and LLM-Based Evaluation Framework
items.summary_zh: 作者从《黄帝内经》选了四段基础条文，用提示引导DeepSeek V3.1传达隐喻和转喻，再让ChatGPT 5 Pro和Gemini 2.5 Pro模拟三类读者，在五个认知维度上给人工译文、基线译文和提示调整译文打分，提示调整译文全面最好。
items.summary_en: From four foundational passages of Huangdi Neijing, prompt scaffolding guided DeepSeek V3.1 to convey metaphor and metonymy; ChatGPT 5 Pro and Gemini 2.5 Pro then simulated three reader types and scored human, baseline, and prompt-adjusted translations on five cognitive dimensions, with the prompt-adjusted translations best on all five.

items.name: Artificial Intelligence in Traditional Chinese Medicine: Bridging Ancient Practice and Future Innovation
items.summary_zh: 该综述按“构建—应用—挑战—展望”分析中医大模型，并指出Qibo和MedChatZH等系统已经出现，但此前综述缺少对共同特征的综合分析。
items.summary_en: This review analyzes traditional Chinese medicine large language models along construction, application, challenges, and prospects, noting that systems such as Qibo and MedChatZH already exist while earlier reviews lacked a synthesis of shared characteristics.

items.name: Artificial intelligence: A catalyst for the modernization of traditional Chinese medicine
items.summary_zh: 这篇范围综述检索PubMed、Web of Science和中国知网截至2025年的文献，并写道深度学习和大语言模型在舌象分析与辨证上表现有前景，部分研究接近专家水平。
items.summary_en: This scoping review searched PubMed, Web of Science, and CNKI through 2025 and states that deep learning and large language models show promising accuracy on tongue-image analysis and syndrome differentiation, in some studies approaching expert-level performance.

items.name: Domestic and International Research Trends in Artificial Intelligence Applications in Korean Medicine: An Analysis from 2019 to 2025
items.venue: Asia-pacific Journal of Convergent Research Interchange
items.summary_zh: 作者系统回顾了2019至2025年23项韩医人工智能研究（国内10篇、国际13篇），并指出近期工作越来越多使用大语言模型和其他生成式人工智能。
items.summary_en: The authors systematically reviewed 23 Korean-medicine artificial-intelligence studies from 2019 to 2025, ten domestic and thirteen international, and report that recent work increasingly uses large language models and other generative AI.

items.name: From Empirical Wisdom to Computational Intelligence: A Knowledge-Data Dual-Driven Paradigm for Modernizing Traditional Chinese Medicine
items.summary_zh: 该文提出知识与数据双驱动范式：用大规模知识图谱和中医专用大语言模型把隐性经验变成可计算结构，并把四诊数字化为多模态中医表型。
items.summary_en: The paper proposes a knowledge–data dual-driven paradigm that turns implicit traditional Chinese medicine experience into computable structure with large-scale knowledge graphs and TCM-specific large language models, and digitizes the four examinations into a multimodal TCM phenomics.

items.name: XiangShu Omics: A Framework Based on the Spatio–Temporal Field Rhythms of Human Life and Systems Intelligence Methodology
items.summary_zh: 这篇综述首次系统提出象数组学，并写道其大模型按理、法、方、药的经典治疗逻辑整合大语言模型，例如数智岐黄。
items.summary_en: This review says it is the first to systematically construct XiangShu omics, and states that its large model integrates large language models grounded in the classical logic of principle, method, formula, and medicine, such as Shu-Zhi Qihuang.

items.name: Utilizing Large Language Models for Named Entity Recognition in Traditional Chinese Medicine against COVID-19 Literature: Comparative Study
items.summary_zh: 作者整理389篇中医药抗新冠文献，人工标注其中48篇的6类实体；模糊匹配下ChatGPT在6项任务中的5项超过BERT问答模型，精确匹配则相反，且GPT-4在药材、靶点和研究方法上的F1都未超过0.5。
orgs: Institute of Basic Theory for Chinese Medicine
GESIS - Leibniz Institute for the Social Sciences
items.summary_en: The authors assembled 389 articles on traditional Chinese medicine against COVID-19 and manually annotated 48 of them with six entity types; under fuzzy match ChatGPT beat BERT question-answering models on 5 of 6 tasks, while exact match reversed that pattern, and none of GPT-4's F1 scores on herb, target, or research method exceeded 0.5.

items.name: AI-driven multi-scale target analysis of traditional Chinese medicine: From the pharmacological effects of single compounds to the synergistic mechanisms of formulae
items.summary_zh: 这篇中药多尺度靶点分析综述把研发面向中医的专用大语言模型列为未来方向，用来解码中药的药理逻辑。
items.summary_en: This review of multi-scale traditional Chinese medicine target analysis lists the development of TCM-specific large language models among its future directions, in order to decode TCM pharmacological logic.

items.name: Pilot Development of a 'Clinical Performance Examination (CPX) Practicing Chatbot' Utilizing Prompt Engineering
items.summary_zh: 作者把韩国韩医学研究院的标准化病人情景改写成文本，用角色提示和少样本提示调用GPT-4，做成韩医临床技能考试练习聊天机器人；内部评价中正确性和依从性较高，保密性和自然度仍需改进。
items.summary_en: The authors turned a National Institute of Korean Medicine standardized-patient scenario into text and used role prompting and few-shot prompting with GPT-4 to build a Korean-medicine CPX practice chatbot; internal scoring found relatively high correctness and compliance, with confidentiality and naturalness still needing improvement.

items.name: TCMKG: Knowledge-Grounded question answering in Traditional Chinese Medicine via dynamic prompt evolution framework
items.venue: Journal of King Saud University - Computer and Information Sciences
items.summary_zh: TCMKG在新安医案上用专家引导提示抽取实体，建成含37192个实体、130030条关系的中医知识图谱，信息抽取精确率0.89、召回率0.88、F1为0.88。
orgs: Anhui University of Traditional Chinese Medicine
items.summary_en: TCMKG used expert-guided prompting on the Xin'an medical-case corpus to build a traditional Chinese medicine knowledge graph of 37,192 entities and 130,030 relations, with information-extraction precision 0.89, recall 0.88, and F1 0.88.

items.name: Two-Stage Chain-of-Thought Fine-Tuning for TCM Medication Decision-Making in Nsclc
items.venue: IEEE International Conference on Bioinformatics and Biomedicine (BIBM)
items.summary_zh: 针对非小细胞肺癌，两阶段思维链微调在处方生成和中成药推荐上分别比基线提高1.2%和6.1%。
orgs: China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences
items.summary_en: For non-small-cell lung cancer, the two-stage chain-of-thought fine-tuning improved prescription generation and proprietary-Chinese-medicine recommendation by 1.2% and 6.1% over the baseline.

items.name: Fine-Med-Mental-T&P: a dual-track approach for high-quality instructional datasets of mental disorders in traditional Chinese medicine
items.summary_zh: Fine-Med-Mental-T&P用DeepSeek-V3生成、Qwen3-32B改写，从教材指南筛出16000条理论指令，并从600多个真实病例种子筛出4000条实践指令，合成20000条中医神志病指令数据。
orgs: Hunan University of Traditional Chinese Medicine
items.summary_en: Fine-Med-Mental-T&P used DeepSeek-V3 to draft and Qwen3-32B to rewrite answers, screening 16,000 theory instructions from textbooks and guidelines and 4,000 practice instructions from more than 600 real case seeds, for 20,000 instruction pairs on traditional Chinese medicine mental disorders.

items.name: MLLM-Enhanced Region-Aware Bidirectional Evidence-Based Model for Tongue Diagnosis
items.venue: Lecture Notes in Computer Science Medical Image Computing and Computer Assisted Interventi
items.summary_zh: 用多模态大模型做区域感知的双向循证舌诊。
items.summary_en: A multimodal large-model method for region-aware, bidirectional evidence-based tongue diagnosis.

items.name: AI Tongue Diagnosis: Expert System with LLMs for Abdominal Disease Detection Through Mobile App
items.venue: Studies in Rhythm Engineering Cognitive Neuroscience and Artificial Intelligence
items.summary_zh: 用大语言模型做移动端舌诊专家系统，面向腹部疾病检测。
items.summary_en: A mobile tongue-diagnosis expert system that uses large language models to detect abdominal disease.

items.name: Korean Medical Consultation With Open-Weight Large Language Models: Pilot Comparative Evaluation of Retrieval-Augmented Generation With Metadata Filtering
items.summary_zh: 用开源权重大模型和检索增强做韩医问诊聊天机器人，并比较带元数据过滤的检索增强效果。
items.summary_en: An open-weight LLM chatbot for Korean medical consultation, comparing retrieval-augmented generation with metadata filtering.

items.name: Artificial Intelligence in Traditional Chinese Medicine: Multimodal Fusion and Machine Learning for Enhanced Diagnosis and Treatment Efficacy
items.summary_zh: 综述人工智能在中医诊断和治疗中的多模态融合与机器学习。
items.summary_en: Reviews multimodal fusion and machine learning for AI-assisted diagnosis and treatment in traditional Chinese medicine.

items.name: AcuSim
items.summary_zh: 颈颅部穴位定位合成数据集。穴位标注依赖专家且成本高，该数据集用于扩大可检测的穴位定位数据。
items.summary_en: Synthetic dataset for localising cervicocranial acupuncture points, built because expert annotation is costly and limits detector training.

items.name: 传统方剂—疾病关系标注语料
items.summary_zh: 从生物医学文献标注传统方剂与疾病关系的语料，方剂按传统医学原则配伍。
items.summary_en: Annotated corpus of traditional formula–disease relations in biomedical articles. Formulas are herb combinations prepared under traditional medicine principles.

items.name: TCMP-300
items.summary_zh: 用于中药材植物识别的综合图像数据集。
items.summary_en: Image dataset of traditional Chinese medicinal plants for plant recognition.

items.name: 胆石症中医证候代谢组
items.summary_zh: 胆石症患者肝郁气滞与肝胆湿热两种证候的血清和尿液代谢组数据。
items.summary_en: Serum and urine metabolomics for two TCM syndromes in cholelithiasis: liver qi stagnation and liver-gallbladder damp-heat.

items.name: 中药扰动转录组图谱
items.summary_zh: 汇集公开库中的中药处理转录组，用于解释中药干预的分子机制。
items.summary_en: Harmonized transcriptomic atlas of traditional Chinese medicine perturbations, assembled from public treatment experiments.

items.name: 病理标注舌象数据集
items.summary_zh: 带病理标注的中医舌象图像集，用于降低人工舌诊的主观性。
items.summary_en: Tongue-image dataset with pathological annotations for AI-assisted TCM diagnosis.

items.name: TCM-MS2Link
items.summary_zh: 把中药—化合物知识层TCM-MolLink与质谱数据收成可供模型使用的统一数据集。
items.summary_en: AI-ready dataset joining curated herb–compound links (TCM-MolLink) with MS/MS spectra.

items.name: 中医药知识问答实验数据
items.summary_zh: 中医药问答数据集，并带提示工程用的知识图谱、知识库和实验结果。
items.summary_en: Traditional Chinese medicine question-answering set plus the knowledge graph, prompt-engineering code, and experiment outputs.

items.name: 病机思维链证候识别数据
items.summary_zh: 在病机推理思维链监督下构建的证候表现识别数据，含结构化病案、金标准证候标签和模型预测。
items.summary_en: Syndrome-manifestation cases with gold labels and model predictions, built under pathogenesis reasoning chain-of-thought supervision.

items.name: 四模型中文医学文献标引测试集
items.summary_zh: 从100篇随机中文医学研究论文抽取要点，由四个大模型做抽取和摘要并打准确分。
items.summary_en: Key-information extraction and summary scores from four large models on 100 Chinese medical research articles.

items.name: TreeProbe
items.summary_zh: 藏医基准，用来测大模型的文化偏差。
items.summary_en: Tibetan-medicine benchmark for measuring cultural bias in large language models.

items.name: 六经辨证数据集
items.summary_zh: 中医六经辨证数据集。
items.summary_en: Traditional Chinese medicine dataset for six-meridian syndrome differentiation.

items.name: TCMDI
items.summary_zh: 用机器学习预测中药—西药禁忌相互作用的基准。
items.summary_en: Benchmark for predicting contraindicated interactions between traditional Chinese medicines and drugs.

items.name: VietMedKG
items.summary_zh: 越南传统医学知识图谱与基准。
items.summary_en: Knowledge graph and benchmark for traditional Vietnamese medicine.

items.name: A TCM Syndrome Differentiation Thinking Method Based on Chain of Thought and Knowledge Retrieval Augmentation
items.venue: Communications in Computer and Information Science Health Information Processing. Evaluati
items.summary_zh: CotKE-TCM 用思维链提示，并检索相似医案、模型生成的中医知识和临床经验，辅助大模型做辨证；在 CHIP 2024 评测集上测试。
items.summary_en: CotKE-TCM prompts a large language model with chain-of-thought and retrieves similar cases, generated TCM knowledge, and clinical experience for syndrome differentiation, tested on the CHIP 2024 track.

items.name: Chinese Medicine Question Answering Robot Based on RAG and Self-Built Dataset
items.venue: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Machine Learning and Automation, CONF-M
items.summary_zh: 用检索增强生成和自建数据集构建中医问答机器人。
items.summary_en: Builds a traditional Chinese medicine question-answering robot with retrieval-augmented generation and a self-built dataset.

items.name: Generating interpretable clinical reasoning chains in TCM via group relative policy optimization and multi-dimensional rewards
items.summary_zh: 以组相对策略优化和多维奖励，生成可解释的中医临床推理链。
items.summary_en: Generates interpretable traditional Chinese medicine clinical reasoning chains with group relative policy optimization and multi-dimensional rewards.

items.name: Knowledge of Chatbots on Oriental Medicine-Based Theory and Practice of Acupuncture Is Inferior to That on Western Medicine-Based Acupuncture-Transmitted Infections
items.summary_zh: 用 2528 道东方医学针灸理论与操作题、100 道针灸相关感染题，比较 ChatGPT、Claude、Copilot、Gemini 和 Perplexity 的免费版与订阅版；针灸理论中位分 75%，低于感染题的 86%。
items.summary_en: Compares free and subscribed ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, Gemini, and Perplexity on 2,528 oriental-medicine acupuncture theory items and 100 acupuncture-infection items; the median theory score was 75%, below 86% on the infection items.

items.name: 一种基于视觉语言模型的中医舌诊智能分析方法
items.summary_zh: 以Qwen-VL为舌诊视觉语言模型，经舌诊知识引导微调后，由舌象生成舌色、苔色等结构化结果及自然语言描述（公开，未授权）
items.summary_en: Fine-tunes Qwen-VL with tongue-diagnosis prompts so a tongue image yields structured color and coating labels plus a natural-language reading (published, not granted).

items.name: 中医药多模态LLM训练方法及其应用
items.summary_zh: 分别提取舌苔与脉象特征，经跨模态注意力与文本特征融合后接入大语言模型，训练中医药多模态LLM（已授权）
orgs: 粤港澳大湾区精准医学研究院（广州）
items.summary_en: Extracts tongue-coating and pulse features, fuses them with text by cross-modal attention, and trains a multimodal TCM large language model (granted).

items.name: 一种融合舌象、心率及文本的多模态健康状态评估方法
items.summary_zh: 以舌象为主、结合心率和使用者自述文本，用提示词引导DeepSeek大模型生成健康状态评估（公开，未授权）
items.summary_en: Takes tongue image as the main signal, adds heart rate and self-reported text, and prompts DeepSeek to write a health-status assessment (published, not granted).

items.name: 大小模型协同中药方剂优化方法、系统、终端及存储介质
items.summary_zh: 用方剂优化大语言模型给出宏观优化方，再用药效物质小模型溯源药材并调整组成，综合后形成最终方剂推荐（公开，未授权）
orgs: 现代中医药海河实验室
items.summary_en: A formula-optimization LLM proposes a macro revision, a smaller pharmacologic model traces constituent herbs, and the two are merged into a final formula (published, not granted).

items.name: 一种面向中医方剂推荐的知识图谱大模型问答方法及系统
items.summary_zh: 用中文指令大语言模型编码病历语义，与动态中医知识图谱的图向量做门控融合，推荐方剂并生成问答结果（公开，未授权）
items.summary_en: Encodes a case with a Chinese instruction LLM, fuses it with a dynamic TCM knowledge graph, and returns formula recommendations as answers (published, not granted).

items.name: 基于知识图谱与大语言模型的脾胃学派理法方药分析系统
items.summary_zh: 融合脾胃学派知识图谱、向量检索与大语言模型，完成选方验证、安全校验和处方生成（公开，未授权）
orgs: 广州智韵草堂医学科技有限公司
items.summary_en: Combines a spleen-stomach school knowledge graph, vector retrieval, and an LLM for formula selection, safety checks, and prescription writing (published, not granted).

items.name: 基于多源特征融合的中医方剂智能推荐方法、介质和设备
items.summary_zh: 融合内容推荐、协同过滤，并用大语言模型分析症状文本，按加权得分推荐个性化方剂（公开，未授权）
items.summary_en: Blends content-based recommendation, collaborative filtering, and an LLM reading of symptom text to rank personalized formulas (published, not granted).

items.name: 一种基于人工智能的方剂配制方法、系统、介质和设备
items.summary_zh: 用大语言模型从医案实体判定病名与证型并生成初步方剂，再由大语言模型评分，未达标则按结构化建议重新生成（公开，未授权）
items.summary_en: An LLM maps case entities to disease and syndrome, drafts a formula, scores it, and regenerates from structured advice until the score passes (published, not granted).

items.name: 基于生成式模拟医案构建的定制化中医处方推荐大模型
items.summary_zh: 用规则引擎穷举结构化中医特征，再由大语言模型写成模拟医案，并微调得到定制化处方推荐大模型（公开，未授权）
items.summary_en: A rule engine enumerates structured TCM features, an LLM turns them into simulated cases, and those cases fine-tune a customized prescription model (published, not granted).

items.name: 一种融合时空特征的针灸推理模型构建方法、系统及设备
items.summary_zh: 对齐四诊与病程的时空特征，检索历史针灸方案后，用微调大模型和思维链做针灸推理并三维展示（公开，未授权）
items.summary_en: Aligns four-examination and course features, retrieves past acupuncture plans, and uses a fine-tuned LLM with chain-of-thought for an explainable plan (published, not granted).

items.name: 针灸穴位推荐方法及其模型获取方法、装置、设备及介质
items.summary_zh: 用病历对语言模型做初步训练，建立症状与针灸穴位的语义映射，再经参数微调与策略优化得到穴位推荐模型（公开，未授权）
items.summary_en: Trains a language model on medical records so symptoms map to acupuncture points, then applies parameter tuning and policy optimization (published, not granted).

items.name: 一种心血管疾病的基于针灸诊疗知识图谱的智能问答系统
items.summary_zh: 构建心血管疾病针灸诊疗知识图谱，结构化查询结果交云端大语言模型润色；查不到时由大语言模型直接作答并提示仅供参考（公开，未授权）
orgs: 天津中医药大学第一附属医院
items.summary_en: Builds a cardiovascular acupuncture knowledge graph and sends hits to a cloud LLM for wording; if retrieval fails, the LLM answers with a caution (published, not granted).

items.name: 河南健康产业大会展示神农本草大模型与中医经络辅助诊断模型
items.summary_zh: 新华网报道，2025年12月24日河南健康产业大会上，河南省卫生健康委展示中医经络辅助诊断模型和豫产豫药多模态神农本草大模型，后者用于药材识别、真伪鉴别、成分定量和产地溯源。
orgs: 河南省卫生健康委员会
items.summary_en: Xinhua reports that on 24 December 2025 Henan's health commission showed a meridian-assisted diagnosis model and the Yuyao multimodal Shennong materia medica model for herb identification, authentication, assay, and origin tracing.

items.name: 广东省中医院启动名老中医辅助诊疗大模型矩阵
items.summary_zh: 科技日报报道，1月9日广东省中医院启动名老中医辅助诊疗大模型矩阵；禤国维皮肤病诊疗大模型和心血管病诊疗大模型已投入临床。
items.summary_en: Science and Technology Daily reports that on 9 January Guangdong Provincial Hospital of Chinese Medicine launched a matrix of famous-doctor decision models; dermatology and cardiovascular models are already in clinical use.

items.name: 河南省人工智能大会集中发布中药研发大模型等五项中试成果
items.summary_zh: 新华网报道，2026年7月国家人工智能应用中试基地（医疗）在河南省人工智能大会集中发布中医经络辅诊模型、中西医结合食管癌大模型、中医药高质量数据集、中药研发大模型和名中医数字智能体。
orgs: 国家人工智能应用中试基地（医疗领域）
items.summary_en: Xinhua reports that in July 2026 the national medical AI pilot base released five results in Henan, including a meridian-diagnosis model, an esophageal-cancer model, a TCM dataset, a Chinese-medicine R&D model, and a famous-doctor agent.

items.name: 贵州中医药大学第一附属医院发布黔小杏医疗大模型
items.summary_zh: 学校官网称，8月27日“黔小杏医疗大模型”在2026数博会发布，以中医药文献、名医经验和临床数据训练，用于辅助诊断、体质辨识、养生推荐和用药指导。
orgs: 贵州中医药大学第一附属医院
items.summary_en: The university site says the Qian Xiaoxing medical model was released on 27 August 2026, trained on TCM literature, expert experience, and clinical data for diagnosis support, constitution identification, wellness advice, and medication guidance.

items.name: 广州中医药大学杏林智慧教学大模型进入课程试点
items.summary_zh: 南方财经报道，广州中医药大学以通用大模型为基座、用约20亿词元中医药数据持续训练“杏林智慧教学大模型”，已在中医各家学说、中国医学史和中医外科学试点。
items.summary_en: Southern Finance reports that Guangzhou University of Chinese Medicine continued-trains a general model on about 2 billion TCM tokens into the Xinglin teaching model, now piloted in three core courses.

items.name: VTM-TDA Benchmark
items.summary_zh: 从杜德利《越南药用植物与药物》整理的越南传统医学计算基准，含724个已与POWO、PubChem等对齐的基原，以及1635条历史处方。
items.summary_en: A FAIR computational benchmark of Vietnamese traditional medicine digitized from Do Tat Loi's pharmacopoeia, with 724 harmonized botanical entities and 1,635 historical prescriptions.

items.name: TongueAtlas-4K
items.summary_zh: 4000张临床舌象、由中医专家标注22类舌象表现的诊断基准，配套MIRNet（AAAI 2026待发表）。Zenodo记录为受限访问。
items.summary_en: A 4,000-image clinical tongue benchmark with certified TCM expert labels for 22 appearance categories, released for MIRNet (AAAI 2026, to appear). The Zenodo record is restricted.

items.name: 医宗金鉴知识三元组
items.summary_zh: 从《医宗金鉴》抽取的25571条知识三元组，覆盖中药、方剂、疾病、穴位和医理，关系类型1105种。
items.summary_en: 25,571 knowledge triples extracted from the Golden Mirror of Medicine, covering medicinals, formulas, diseases, acupoints, and theory across 1,105 relation types.

items.name: TCM-QM
items.summary_zh: 3196个中药相关分子的气相DFT描述符，并附16918条去重后的草药—分子来源关系。
items.summary_en: Gas-phase DFT descriptors for 3,196 TCM-related molecules, with 16,918 deduplicated herb–molecule provenance links.

items.name: hwtcm-sft-v1
items.summary_zh: 海维团队的中医单轮问答指令集，7096条。语料来自网站、论坛和书籍，由多个模型转成问答，并按专业性、安全性和流畅性评分。
items.summary_en: Haiwei AI Team's 7,096-example TCM instruction set. Text from websites, forums, and books was converted to QA and scored for expertise, safety, and fluency.

items.name: hwtcm-deepseek-r1-distill-data
items.summary_zh: 海维团队用 DeepSeek 从网络原文蒸馏的中医推理问答指令数据。作者说明未经人工审查。
items.summary_en: Haiwei AI Team's DeepSeek-distilled TCM reasoning QA set built from web text. The authors state that it was not manually reviewed.

items.name: 穴位皮肤阻抗的手机脉诊
items.summary_zh: 用指尖按压动脉处皮肤的方式，在穴位上测皮肤阻抗，检验手机做中医脉诊是否可行。
items.summary_en: Feasibility study of TCM pulse diagnosis on a smartphone by measuring skin impedance at acupoints, approximating fingertip pressure over the artery.

items.name: 仿生设备采集中医脉象的规程
items.summary_zh: 给出用仿生脉诊设备把中医脉象信息数字化采集的规程。
items.summary_en: A protocol for digitizing TCM pulse information with bionic pulse-diagnosis equipment.

items.name: 智能脉诊：信号处理与深度学习
items.summary_zh: 用信号处理和深度学习对中医脉诊信号做健康状态分类。
items.summary_en: Signal processing and deep learning for health-status classification from TCM pulse signals.

items.name: 面向糖尿病的中医脉诊卷积神经网络
items.summary_zh: 整理脉诊信号供卷积神经网络使用，以提高中医脉诊判断糖尿病的一致性。脉诊长期依赖指下感觉，重复性差。
items.summary_en: Data processing so a convolutional network can read TCM pulse signals for diabetes, addressing the low repeatability of fingertip pulse diagnosis.

items.name: 舌、声、脉联合的中医体质辨识
items.summary_zh: 把舌象、声音和脉象指标合在一起做中医体质辨识。
items.summary_en: TCM constitution diagnosis that combines tongue, voice, and pulse indices.

items.name: 中医脉诊重测信度与评分者一致性
items.venue: World Journal of Traditional Chinese Medicine
items.summary_zh: 两名印度中医执业者对300名受试者做双侧脉诊，评估重测信度和评分者之间是否一致。
items.summary_en: Test–retest reliability and inter-rater agreement of TCM pulse diagnosis by two practitioners on 300 participants.

items.name: 方剂网络中的十八反与十九畏
items.summary_zh: 用 362 首方剂建成方剂网络，并从化学空间和代谢空间考察十八反、十九畏药对。
items.summary_en: A network of 362 TCM formulas, plus chemical space and metabolism space, used to examine the eighteen antagonisms and nineteen mutual inhibitors.

items.name: ANDERATION：反社区发现用于中药配伍禁忌
items.summary_zh: 按节点的度以及组内度与组外度之比做反社区发现，用来在中药网络里找配伍禁忌。配伍禁忌是组内几乎没有连边、连边多在组外。
items.summary_en: Anti-community detection, using a node's degree and its inner-to-outer degree ratio, applied to herb incompatibility in TCM.

items.name: 从文献为抗抑郁药不良反应寻找中药替代
items.summary_zh: 先从文献找出不良反应明显的西药，再寻找可能减轻这些不良反应的中药。案例是抑郁症用药。
items.summary_en: Literature-based search for TCM alternatives that may lessen adverse reactions of western drugs, with depression treatment as the case.

items.name: KeMRE：中药说明书的知识增强关系抽取
items.summary_zh: 用知识增强的关系抽取，从中药说明书文本中抽出医学关系。
items.summary_en: Knowledge-enhanced relation extraction from Chinese medicine instruction texts.

items.name: 中药化合物的多监管安全评价机器学习框架
items.summary_zh: 从 TCMSP、TCMID、PubChem 和 ChEMBL 汇集 24 种药材的 127 个活性成分，用随机森林，并按 FDA、EMA 和 CFDA 的不同侧重点做安全评分。
items.summary_en: Random-forest safety scoring of 127 bioactive compounds from 24 herbs, drawn from TCMSP, TCMID, PubChem, and ChEMBL, with separate weights for FDA, EMA, and CFDA priorities.

items.name: BioBERT-HDI：草药与化学药相互作用预测
items.summary_zh: 用 BioBERT 从文献文本预测草药和化学药的相互作用，并与其他机器学习模型比较。
items.summary_en: BioBERT predicts herb–drug interactions from the literature and is compared with other machine-learning models.

items.name: 中药安全性研究：方法、应用与展望
items.summary_zh: 综述中药不良反应为何难研究：成分复杂，药物和机体的相互作用也难事先判断，和化学药、生物药的毒性研究不是同一类问题。
items.summary_en: Review of why TCM toxicity is hard to study: multi-component formulas and unpredictable drug–body interactions, unlike chemical or biological drugs.

items.name: 中药计算毒性研究小综述
items.summary_zh: 综述用计算方法研究中药毒性的工作。
items.summary_en: Mini-review of in silico toxicity studies of traditional Chinese herbal medicine.

items.name: 面向临床的中西药联用安全性数智评价
items.summary_zh: 中西药联用的不良反应隐匿、机制复杂，且个体差异大。文章提出一条从智能预测、风险识别、机制验证到数智决策的评价路径，覆盖用药前预警和用药中识别。
items.summary_en: A clinical framework for safety of combined Chinese and western drugs: prediction, risk detection, mechanism checks, and decision support before and during use.

items.name: 中医为何需要可解释人工智能
items.summary_zh: 认为中医人工智能的障碍不只是预测分数，而是数据驱动模型和证候、病机这类理论推理对不上，所以需要可解释性。
items.summary_en: Argues that TCM AI is limited by a mismatch between statistical models and syndrome-based reasoning, so explanations are required.

items.name: TCM4NSCLC
items.summary_zh: 一位资深中医门诊的非小细胞肺癌真实世界记录，整理成可计算数据，用于辨证、处方，以及真实世界疗效和亚组分析。
items.summary_en: Computable real-world outpatient records from one senior TCM physician on non-small-cell lung cancer, for syndrome differentiation, prescription, and real-world effectiveness.

items.name: 脉诊机器学习识别妊娠与冠心病
items.summary_zh: 用 MEMS/CMOS 便携脉诊仪采集健康女性、冠心病女性和孕早期女性的脉图，再用机器学习区分妊娠和冠心病。
items.summary_en: A portable MEMS/CMOS pulse device records healthy women, women with coronary heart disease, and women in the first trimester, then machine learning separates pregnancy from coronary heart disease.

items.name: TPC-GCN：中医脉象分类
items.summary_zh: 先用改进的 SMOTE 扩充脉象样本，再提取多域特征，用图卷积网络做中医脉象分类。
items.summary_en: Improved SMOTE augments pulse samples, multi-domain features are extracted, and a graph convolutional network classifies TCM pulse patterns.

items.name: 基于中医脉诊矩阵的客观脉象分析
items.venue: Medicine in Novel Technology and Devices
items.summary_zh: 用中医脉诊矩阵做客观脉象分析。文章认为现有脉图定义不完整，客观化标准也不统一。
items.summary_en: Objective pulse analysis with a TCM pulse matrix. The authors argue that current waveform definitions and objectification standards are incomplete.

items.name: 桡动脉脉搏波识别多囊卵巢综合征
items.summary_zh: 用桡动脉脉搏波参数和机器学习区分多囊卵巢综合征与健康人，共 459 名受试者，用来把中医脉诊客观化。
items.summary_en: Machine learning on radial pulse-wave parameters separates polycystic ovary syndrome from healthy controls in 459 subjects, as a step toward objective TCM pulse diagnosis.

items.name: 桡动脉脉搏波的高血压机器学习分类
items.summary_zh: 用机器学习比较 450 名高血压患者和 479 名健康人的桡动脉脉搏波，为中医脉诊提供客观参照。
items.summary_en: Machine-learning comparison of radial pulse waves from 450 people with hypertension and 479 healthy people, as an objective reference for TCM pulse diagnosis.

items.name: 希尔伯特–黄变换与随机森林的冠心病脉象识别
items.summary_zh: 用希尔伯特–黄变换提取中医脉象的能量和样本熵，再用随机森林区分冠心病患者和健康人。
items.summary_en: Hilbert–Huang energy and sample entropy of TCM pulse signals, classified with a random forest to separate coronary heart disease from healthy people.

items.name: 深度卷积网络分析腕部脉波
items.summary_zh: 用香农能量包络和希尔伯特变换抽出腕部脉波，再用深度卷积网络做中医脉诊识别。
items.summary_en: Shannon energy envelope and the Hilbert transform extract the wrist pulse, then a deep convolutional network recognizes it for TCM pulse diagnosis.

items.name: 脉搏压力波与妊娠的机器学习对应
items.summary_zh: 用深度学习把脉搏压力波和是否妊娠对应起来。文中妊娠识别准确率 84%，AUC 91%。用的是压力波，不是中医脉象的位、数、形、势。
items.summary_en: Deep learning relates the pulse pressure wave to pregnancy. The paper reports 84% accuracy and an AUC of 91%. The signal is the pressure wave, not the TCM pulse qualities of position, rate, shape, and force.

items.name: 统计特征与 MobileViT 的中医面色分类
items.summary_zh: 用统计特征和 MobileViT 做中医面色自动分类。
items.summary_en: Statistical features and MobileViT for automatic TCM facial-complexion classification.
