items.name: 模糊支持向量机的中医面色识别
items.summary_zh: 分割面颊后，用基于颜色建模的模糊支持向量机识别中医面色，以降低离群点的影响。
items.summary_en: After cheek segmentation, a fuzzy support vector machine with color modeling recognizes TCM facial complexion and reduces the effect of outliers.

items.name: 彩色人脸特征的中医体质分类
items.venue: Journal of Traditional Chinese Medical Sciences
items.summary_zh: 采集 5150 人的彩色人脸图像，检测人脸并定位关键点，用面部特征做中医体质分类。
items.summary_en: Color face images of 5,150 people, with face detection and landmarks, used to classify TCM constitution from facial features.

items.name: 中医面色的定性与定量分析
items.summary_zh: 用计算机对面色的颜色和光泽做定性和定量识别，以减少只靠经验望诊的主观性。
items.summary_en: Computerized qualitative and quantitative recognition of facial color and gloss, reducing the subjectivity of experience-based face diagnosis.

items.name: 计算机视觉的中医面色识别
items.summary_zh: 用深度学习定位 68 个面部关键点，分割庭、颊、明堂等区域，再按多颜色空间的直方图识别中医面色。
items.summary_en: Deep learning finds 68 facial landmarks, segments regions such as the ting, cheeks, and mingtang, then reads TCM complexion from color histograms.

items.name: Jiezhai Gong 妇产科医案知识图谱
items.venue: International Conference on Biomedical and Intelligent Systems
items.summary_zh: 用 Neo4j 构建 Jiezhai Gong 妇产科医案知识图谱。
items.summary_en: A Neo4j knowledge graph of Jiezhai Gong's obstetric and gynecological case records.

items.name: 可解释图神经网络量化中药配伍
items.summary_zh: 在中医药多维知识图谱上，用可解释图神经网络量化配伍。图谱把术语和饮片连起来，药性作为虚拟节点；在 6080 首方上评估饮片在方中的作用，并用 215 首新冠相关方做验证。
items.summary_en: Interpretable graph neural networks quantify herb compatibility on a multidimensional TCM knowledge graph. Medicinal properties are virtual nodes. The study assesses herbal pieces in 6,080 formulas and checks 215 COVID-19 formulas.

items.name: 可解释框架量化中医症状–方药对应
items.summary_zh: 用古代和经典方剂记录训练模型，把症状模式对应到个体化方药这条原则量化，以便和现代生物医学对照。
items.summary_en: A model trained on ancient and classical formula records quantifies the TCM mapping from symptom patterns to individualized herbal therapy, for comparison with modern biomedicine.

items.name: 用《伤寒论》检验八纲表里辨证
items.summary_zh: 用《伤寒论》的经验数据，把八纲里的表里看成降维，检验表里是否包含最多的症状信息、是否更抽象，以及是否有助于选方。
items.summary_en: Using empirical records from the Shanghan Lun, treats the exterior–interior pair of the Eight Principles as dimensionality reduction and tests whether it carries the most symptom information, is the most abstract, and helps formula choice.

items.name: 糖尿病证候的多实例多任务卷积网络
items.summary_zh: 把糖尿病患者的病历当成一维图像、症状当成像素，用多实例多任务卷积网络先找出相关症状，再对应到证候。
items.summary_en: Treats a diabetic patient's record as a one-dimensional image and symptoms as pixels. A multi-instance multi-task convolutional network finds relevant symptoms and maps them to syndromes.

items.name: 赵汉青门诊处方（2025）
items.summary_zh: 赵汉青 2025 年中医内科门诊的去标识处方：122 名患者、335 张处方、5951 条药味记录，每味药有克剂量。初诊 75 张、复诊 260 张。给药途径以口服汤剂为主（315 张），另有冲服 8 张、外洗 8 张、外用 4 张。每日两次 333 张，每日三次 2 张。药名里能看到炮制写法，含「炒」412 行、「炙」341 行、「麸」289 行、「醋」164 行、「姜」154 行、「酒」89 行、「煅」67 行、「制」63 行，另有法半夏 99 行；同一行可以同时含多个字。CC BY 4.0。仓库说明就诊机构为 Beijing Heniantang Hospital。
items.summary_en: De-identified 2025 internal-medicine outpatient prescriptions from Zhao Hanqing: 122 patients, 335 prescriptions, and 5,951 herb rows with gram doses. 75 are initial visits and 260 are follow-ups. Routes: 315 oral decoctions, 8 oral dissolved, 8 external washes, and 4 external uses. Dosing is twice daily in 333 prescriptions and three times daily in 2. Herb-name rows containing processing marks, which can overlap: stir-fried 412, honey-fried 341, bran 289, vinegar 164, ginger 154, wine 89, calcined 67, prepared 63, and processed Pinellia (Fa Ban Xia) 99. CC BY 4.0. The repository describes the clinic as Beijing Heniantang Hospital.

items.name: TCMCPD
items.summary_zh: 从病案整理的结构化库：4895 名患者、12900 次就诊、712 味中药，就诊–证候 11879 条，就诊–药味 63192 条。剂量单位以克为主（61386），另有钱 1067、枚 364、片 240、两 69、分 64、毫升 2。并连接症状、成分和靶点，附 Neo4j 节点和边。作者说明不转发受版权限制的医案原文。描述稿目前是 Research Square 预印本。
items.align_note: visits.csv 含 content 字段；README 提示公开前需核对病案原文版权。药味剂量列已在 visit_herb.csv 核对。
items.summary_en: Structured case-derived tables: 4,895 patients, 12,900 visits, 712 herbs, 11,879 visit–syndrome links, and 63,192 visit–herb rows. Dose units are mostly grams (61,386), plus 1,067 qian, 364 pieces, 240 tablets, 69 liang, 64 fen, and 2 millilitres. Rows also link symptoms, ingredients, and targets, with Neo4j files. Full copyrighted case texts are not redistributed. The describing manuscript is a Research Square preprint.

items.name: 针灸临床实践指南数据集
items.summary_zh: 把针灸临床实践指南整理成数据集，以便在临床上直接使用。
items.summary_en: A dataset of acupuncture clinical practice guidelines, released to make the guidelines easier to use in clinic.

items.name: 中医药中英术语数据集
items.summary_zh: 中国科学数据发布的中医药中英术语对照数据集。
items.summary_en: A Chinese–English terminology dataset for traditional Chinese medicine, published in China Scientific Data.

items.name: 健康成人韩医诊察数据集
items.summary_zh: 先从文献抽出韩医诊察指标，经三轮专家意见形成方案，再在韩医医院连续四年采集健康成人的诊察数据。
items.summary_en: A traditional Korean medicine examination protocol, built from the literature and three rounds of expert review, with healthy-adult examination data collected over four years.

items.name: 中医病历症状名自动规范化
items.summary_zh: 把中医电子病历里的症状名自动规范到统一术语，以便从病历而不是只从手工整理的方剂里做挖掘。
items.summary_en: Automatically maps symptom names in TCM electronic records onto a unified terminology, so mining can use clinical records rather than only manually extracted formulas.

items.name: 中医病历症状规范化的自动方法
items.venue: Communications in Computer and Information Science
items.summary_zh: 讨论如何自动把中医病历中的症状名规范化。
items.summary_en: Automated methods for normalizing symptom names in traditional Chinese medicine records.

items.name: 中医症状的细粒度实体与关系抽取
items.venue: BMC Medical Informatics and Decision Making
items.summary_zh: 针对病历里半结构化、会嵌套的症状描述，做细粒度症状实体和关系抽取，避免粗标注把信息丢掉。
items.summary_en: Fine-grained extraction of nested symptom entities and relations from semi-structured TCM records, avoiding the loss from coarse labels.

items.name: ICD-11 传统医学章与 SNOMED CT 的本体对照
items.venue: Studies in Health Technology and Informatics
items.summary_zh: 把 ICD-11 第26章的传统医学条目和 SNOMED CT 对照，用来建传统医学本体。
items.summary_en: Compares traditional medicine entries in ICD-11 Chapter 26 with SNOMED CT in order to build a traditional-medicine ontology.

items.name: 《伤寒论》知识图谱
items.summary_zh: 构建《伤寒论》知识图谱，并给出应用。
items.summary_en: Constructs a knowledge graph of the Treatise on Febrile Diseases and reports an application.

items.name: 《伤寒论》问题意图分类（TinyBERT-CNN）
items.summary_zh: 用 TinyBERT 和卷积神经网络融合，对《伤寒论》里的问题做意图分类。
items.summary_en: Classifies the intent of questions about the Treatise on Febrile Diseases with a TinyBERT and convolutional network.

items.name: 由多尺度面容生成中药处方
items.summary_zh: 用卷积网络从多尺度面部特征生成中药处方。此前处方生成多只看症状，这篇挖掘面容和处方的关系。
items.summary_en: A convolutional model that builds an herbal prescription from multi-scale facial features, rather than from symptoms alone.

items.name: 舌、面与舌下融合识别糖尿病
items.summary_zh: 融合舌象、面容和舌下图像，识别糖尿病及其早期的糖调节受损。中医望诊把这几处当作无创依据，此前工作多只看单一模态。
items.summary_en: Fuses tongue, face, and sublingual images to detect diabetes and impaired glucose regulation. Earlier work used only one of these views.

items.name: 用伽马密度拟合中医脉图
items.summary_zh: 把中医脉图当作波形，用多维变量分析，以伽马密度函数拟合脉图，用来形成可计算的脉象分类指标。
items.summary_en: Fits Chinese pulse waveforms with collective gamma density functions to produce quantitative classification indices.

items.name: 白睛异常分割（HD-DinoMoE）
items.summary_zh: 中医目诊看白睛缺少定量。这篇用分层混合专家网络，在复杂拍摄条件下分割巩膜表面异常。
items.summary_en: Segments scleral-surface anomalies with a hierarchical mixture-of-experts network, to quantify TCM inspection of the whites of the eyes.

items.name: 深度强化学习的序贯中药治疗规划
items.summary_zh: 把慢性病的中药治疗看成多次就诊上的序贯决策，用深度强化学习规划后续处方，而不是只给一次方。
items.summary_en: Plans sequential herbal prescriptions across visits for chronic disease with deep reinforcement learning, rather than a single prescription.

items.name: 多模态中医体质端到端评估
items.summary_zh: 端到端评估中医体质。输入包括面象、舌象、脉和声音，以及问诊文本。
items.summary_en: End-to-end TCM constitution assessment from face and tongue images, pulse and voice, and inquiry text.

items.name: 按中医问诊思路做的证候辨证
items.summary_zh: 按中医问诊的思路做个性化证候辨证，针对计算问诊里追问不足、缺少问诊原则的问题。
items.summary_en: Syndrome differentiation that follows TCM inquiry, aimed at consultation systems that ask too little and ignore inquiry principles.

items.name: 汉方问诊虚拟病人
items.summary_zh: 构建汉方问诊的虚拟病人，用来加强对汉方病机概念的理解和共情。
items.summary_en: A virtual patient for Kampo medical interviews, intended to support empathy and the pathological concepts used in Kampo.

items.name: 高血压的中医面色分类
items.summary_zh: 建立用于高血压的中医面色分类模型。
items.summary_en: A classification model for TCM facial-color diagnosis of hypertension.

items.name: Wasserstein GAN 扩充腕部脉象
items.summary_zh: 用 Wasserstein GAN 为中医腕部脉象信号做数据增强。
items.summary_en: Wasserstein GAN augmentation of wrist-pulse signals for traditional Chinese medicine.

items.name: 高血压患者的寸口脉与脉搏波
items.summary_zh: 在高血压患者中，把中医寸口脉诊和脉搏波、血流动力学放在一起看二者是否相关。
items.summary_en: Compares TCM wrist pulse-taking with pulse-waveform analysis and hemodynamics in people with hypertension.

items.name: 自适应神经模糊推理的中医睡眠障碍诊断
items.summary_zh: 用自适应神经模糊推理系统做中医睡眠障碍诊断。
items.summary_en: Uses an adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system to diagnose sleep disorders in a traditional Chinese medicine setting.

items.name: TCMToxDB
items.summary_zh: 中药毒性与安全使用数据库，区分方剂、饮片和成分的毒性，并按毒性表现整理靶点。站内集成五种药–靶、成分–靶预测算法。
items.summary_en: A toxicity database that separates toxic effects of formulas, herbs, and ingredients, and gathers targets for specific toxic manifestations. Five herb–target and ingredient–target prediction algorithms are included. Site: https://www.sdu-idea.cn/TCMToxDB.

items.name: MetaAcuPoint
items.summary_zh: 用 Unreal Engine 的 MetaHuman 生成 900 张手部图像，按骨骼插槽标注 5 个手部穴位，供韩医穴位定位使用。
items.summary_en: 900 synthetic RGB hand images from MetaHuman avatars in Unreal Engine, with bone-attached sockets for five hand acupoints used in Korean medicine.

items.name: 中药异构网络结构集
items.summary_zh: 汇总生物医学里常见的异构网络，其中包括药–靶、药–症状、药–药和症状–症状网络，也含蛋白质相互作用网络。
items.summary_en: Heterogeneous biomedical graphs that include herb–target, herb–symptom, herb–herb, and symptom–symptom networks, together with protein–protein interaction networks.

items.name: 东亚传统医学如何进入国际卫生信息标准
items.summary_zh: 范围综述：检索 2016 年 1 月至 2026 年 3 月的英文文献，看韩医、中医和汉方概念怎样映射进主流卫生信息标准。
items.summary_en: Scoping review of English reports from January 2016 to March 2026 on how Korean medicine, TCM, and Kampo concepts are mapped into mainstream health-informatics standards.

items.name: 深度学习穴位定位综述
items.summary_zh: 按身体部位、网络结构、定位策略和图像模态，综述深度学习穴位定位的数据集、指标和适用场景。
items.summary_en: Review of deep-learning acupoint localization, grouped by body region, architecture, strategy, and image modality, including datasets and metrics.

items.name: 计算机辅助穴位定位系统综述
items.summary_zh: 系统综述用传统算法和深度学习在不同解剖区域做穴位定位的研究，并讨论效果和限制。
items.summary_en: Systematic review of traditional algorithms and deep learning for acupoint localization across anatomical regions.

items.name: 胸痹/冠心病的中西医数据治理
items.summary_zh: 以胸痹（冠心病）为例，按 HL7 FHIR 和 SNOMED CT 建了 9 个子集、352 个数据元，其中 42.6% 是中医专用。触发引擎有 128 条规则。前瞻对照纳入 972 人。
items.summary_en: For chest bi syndrome and coronary heart disease, a FHIR and SNOMED CT data system with 9 subsets and 352 elements, 42.6% of them TCM-specific, plus a 128-rule trigger engine. A prospective controlled study enrolled 972 people.

items.name: GB/T 31774 与 ISO 18668 中药编码对照
items.venue: China Journal of Chinese Materia Medica
items.summary_zh: 对照中国国家标准 GB/T 31774-2015 和国际标准 ISO 18668 第 1 至第 4 部分的中药编码，说明相同和不同之处。
items.summary_en: Compares the Chinese national coding standard GB/T 31774-2015 with ISO 18668 parts 1–4 for Chinese medicines.

items.name: GB/T 12346-2021 经穴名称与定位解读
items.summary_zh: 解释国家标准《经穴名称与定位》（GB/T 12346-2021）相对 2006 版的变化，包括标准名称、术语、定义、部位表述，以及部分穴位骨度分寸和定位。
items.summary_en: Explains what changed in GB/T 12346-2021, Nomenclature and Location of Meridian Points, relative to the 2006 edition, including terms, definitions, body regions, and bone-proportional cun.

items.name: ICD-10 疾病与汉方寒热虚实的对应
items.summary_zh: 在一家大型汉方门诊，把 2014 年 10 月至 2019 年 6 月、20 岁及以上患者的 ICD-10 诊断，对照到 ICD-11 传统医学里的寒热、虚实等模块。
items.summary_en: At a Kampo clinic, relates ICD-10 diagnoses of patients aged 20 or older, seen from October 2014 through June 2019, to ICD-11 traditional-medicine modules such as heat–cold and excess–deficiency.

items.name: 对 ICD-11 第26章传统医学条目的增补建议
items.summary_zh: ICD-11 第26章来自 WHO 西太区传统医学术语标准，是中日韩分类的并集。文章建议在保留已收录证候的同时补充仍缺的证候。
items.summary_en: Argues that ICD-11 Chapter 26, drawn from the WHO international standard terminologies, should keep the adopted patterns and add essential patterns that are still missing.

items.name: PIPE-11：落地 ICD-11 传统医学章的临床决策支持
items.summary_zh: 介绍 Pattern Identification and Prescription Expert-11，用辨证和处方文献把 ICD-11 传统医学章做成可计算的临床决策支持。
items.summary_en: Pattern Identification and Prescription Expert-11, a decision-support system for putting the ICD-11 traditional medicine chapter into computable pattern identification and prescription.

items.name: STC-NF：中医症状术语两段式规范化
items.summary_zh: 针对一条原文对应多个症状、缺少行业标准术语的问题，先把症状拆成 12 类细粒度语义，再用三个命名实体识别模型做两段式规范化，拼回标准术语。数据来自电子病历。
items.summary_en: Split-then-concatenate normalization of TCM symptom terms from electronic records: 12 fine-grained semantic labels, three named-entity recognizers, and a two-stage deep-learning model.

items.name: 中医证候诊断标准适用性评价指南
items.summary_zh: 用德尔菲法给出证候诊断标准的适用性评价指南，共 5 个域、25 条：可获得性、可读性、可实施性、可接受性和总评。每条按 5 点量表打分。
items.summary_en: A Delphi guideline for judging whether TCM syndrome diagnostic criteria are usable: 5 domains and 25 items, scored on a 5-point scale. Domains are accessibility, readability, implementability, acceptability, and overall evaluation.

items.name: 国际疾病分类与传统医学数据缺口
items.venue: Bulletin of the World Health Organization
items.summary_zh: 讨论国际疾病分类体系里传统医学数据仍然缺失的问题。
items.summary_en: Discusses data gaps for traditional medicine in the International Statistical Classification of Diseases.

items.name: 《伤寒论》异构图与图卷积表示
items.summary_zh: 为《伤寒论》构建异构图，并用图卷积网络学习节点表示。
items.summary_en: Builds a heterogeneous graph of the Treatise on Febrile Diseases and learns node representations with a graph convolutional network.

items.name: 用自然语言处理挖掘《伤寒论》
items.venue: World Journal of Traditional Chinese Medicine
items.summary_zh: 用自然语言处理对《伤寒论》做文本挖掘和分析。
items.summary_en: Text mining and analysis of the Treatise on Febrile Diseases with natural language processing.

items.name: 温病文献的 BERT 命名实体识别
items.summary_zh: 用 BERT 识别中医温病文献中的命名实体。
items.summary_en: BERT named-entity recognition for warm-disease texts in traditional Chinese medicine.

items.name: 模仿肺癌中医辨证的端到端模型
items.summary_zh: 训练端到端模型，模仿中医在肺癌诊断中的证候辨证。
items.summary_en: End-to-end models trained to imitate traditional Chinese medicine syndrome differentiation in lung cancer diagnosis.

items.name: 《伤寒论》的复杂网络模型
items.summary_zh: 用复杂网络描述《伤寒论》的结构。
items.summary_en: A complex-network model of the Treatise on Cold Damage.

items.name: 《温热经纬》与《伤寒论》方剂网络
items.summary_zh: 对《温热经纬》和《伤寒论》中的方剂做网络分析。
items.summary_en: Network analysis of herbal formulas from Wenre Jingwei and the Shanghan Lun.

items.name: 知识图谱增强的长尾证候辨证
items.summary_zh: 用知识图谱增强长尾学习，做中医证候辨证。
items.summary_en: Knowledge-graph-enhanced long-tail learning for traditional Chinese medicine syndrome differentiation.

items.name: TCMKD 中医药知识发现平台
items.summary_zh: 手工校对后汇集证候、方剂、中成药、药材、成分、靶点和疾病。平台提供挖掘、富集和网络定位分析。
items.summary_en: A proofread platform of syndromes, formulas, Chinese patent drugs, medicinal materials, ingredients, targets, and diseases, with mining, enrichment, and network analysis. https://cbcb.cdutcm.edu.cn/TCMKD/

items.name: TCM-BERT-CNN 整体证候分类
items.summary_zh: 从公开指南和教材整理专家知识，用 BERT 和卷积神经网络，由症状直接预测多个证候，并用十折交叉验证。
items.summary_en: BERT and a convolutional network that map symptoms to multiple syndromes, using expert knowledge from public guidelines and textbooks and ten-fold cross-validation.

items.name: GNN-BERT 的症状–穴位推荐
items.summary_zh: 用异构图和图神经网络，再配合微调的 BERT，建模症状和穴位的配伍，用来推荐穴位。
items.summary_en: Models symptom–acupoint compatibility with a heterogeneous graph and a fine-tuned BERT, for acupoint recommendation.

items.name: 红外热像面部穴位两级定位
items.summary_zh: 按骨度分寸和中医解剖规则整理多姿态红外面部热像，先检测人脸，再回归穴位位置。
items.summary_en: A two-stage detector and regressor that localizes facial acupoints on multi-pose infrared thermal images, using bone-proportional cun and TCM anatomical rules.

items.name: 中药化学成分毒性实验库
items.summary_zh: 从公开毒理学文献整理的中药化学成分毒性实验记录，含体内和体外实验。示例药物包括闹羊花、斑蝥、巴豆、洋金花、附子和轻粉。字段有给药途径、实验物种、LD50 等毒性指标、毒性剂量、靶器官和病理表现，并保留 PMID。
items.summary_en: Literature-derived in vivo and in vitro toxicity experiments for chemical constituents of traditional Chinese medicines, including Naoyanghua, Banmao, croton, Yangjinhua, Fuzi, and Qingfen. Fields cover route, species, indicators such as LD50, toxic dose, target organ, pathology, and PMID.

items.name: 治法–处方与药材剂量表
items.summary_zh: 仓库说明写有 23 类治法、400 多个治法亚类、4174 种常用药材及其剂量和来源，经典方 900 首以上，处方特征分 21 类。仓库里有 Treatment.csv 和《治法-处方数据集总表》。
items.summary_en: The repository readme describes 23 treatment methods, more than 400 subcategories, 4,174 common medicinal materials with doses and sources, and more than 900 classic formulas, with 21 feature categories. Files include Treatment.csv and a treatment–prescription workbook.

items.name: SYD_NK 内科证候测试集
items.summary_zh: 366 条中医内科证候测试样本，每条是证候名加一段第一人称症状叙述。作者说明材料来自《中医内科学》，由中医学生校对，用于证候辨证。Apache-2.0。
items.summary_en: 366 TCM internal-medicine test items. Each item is a syndrome name plus a first-person symptom narrative. The card says the text was cleaned from an internal-medicine textbook and checked by TCM students. Apache-2.0.

items.name: TCMM 中药现代化统一数据库
items.summary_zh: 提出一个面向中药现代化和治疗创新的统一数据库。
items.summary_en: A unified database aimed at modernization of traditional Chinese medicine and therapeutic innovation.

items.name: 台湾草药不良反应报告系统（1998–2016）
items.summary_zh: 介绍台湾 1998 年至 2016 年用于报告和评估草药不良反应的系统。
items.summary_en: A system for reporting and evaluating adverse reactions to herbal medicine in Taiwan, covering 1998–2016.

items.name: UniTCM
items.summary_zh: 把方剂和疾病对应到分子层面的反向药理学平台，包含标准化、临床发现、分子分析、系统核对和分析工具五层。
items.summary_en: A reverse-pharmacology platform that links formulas and diseases to molecular findings, with layers for standardization, clinical discovery, molecular analysis, systems checks, and tools.

items.name: IHPreten：配伍禁忌药对预测
items.summary_zh: 用带属性正则的监督学习框架，预测中药里的配伍禁忌药对。
items.summary_en: A supervised model with attribute regularization that predicts incompatible herb pairs in traditional Chinese medicine.

items.name: 含反药的附子处方关联规则
items.venue: China Journal of Chinese Materia Medica
items.summary_zh: 用关联规则分析不同地区含配伍禁忌药的附子处方，并归纳这些配伍的特点。
items.summary_en: Association-rule analysis of aconite prescriptions that contain incompatible herbs, comparing regions and compatibility features.

items.name: 妊娠禁忌中药概述
items.summary_zh: 书中一章，概述妊娠期间禁用的中药。
items.summary_en: A book chapter surveying Chinese medicines that are contraindicated in pregnancy.

items.name: 中药处方剂量分配的模糊分析
items.summary_zh: 用模糊分析讨论中药处方里的剂量分配。
items.summary_en: Fuzzy analysis of how doses are allocated inside a traditional Chinese medicine prescription.

items.name: 异构网络预测中药毒性
items.summary_zh: 用异构网络预测中药毒性。
items.summary_en: Predicts traditional Chinese medicine toxicity with a heterogeneous network.

items.name: 古代经典名方关键信息表
items.venue: 国家中医药管理局 / 国家药品监督管理局
items.summary_zh: 官方公布的经典名方关键信息，不是患者病历。三份通知分别是 2020 年 7 首、2023 年「竹叶石膏汤」等 25 首、2025 年「旋覆代赭汤」等 43 首。2025 年附表逐味给出基原、炮制规格和折算剂量。旋覆代赭汤中甘草为炒甘草 41.40 克、半夏为清半夏 34.50 克；全方以水 2000 毫升煮取 1200 毫升，去渣再煎至 600 毫升，每次温服 200 毫升、日三服。
items.summary_en: Official key-information tables for ancient classic formulas, not patient records. The notices cover 7 formulas in 2020, 25 including Zhuye Shigao Tang in 2023, and 43 including Xuanfu Daizhe Tang in 2025. The 2025 table gives source, processing, and gram doses. In Xuanfu Daizhe Tang, licorice is dry-fried (41.40 g) and pinellia is Qing Ban Xia (34.50 g). The decoction uses 2000 mL of water, reduces to 1200 mL, removes the marc, boils again to 600 mL, and is taken warm at 200 mL three times a day.

items.name: TCM-TBOSD 辨证论治评测
items.summary_zh: CCL 2025 评测任务。齐鲁工业大学（山东省科学院）与山东中医药大学附属医院用脱敏病历做成 TCM-TBOSD，1500 条，覆盖 10 种证型、4 种疾病、381 味药。处方字段是药名列表，论文写明不包括剂量。仓库有基线代码和数据使用保密承诺书，病例表没有直接放在文件列表里。
orgs: 齐鲁工业大学（山东省科学院）
山东中医药大学附属医院
items.summary_en: CCL 2025 shared task. Qilu University of Technology and the Affiliated Hospital of Shandong University of Traditional Chinese Medicine built TCM-TBOSD from de-identified records: 1,500 cases, 10 syndromes, 4 diseases, and 381 herbs. The prescription field lists herb names and, as the paper states, excludes doses. The repository has baseline code and a confidentiality form; the case table is not in the file listing.

items.name: 中药肝损伤不良反应的风险信号
items.summary_zh: 用不良反应监测数据，探索中药所致肝损伤的新风险信号和易感因素。期刊页给出论文，没有放出个例表。
items.summary_en: Uses adverse-reaction monitoring data to look for new risk signals and susceptibility factors in traditional Chinese medicine–induced liver injury. The journal page publishes the article and does not release case rows.

items.name: 面像、体型、声音和问卷融合的四象体质辨识
items.summary_zh: 韩国韩医学研究院在 23 家韩医诊所收集 2973 名患者的面像、体型、声音和问卷，分别建四象体质模型后再融合。测试集男性准确率 64.0%，女性 55.2%。图像和问卷没有公开下载。
items.summary_en: KIOM fused face images, body shape, voice, and questionnaires from 2,973 patients at 23 Korean-medicine clinics to classify Sasang constitution. Test accuracy was 64.0% for men and 55.2% for women. The images and questionnaires are not publicly posted.

items.name: 用面部几何特征区分四象体质
items.summary_zh: 从面部照片提取距离、角度和距离比，用来区分四象体质。摘要给出的特征规模是距离 1225 项、角度 61250 项、距离比 749700 项。面像没有公开。
items.summary_en: Selects distances, angles, and distance ratios from facial photographs to distinguish Sasang constitution. The abstract counts 1,225 distance features, 61,250 angle features, and 749,700 ratio features. The photographs are not public.

items.name: 面色与体型的中医体质图像辨识
items.summary_zh: 采集健康人的全身站立图像，按中医体质量表标上体质，再用面色、体型和深度图像来辨认。图像没有公开。
items.summary_en: Full-body standing photos of healthy people, labeled with the Constitution in Chinese Medicine Questionnaire, and classified from complexion, body shape, and depth. The images are not public.

items.name: 均匀色空间的中医面色识别
items.venue: International Journal of Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence
items.summary_zh: 在均匀 Lab 色空间里识别中医面色。面像没有公开。
items.summary_en: Recognizes TCM facial complexion in a uniform Lab color space. The face images are not public.

items.name: 视频面部特征的中医望神分类
items.summary_zh: 用视频里的面部特征做中医望神的自动分类。视频没有公开。
items.summary_en: Classifies TCM spirit inspection from facial features in video. The videos are not public.

items.name: 冠心病、其他心血管病与健康人的脉象参数
items.summary_zh: 用压力传感器采集 251 人的脉图：冠心病 102 人、非冠心病的心血管病 94 人、健康人 55 人，比较三组脉象参数。脉图没有公开。
items.summary_en: Pressure-sensor pulse recordings from 251 people: 102 with coronary heart disease, 94 with other cardiovascular disease, and 55 healthy people. The recordings are not public.

items.name: 空腹过程的寸关尺脉图定量
items.summary_zh: 对 51 名健康人在空腹前、空腹第 4 天和第 7 天采集左寸、右寸和右关脉图，比较与胃肠虚实有关的脉象参数。脉图没有公开。
items.summary_en: Records Left Cun, Right Cun, and Right Guan pulses in 51 healthy adults before fasting and on fasting days 4 and 7. The recordings are not public.

items.name: 多通道桡动脉信号的脉象识别
items.venue: International Conference on Digital Transformation and Management
items.summary_zh: 用多通道设备采集桡动脉搏动，去噪并提取特征后，用卷积神经网络识别常见脉象。样本量和记录都没有公开。
items.summary_en: A convolutional network reads common pulse patterns from multichannel radial-artery signals after denoising and feature extraction. The sample size and the recordings are not public.

items.name: 九层卷积网络的腕部脉象分类
items.venue: International Symposium on Computer, Consumer and Control
items.summary_zh: 用 9 层卷积网络直接对中医腕部脉象信号分类，不再手工选择特征。脉图没有公开。
items.summary_en: A 9-layer convolutional network classifies TCM wrist-pulse signals without handcrafted features. The recordings are not public.

items.name: 中风患者韩医四诊的观察者一致性
items.summary_zh: 两名医师独立检查 168 名中风住院患者。脉诊体征的 AC1 为 0.66–0.89，望诊 0.66–0.95，闻诊 0.67–0.88，问诊 0.62–0.94。这是一致性研究，不是公开标注集。
items.summary_en: Two clinicians independently examined 168 hospitalized stroke patients with Korean-medicine pattern identification. AC1 was 0.66–0.89 for pulse, 0.66–0.95 for inspection, 0.67–0.88 for listening and smelling, and 0.62–0.94 for inquiry.

items.name: 脉波与语音联合筛查冠心病和心衰
items.venue: BMC Medical Informatics and Decision Making
items.summary_zh: 上海中医药大学等把桡动脉脉搏波当作脉诊，把语音当作闻诊，用来筛查冠心病和心力衰竭。同步记了 553 人，包括健康人、冠心病和心衰，另有 194 人做外部验证。
items.summary_en: Shanghai University of Traditional Chinese Medicine and collaborators treat the radial pulse wave as pulse diagnosis and the voice as auscultation, to screen for coronary artery disease and heart failure. They recorded 553 people (healthy, coronary disease, and heart failure) and checked the model on another 194.

items.name: AN-IHP：注意力网络预测配伍禁忌药对
items.venue: IEEE Transactions on Computational Biology and Bioinformatics
items.summary_zh: 用注意力网络预测中药里配伍禁忌的药对。
items.summary_en: Attention networks predict incompatible herb pairs in traditional Chinese medicine.

items.name: 配伍禁忌药对的监督学习框架
items.summary_zh: 用监督学习预测中药配伍禁忌药对。与后来的 IHPreten 是同一方向的另一篇会议论文。
items.summary_en: A supervised learning framework for incompatible herb pairs, a 2018 conference paper in the same line as the later IHPreten model.

items.name: 图注意力网络预测中药相互作用
items.summary_zh: 用图注意力网络预测中药之间的相互作用，用来提前发现配伍风险。
items.summary_en: Graph attention networks predict interactions among traditional Chinese medicines.

items.name: 质谱机器学习预测中药毒性
items.summary_zh: 用质谱和机器学习预测中药毒性。
items.summary_en: Machine learning on mass spectra predicts the toxicity of traditional Chinese medicines.

items.name: 基于结构相似的中药心血管毒性预测软件
items.summary_zh: 按化学结构相似性做软件，预测中药的心血管毒性。
items.summary_en: Structure-similarity software for predicting cardiovascular toxicity of traditional Chinese medicine.

items.name: 胸痹处方中的十八反关联规则
items.venue: China Journal of Chinese Materia Medica
items.summary_zh: 用关联规则查看胸痹处方里十八反药对的出现规律。
items.summary_en: Association-rule mining of the eighteen incompatible medicaments inside chest-pain prescriptions.

items.name: 中药心脏不良反应的文献计量与关联规则
items.summary_zh: 用文献计量和关联规则归纳中药引起的心脏不良反应有哪些规律。
items.summary_en: Bibliometrics and association rules for cardiac adverse reactions attributed to Chinese materia medica.

items.name: SiPA：同时预测中药相互作用
items.summary_zh: 因为成分、靶点和疾病之间的相互作用记录不够，提出 SiPA，用来同时预测并扩展中药相互作用网络。
items.summary_en: SiPA predicts several interactions at once so the TCM network among constituents, targets, and diseases can be expanded.

items.name: 肿瘤治疗中的草药–化学药相互作用
items.summary_zh: 综述肿瘤患者联用草药和抗癌药时的相互作用，包括药效、药代机制和风险预测。
items.summary_en: Review of herb–drug interactions in oncology, covering pharmacodynamic and pharmacokinetic mechanisms and risk prediction.

items.name: 评估药物–草药相互作用的人工智能工具
items.summary_zh: 综述用人工智能模型评估药物和草药相互作用的工具。
items.summary_en: Review of artificial-intelligence models and tools for assessing drug–herb interactions.

items.name: GPT-4 作答台湾中医师执照考试
items.summary_zh: 用 GPT-4 回答 2022 年台湾中医师执照考试 480 题，并与两名持证中医师对照。直接选答和先解释再选答两种方式合在一起，模型准确率 43.9%，两名医师分别是 70% 和 78.4%。错误里约 55.3% 来自对中医概念的误解。这是执照考试和持证医师的对照，不是把证候、处方合理性和安全拦截分开测。
items.summary_en: GPT-4 answered 480 items from the 2022 Taiwan TCM licensing examination and was compared with two licensed TCM doctors, using direct answers and explain-then-answer. Overall accuracy was 43.9% for the model, versus 70% and 78.4% for the two doctors. About 55.3% of the errors came from misunderstanding TCM concepts. This compares exam recall with licensed practitioners; it does not separately score syndrome judgment, prescription rationality, and safety checks.

items.name: 神经网络判别经方方名
items.summary_zh: 从《伤寒论》和《金匮要略》原文抽出 261 首方、173 味药，训练神经网络：只给出药物组成、不给方名时，判断这是哪一首经方，并用代表不同经的加减方做检验。
orgs: 广州中医药大学第一附属医院
items.summary_en: A neural network trained on 261 formulae and 173 herbs extracted from the Shanghan Lun and the Synopsis of Prescriptions of the Golden Chamber. Given only the medicinal composition, it names the classical formula, and it is tested on modified formulae from different meridians.

items.name: TCM-Suite
items.summary_zh: 把药材鉴定和网络药理放在同一个网站上。Watson 这边现在列着方剂 6692 首、药材 7322 味、化合物 704321 个、蛋白 19319 个、疾病 15437 种。Holmes 用标记基因做药材鉴定。2022 年发表在 iMeta。
items.summary_en: A site that joins herb identification with network pharmacology. The Watson section currently lists 6,692 formulas, 7,322 herbs, 704,321 compounds, 19,319 proteins, and 15,437 diseases. Holmes identifies herbs with marker genes. Described in iMeta in 2022.

items.name: NPASS
items.summary_zh: 天然产物的实验活性库。这一版有天然产物 204023 个、来源生物 48940 个、靶点 8764 个、活性记录 1048756 条，活性数值来自 ChEMBL 和文献。物种来源接过 TCM-ID、TCMID、TCMSP、TM-MC 等库。2026 年更新的论文在 2025 年 11 月登在 Nucleic Acids Research。
items.summary_en: A database of measured activity for natural products. This version lists 204,023 natural products, 48,940 source organisms, 8,764 targets, and 1,048,756 activity records, with values drawn from ChEMBL and the literature. Species records were also taken from TCM-ID, TCMID, TCMSP, and TM-MC. The 2026 update appeared in Nucleic Acids Research in November 2025.

items.name: 中医世家
items.summary_zh: 在线查阅中医古籍、药材、方剂和医案。方剂索引 25425 项，可按首字或拼音找；药材索引 11307 项。原来的网站已经打不开，现在用的是新网址。
items.summary_en: An online reader for TCM classics, herbs, formulas, and case records. The formula index has 25,425 entries, browsable by initial character or pinyin, and the herb index has 11,307 entries. The old site no longer opens; this is the new address.

items.name: PharmMapper
items.summary_zh: 上传一个分子的三维结构，反查它可能落到哪些蛋白上。2017 版根据 2016 年 1 月 1 日前的 PDB 建库，有 7000 多个受体药效团，覆盖 1627 个药物靶点，其中 459 个是人的蛋白。中药成分只有结构、还没有实验靶点时可以用。
items.summary_en: Upload a 3D molecular structure and get possible protein targets. The 2017 release, built from PDB entries released before 1 January 2016, holds over 7,000 receptor pharmacophores covering 1,627 drug targets, 459 of them human proteins. Useful when a herb constituent has a structure but no measured target.

items.name: tcm-cli
items.summary_zh: 在终端里用自然语言查中医。可以问方剂组成、从症状看证候，也可以核配伍。需要 Python 3.10 以上和一个大模型接口密钥。本地数据可以用命令拉下来，包括药材、方剂，以及 TCMSP、TCMID 等。许可是 MIT。仓库建于 2026 年 2 月。
items.summary_en: A terminal tool for asking TCM questions in natural language, including formula composition, syndrome questions, and compatibility checks. It needs Python 3.10 or newer and an LLM API key. Local data can be pulled for herbs, formulas, TCMSP, TCMID, and related sets. MIT license. The repository was created in February 2026.

items.name: pro_TCMLLM
items.summary_zh: 一份把神农指令数据接到 ChatGLM-6B 上的 P-Tuning 脚本。正在启用的命令把前缀长度设为 128、学习率 2e-2，训练和验证文件放在 ShenNong_TCM_Dataset 目录，最长 3000 步，单卡 batch 为 4，梯度累积为 2，并打开 fp16。仓库建于 2025 年 11 月。
items.summary_en: A P-Tuning script that trains ChatGLM-6B on the ShenNong instruction files. The active command uses prefix length 128, learning rate 2e-2, the ShenNong train and test files, 3,000 steps, batch size 4, gradient accumulation 2, and fp16. The repository was created in November 2025.

items.name: Tao-Shanghan-Corpus
items.section: 原始书籍 / 预训练语料
items.summary_zh: 可下载的《伤寒论》文献语料，把条文、注文和异文分开。2026 年 8 月 11 日发布的 1.0 版有条文记录 681 条，其中正条文 398 条，对齐的历史注文 2958 条，异文 616 条。许可是 CC BY 4.0。
items.summary_en: A downloadable Shanghan Lun corpus that keeps clauses, commentaries, and textual variants apart. Version 1.0, released 11 August 2026, has 681 clause records, including 398 canonical clauses, 2,958 aligned commentaries, and 616 variants. CC BY 4.0.

items.name: 五部伤寒书知识图谱
items.summary_zh: 从《伤寒论》《伤寒类方》《伤寒悬解》《伤寒论浅注》《伤寒九十论》抽出的知识图谱。节点 26771 个，关系 8272 条，CSV 可以导入 Neo4j。2024 年发布在 ScienceDB。
items.summary_en: A knowledge graph drawn from Shanghan Lun, Shanghan Leifang, Shanghan Xuanjie, Shanghan Lun Qianzhu, and Shanghan Jiushi Lun. It has 26,771 nodes and 8,272 relations in CSV files that can be loaded into Neo4j. Released on ScienceDB in 2024.

items.name: 经方按症状排序（平人）
items.summary_zh: 把《伤寒杂病论》里某一方对应的证当作应有证，把病人当下的证当作现有证，两边匹配后给出 0% 到 100% 的适用性，并做成在线程序《平人》。输入用的是书里描述症状和病程的词。2021 年 12 月发布，许可 CC BY 4.0。
items.summary_en: Matches the pattern expected by a formula in the Shanghan zabing lun with the patient's present pattern and scores the fit from 0% to 100%. The method is implemented as the online program Pingren. Inputs are the book's own words for symptoms and course. Released December 2021, CC BY 4.0.

items.name: 中医体质量表计分代码
items.summary_zh: 中医体质量表 CCMQ 的 SAS 代码、SPSS 语法和一份 Excel 测试表，用来按问卷计算体质。2021 年 1 月发布，许可 CC BY 4.0。
items.summary_en: SAS code, SPSS syntax, and an Excel test sheet for scoring the Constitution in Chinese Medicine Questionnaire. Released January 2021, CC BY 4.0.

items.name: WHO 中医药国际标准术语
items.summary_zh: 世界卫生组织 2022 年公布的中医药术语标准，给临床、政策和病历使用同一套概念。出版物页面提供 PDF，用来对照证、证候和四诊的中英文说法。
items.summary_en: The World Health Organization's 2022 terminology standard for traditional Chinese medicine, so clinics, policy, and records can share the same concepts. The publications page offers a PDF for checking Chinese and English wording of patterns and the four examinations.

items.name: 吴鞠通温病技能
items.summary_zh: 把《温病条辨》《医医病书》《吴鞠通医案》和《温热经纬》整理成温病派技能，方便和六经方证对照。仓库简介写有医案 359 案、温病方 22 首，辨证用三焦和卫气营血。
items.summary_en: A warm-disease skill set drawn from Wenbing Tiaobian, Yiyi Bingshu, Wu Jutong's case records, and Wenre Jingwei, set beside six-meridian formula patterns. The repository description lists 359 cases and 22 warm-disease formulas, using sanjiao and wei-qi-ying-xue.

items.name: 附子毒性成分指数
items.summary_zh: 用乌头碱、新乌头碱和次乌头碱的最小致死量做加权，提出附子的毒性成分指数，避免把三种双酯型生物碱的含量直接相加。2016 年发表在 Frontiers in Pharmacology。
items.summary_en: Weights aconitine, mesaconitine, and hypaconitine by minimum lethal dose and defines a toxic-constituents index for aconite, instead of adding the three diester-alkaloid contents directly. Frontiers in Pharmacology, 2016.

items.name: 喜炎平严重不良事件的投影重要性
items.summary_zh: 用变量投影重要性分析年龄和中西药联用，对喜炎平注射液不良事件严重程度的影响。2023 年发表在 Chinese Medicine。
items.summary_en: Uses variable-importance-for-projection scores to see how age and herb-drug combinations contribute to the severity of adverse events linked to Xiyanping injection. Chinese Medicine, 2023.

items.name: 喜炎平联用药物与疑似过敏
items.summary_zh: 用国家医保抽样做巢式病例对照，看喜炎平注射液和其他药一起用时，疑似过敏的风险怎么变。2022 年发表在 Frontiers in Pharmacology。
items.summary_en: A nested case-control study in a national medical-insurance sample on concomitant drugs and suspected allergic reactions with Xiyanping injection. Frontiers in Pharmacology, 2022.

items.name: 湖北中药注射剂自发报告
items.summary_zh: 分析湖北省 2014 到 2019 年中药注射剂不良反应自发报告，看哪些品种和表现更值得留意。2021 年发表在 Scientific Reports。
items.summary_en: Analyzes spontaneous adverse-reaction reports for traditional Chinese medicine injections in Hubei from 2014 to 2019. Scientific Reports, 2021.

items.name: 中药不良反应信号的决策树分类
items.venue: BMC Medical Informatics and Decision Making
items.summary_zh: 用决策树给中药药物警戒里的信号检测做分类。2018 年发表在 BMC Medical Informatics and Decision Making。
items.summary_en: Decision-tree classification for signal detection in traditional Chinese medicine pharmacovigilance. BMC Medical Informatics and Decision Making, 2018.

items.name: MSAT：中药物不良反应预测
items.summary_zh: 用 FAERS 自发报告训练异构图神经网络，预测中药相关的不良反应。2026 年发表在 Frontiers in Pharmacology。
items.summary_en: A heterogeneous graph neural network trained on FAERS spontaneous reports to predict adverse reactions associated with Chinese materia medica. Frontiers in Pharmacology, 2026.

items.name: 强化学习的可解释中医处方推荐
items.summary_zh: 用强化学习做可解释的中医处方推荐，并把较小语言模型里的隐含偏好用上。2025 年发表在 Chinese Medicine。
items.summary_en: Reinforcement learning for explainable traditional Chinese medicine prescription recommendation, using implicit preferences from a smaller language model. Chinese Medicine, 2025.

items.name: 胰腺癌病历的证型识别
items.summary_zh: 从胰腺癌电子病历的自由文本里识别中医证型。2025 年发表在 JMIR Formative Research。
items.summary_en: Identifies TCM syndrome types from free text in electronic records of people with pancreatic cancer. JMIR Formative Research, 2025.

items.name: 中医病历嵌套实体识别
items.summary_zh: 识别中医电子病历里套在一起的实体，比如症状和它所在的部位。2025 年发表在 Scientific Reports。
items.summary_en: Recognizes nested entities in traditional Chinese medicine electronic medical records, such as a symptom and the body site it belongs to. Scientific Reports, 2025.

items.name: 中医命名实体识别的知识蒸馏
items.summary_zh: 用知识蒸馏做中医命名实体识别，把大模型的识别能力收进更小的模型。2026 年发表在 Scientific Reports。
items.summary_en: Knowledge distillation for named-entity recognition in traditional Chinese medicine, moving the skill into a smaller model. Scientific Reports, 2026.

items.name: 远程监督的中医跨度实体抽取
items.summary_zh: 用远程监督做跨度一级的中医实体抽取，从文本里直接抽出一段实体，而不是逐字标注。2021 年发表在 JMIR Medical Informatics。
items.summary_en: Span-level named-entity extraction for traditional Chinese medicine, trained with distant supervision. JMIR Medical Informatics, 2021.

items.name: 人工智能中医辅助诊断系统验证
items.summary_zh: 验证一套基于人工智能的中医辅助诊断系统。2020 年发表在 JMIR Medical Informatics。
items.summary_en: Validation of an artificial-intelligence assistive diagnostic system for traditional Chinese medicine. JMIR Medical Informatics, 2020.

items.name: 基于知识图谱的中成药处方监测
items.summary_zh: 用知识图谱做中成药处方监测，用来发现联用和剂量上的问题。2021 年发表。
items.summary_en: A prescription-monitoring program for Chinese patent medicines built on a knowledge graph. Evidence-Based Complementary and Alternative Medicine, 2021.

items.name: 中药复方剂量调整方法
items.summary_zh: 讨论怎样把经验用药收成可调整的复方剂量，往更精细的用法走。2026 年发表在 Frontiers in Pharmacology。
items.summary_en: A method for adjusting the dosage of traditional Chinese medicine formulas, moving from empirical practice toward more precise use. Frontiers in Pharmacology, 2026.

items.name: 复方煎煮时长分类
items.venue: Computer Methods in Biomechanics and Biomedical Engineering
items.summary_zh: 按多维特征给中药复方的煎煮时长做分类。2024 年发表。
items.summary_en: Classifies how long a traditional Chinese medicine compound should be decocted, using multi-dimensional features. Computer Methods in Biomechanics and Biomedical Engineering, 2024.

items.name: 方剂推荐中的剂量预测
items.summary_zh: 在推荐中药方剂的同时预测剂量，用了扩散模型和异构层次网络。2025 年 IEEE BIBM。
items.summary_en: Predicts doses while recommending a traditional Chinese medicine formula, using a diffusion model and a heterogeneous hierarchical network. IEEE BIBM, 2025.

items.name: 中西药相互作用专论库
items.venue: Evidence-Based Chinese Medicine and Technology Assessment
items.summary_zh: 为临床决策支持库整理有证据的中西药相互作用专论。2026 年发表。
items.summary_en: Evidence-based monographs of Chinese herb–drug interactions for a clinical decision-support database. Evidence-Based Chinese Medicine and Technology Assessment, 2026.

items.name: 中医临床命名实体与关系联合识别
items.summary_zh: 用字符级卷积循环交互网络，同时做中医临床命名实体识别和关系抽取。2026 年发表在 Artificial Intelligence in Medicine。
items.summary_en: Joint named-entity and relation extraction for traditional Chinese medicine clinical text, with a character-level convolutional recurrent network. Artificial Intelligence in Medicine, 2026.

items.name: 唇色的中医望诊分类
items.summary_zh: 用多类支持向量机，按唇色做中医望诊。2012 年发表。
items.summary_en: Classifies lip color for traditional Chinese medicine inspection with multi-class support vector machines. BMC Complementary and Alternative Medicine, 2012.

items.name: 可控 Transformer 面诊
items.venue: IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics
items.summary_zh: 用一个可控的 Transformer，同时做多项中医面诊任务。2026 年发表。
items.summary_en: A controllable Transformer for several traditional Chinese medicine facial-inspection tasks at once. IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics, 2026.

items.name: 小波包分形维的闻诊
items.summary_zh: 用小波包分形维和支持向量机，把中医闻诊里的声音做成可计算的证候判断。2014 年发表。
items.summary_en: Turns traditional Chinese medicine listening into a computable syndrome task with wavelet-packet fractal dimension and a support vector machine. 2014.

items.name: 用声学特征辨体质
items.venue: Journal of Alternative and Complementary Medicine
items.summary_zh: 从语音的声学特征辨认中医体质。2013 年发表。
items.summary_en: Uses acoustic features of the voice to identify constitutions in traditional Chinese medicine. Journal of Alternative and Complementary Medicine, 2013.

items.name: 冠心病问诊的多标签学习
items.summary_zh: 用多标签学习给冠心病的中医问诊诊断建模。2010 年发表。
items.summary_en: Models inquiry-based diagnosis of coronary heart disease in traditional Chinese medicine with multi-label learning. BMC Complementary and Alternative Medicine, 2010.

items.name: 上海 2 型糖尿病问诊证候识别
items.summary_zh: 用上海的中医问诊信息，识别 2 型糖尿病的证候。2022 年发表。
items.summary_en: Recognizes traditional Chinese medicine syndromes of type 2 diabetes from inquiry information collected in Shanghai. 2022.

items.name: 多囊卵巢证型的多标签预测
items.summary_zh: 比较不同特征选择和多标签模型，预测多囊卵巢综合征患者的中医证型。2024 年发表在 Heliyon。
items.summary_en: Compares feature selection and multi-label models for predicting traditional Chinese medicine patterns in polycystic ovary syndrome. Heliyon, 2024.

items.name: 痛经辨证的机器学习模型
items.summary_zh: 用机器学习给痛经做中医辨证。2025 年发表。
items.summary_en: A machine-learning model for traditional Chinese medicine syndrome differentiation in dysmenorrhea. Combinatorial Chemistry and High Throughput Screening, 2025.

items.name: 儿童多动症推拿的特征选择
items.summary_zh: 用机器学习挑选特征，并预测注意缺陷多动障碍儿童的中医推拿方案。2025 年发表在 Bioengineering。
items.summary_en: Selects features and predicts pediatric tuina choices for children with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder. Bioengineering, 2025.

items.name: 乳腺癌中医证型的神经网络区分
items.summary_zh: 用神经网络和聚类，区分乳腺癌患者的中医证型。2020 年发表在 Frontiers in Pharmacology。
items.summary_en: Uses a neural network and clustering to separate traditional Chinese medicine patterns in people with breast cancer. Frontiers in Pharmacology, 2020.

items.name: 肺磨玻璃结节的中医症状风险模型
items.summary_zh: 把中医临床症状和影像进展合在一起，评估肺磨玻璃结节往后发展的风险。2026 年发表在 Journal of Integrative Medicine。
items.summary_en: Assesses how pulmonary ground-glass nodules may progress, combining imaging with traditional Chinese medicine symptoms. Journal of Integrative Medicine, 2026.

items.name: TCM-Qwen2.5-7B-SFT
items.summary_zh: 基于 Qwen2.5-7B 的中医监督微调权重，模型文件是完整的 safetensors，许可 Apache-2.0。2026 年 10 月上传。
items.summary_en: A traditional Chinese medicine supervised-fine-tuning checkpoint of Qwen2.5-7B. The weights are full safetensors files under Apache-2.0, uploaded in October 2026.

items.name: Qwen3.5-9B 中医继续预训练
items.summary_zh: 在 Qwen3.5-9B 上做的中医继续预训练 LoRA，许可 Apache-2.0。2026 年 7 月上传。
items.summary_en: A continued-pretraining LoRA for traditional Chinese medicine on Qwen3.5-9B, under Apache-2.0. Uploaded in July 2026.

items.name: 中医体质 Qwen3-8B 量化权重
items.summary_zh: 面向中医体质的 Qwen3-8B 量化权重，仓库里有 q4、q5 和 q8 三份 GGUF，许可 Apache-2.0。2026 年 9 月上传。
items.summary_en: Quantized Qwen3-8B weights for traditional Chinese medicine constitution, with q4, q5, and q8 GGUF files under Apache-2.0. Uploaded in September 2026.

items.name: TCMDATA
items.summary_zh: 面向靶点的中医网络药理分析和人工智能解读的 R 包。2026 年发表在 Current Molecular Pharmacology。
items.summary_en: An R package for target-oriented network pharmacology and AI-assisted interpretation in traditional Chinese medicine. Current Molecular Pharmacology, 2026.

items.name: WHO 西太区传统医学术语
items.summary_zh: 世界卫生组织西太平洋区 2007 年的传统医学国际标准术语，是 2022 年中医药术语之前的一版。PDF 可以从 IRIS 打开。
items.summary_en: The World Health Organization Western Pacific terminology for traditional medicine, the 2007 predecessor of the 2022 Chinese-medicine terminology. The PDF is on IRIS.

items.name: 融合证素知识的中医证候术语映射
items.summary_zh: 用证素知识，把临床里的证候说法映射到标准证候名。刊在《情报科学》2025 年第 43 卷第 7 期。
items.summary_en: Maps clinical wordings of TCM syndromes onto standard syndrome names with syndrome-element knowledge. Information Science, 2025, volume 43, issue 7.
